papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构建）、satisfies the differential Chapman--Kolmogorov equation（满足微分Chapman-Kolmogorov方程）、demonstrate（论证）、study（研究）。；研究对象：一种具有初始状态记忆的连续时间、正可分的非马尔可夫随机过程（称为“Funessian过程”），以及由其驱动的随机游走中的输运现象和遍历性破缺。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该非马尔可夫过程在稳态下相关函数呈指数衰减（通常被视为马尔可夫动力学特征），但记忆效应在整个演化过程中持续存在，并体现在可观测统计量中；互信息可作为该过程非马尔可夫性的可靠度量；记忆效应会破坏遍历性并改变扩散系数等输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该非马尔可夫过程在稳态下相关函数呈指数衰减（通常被视为马尔可夫动力学特征），但记忆效应在整个演化过程中持续存在，并体现在可观测统计量中；互信息可作为该过程非马尔可夫性的可靠度量；记忆效应会破坏遍历性并改变扩散系数等输运性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建：通过满足微分Chapman-Kolmogorov方程构造一个正可分的非马尔可夫过程；分析手段：计算相关函数、互信息；应用研究：将该过程用于驱动随机游走，分析其遍历性和扩散系数。

papers.title: Towards standardisation of average grain size measurement of additively manufactured microstructures using EBSD
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured (AM) alloys have heterogeneous microstructures with broad grain size distributions and highly anisotropic and/or non-convex grain shapes. AM components can have complex geometries and porosity which may affect the local microstructure. Currently there is no electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD)-based grain size measurement standard suitable for typical AM materials. An interlaboratory comparison study was conducted to find out what grain size metrics and summary statistics are currently used to describe average grain size. Participants were asked to measure and report the average grain size from the same EBSD map dataset. Detailed reports have been published in Reference [1]. Based on these results, we have tested and propose recommendations for a new standard for measuring average grain size in AM materials. The present work demonstrates the suitability and limitations of the proposal across several different Ni and Al AM components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：interlaboratory comparison study（实验室间对比研究）、EBSD（电子背散射衍射）、measurement（测量）。；研究对象：增材制造（AM）合金的微观结构，具体为Ni基和Al基增材制造部件中的晶粒尺寸测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 目前缺乏适用于增材制造材料的基于EBSD的晶粒尺寸测量标准；通过实验室间对比研究，提出了针对增材制造材料平均晶粒尺寸测量的新标准建议，并在多种Ni和Al增材制造部件上验证了其适用性与局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：目前缺乏适用于增材制造材料的基于EBSD的晶粒尺寸测量标准；通过实验室间对比研究，提出了针对增材制造材料平均晶粒尺寸测量的新标准建议，并在多种Ni和Al增材制造部件上验证了其适用性与局限性。；创新点：针对增材制造材料特有的宽晶粒尺寸分布、高度各向异性及非凸晶粒形状，首次提出并测试了基于EBSD的平均晶粒尺寸测量标准建议。
papers.method_zh: 采用电子背散射衍射（EBSD）技术进行晶粒尺寸测量，通过组织多个实验室对同一EBSD图谱数据集进行平均晶粒尺寸测量与报告，开展实验室间对比研究，并基于结果提出标准化建议。

papers.title: Fermion Families and Pontryagin Class: Topological Field Theory via Colour Symmetry Extension
papers.abstract: Family puzzle asks why the Standard Model (SM) features exactly 3 families of quarks and leptons. Motivated by topological constraints, we study 4-dimensional fermionic anomalies with discrete $Z_n$ symmetry, classified by the 5d spin bordism group. We show that only the group-cohomology subclass H$^5(Z_n,U(1))\cong Z_n$ can be canceled by an anomalous $Z_n$-symmetric 4d $Z_n$-gauge topological quantum field theory (TQFT), while beyond-group-cohomology $A_{Z_n} p_1$ involving the Pontryagin class $p_1$ cannot (except $n=2,3$). More generally, we prove that any cocycle $α_d\in$H$^d(Z_n,U(1))$ in odd spacetime dimension $d\ge3$ is trivialised by the symmetry extension $1\to Z_n\to Z_{n^2}\to Z_n\to 1,$ and we construct the corresponding symmetric anomalous boundary TQFT. For $d=5$ and $n=3$, this yields a Spin$\times Z_3$-symmetric 4d $Z_3$-gauge TQFT that cancels the mixed discrete $(\bf B+L)$-gauge-gravitational anomaly of the SM in the absence of 3 "sterile" right-handed neutrinos $ν_R$. We further analyze a generalized SM with $N_c$ colors and $N_f$ families and argue that missing $N_f$ copies of the $ν_R$ can be naturally replaced by that 4d anomalous $Spin\times_{Z_2^F} Z_{2 N_f,{{\bf B} + {\bf L}}}$ symmetric $Z_{N_c}$-gauge TQFT under the anomaly cancellation, via an appropriate $Z_{N_c}$-color symmetry extension construction $1\to Z_{N_c}\to Spin\times Z_{N_cN_f}\to Spin\times_{Z_2^F} Z_{2N_f}\to1$ of anomalous topological order. For minimal nonzero positive integers $N_c$ and $N_f$, we find the minimal color extensions: $N_c=3, N_f \ge 3$; $N_c=4, N_f \ge 2$; and $N_c=12, N_f \ge 6$. If we further require that an SM baryon is a fermion so $N_c$ is odd, then $Z_{N_c}=Z($SU$(N_c))$ color center, we prove 3 families and 3 colors, $N_c=N_f=3$, is the unique case that stands out. We also prove that $A_{Z_3}p_1= 0\mod3$ for the mod 3 cohomology class in an appropriate context.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑场论、对称性扩展、群上同调、自旋配边群。；研究对象：标准模型中夸克和轻子恰好存在三代（family puzzle）的起源，以及与之相关的费米子反常、拓扑量子场论（TQFT）和颜色对称性扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了标准模型中三代费米子与三色（N_c=N_f=3）是唯一满足所有拓扑约束（包括庞特里亚金类p_1相关的反常抵消）的独特组合；构造了可抵消标准模型中混合（B+L）-规范-引力反常的4维Z_3-规范TQFT，从而无需引入三代“惰性”右手中微子ν_R。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了标准模型中三代费米子与三色（N_c=N_f=3）是唯一满足所有拓扑约束（包括庞特里亚金类p_1相关的反常抵消）的独特组合；构造了可抵消标准模型中混合（B+L）-规范-引力反常的4维Z_3-规范TQFT，从而无需引入三代“惰性”右手中微子ν_R。；创新点：首次将庞特里亚金类p_1相关的非群上同调反常（A_{Z_n} p_1）纳入家族问题的拓扑约束分析，并证明仅n=2,3时可被抵消；通过颜色对称性扩展构造了可替代右手中微子的反常TQFT，并严格推导出N_c=N_f=3是唯一满足所有条件的解。
papers.method_zh: 利用5维自旋配边群对离散Z_n对称性下的4维费米子反常进行分类；通过群上同调H^d(Z_n,U(1))分析反常的抵消条件；构造对称性扩展1→Z_n→Z_{n^2}→Z_n→1并构建相应的边界TQFT；对广义标准模型（N_c色、N_f代）进行颜色对称性扩展分析，并求解最小正整数解。

papers.title: Realization of the Ruby Lattice Antiferromagnet in Layered Transition-Metal Fluorides
papers.abstract: The antiferromagnet on the ruby lattice is expected to host a range of exotic emergent phenomena, yet its material realization has remained elusive. Here we show that the layered transition metal fluorides CsBaFe$_3$F$_{12}$ and CsBaCr$_3$F$_{12}$ with Fe$^{3+}$ and Cr$^{3+}$ ions realize only slightly distorted ruby lattice geometries with spin moments $S=5/2$ and $S=3/2$, respectively. Their microscopic Hamiltonians, calculated with DFT energy mapping, are dominated by short-ranged antiferromagnetic interactions within the ruby layers. Classical Monte Carlo simulations reveal strong frustration in both compounds, with local Néel correlations on the hexagonal plaquettes and distinct long-range ordering tendencies governed by weaker triangular links. For CsBaFe$_3$F$_{12}$, the calculated thermodynamic behaviour is consistent with the experimentally reported magnetic ordering scale. For CsBaCr$_3$F$_{12}$, classical Monte Carlo and Luttinger-Tisza analysis reveal competing low-energy ordering wave vectors, strong finite-size sensitivity, and a tendency toward incommensurate order. Overall, our results establish these fluorides as experimentally accessible ruby-lattice antiferromagnets and provide quantitative predictions for future neutron-scattering studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算为主，辅以实验验证）。判断依据：DFT能量映射、经典蒙特卡洛模拟、Luttinger-Tisza分析等计算手段，并结合实验报道的磁有序标度进行验证。；研究对象：层状过渡金属氟化物CsBaFe₃F₁₂和CsBaCr₃F₁₂，具体实现红宝石晶格反铁磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CsBaFe₃F₁₂和CsBaCr₃F₁₂分别以S=5/2和S=3/2的自旋矩实现了近乎完美的红宝石晶格几何，其微观哈密顿量由层内短程反铁磁相互作用主导，表现出强阻挫特性，并具有不同的长程有序倾向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CsBaFe₃F₁₂和CsBaCr₃F₁₂分别以S=5/2和S=3/2的自旋矩实现了近乎完美的红宝石晶格几何，其微观哈密顿量由层内短程反铁磁相互作用主导，表现出强阻挫特性，并具有不同的长程有序倾向。；创新点：首次在实验可及的层状过渡金属氟化物中实现了红宝石晶格反铁磁体，填补了该几何阻挫体系材料实现的空白，并为未来中子散射研究提供了定量预测。
papers.method_zh: DFT能量映射计算微观哈密顿量；经典蒙特卡洛模拟研究热力学行为和阻挫效应；Luttinger-Tisza分析确定低能有序波矢。

papers.title: A GPU-based Solver for Polarization Dynamics in Ferroelectric Materials
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric materials can be used for the development of multiple device concepts combining non-volatility, small dimensions, low-power actuation, and electrical tunability. Such development demands efficient and precise design of simulation tools describing the polarization texture. However, most existing ferroelectric solvers are CPU-based and rely on simplified electrostatic treatments and reduced-dimensional representations of the polarization field. These approximations limit their ability to capture finite-size and boundary effects and restrict the range of domain structures and domain walls that can be realistically simulated. Here, we present a fully GPU (graphics processing units)-accelerated and scalable numerical solver, named PETASPIN_microelectrics, for computing the full polarization vector field of ferroelectric systems using the Ginzburg-Landau formalism. Our solver incorporates an optimized and validated calculation of the full electrostatic field and enables the parallel execution of multiple simulations. We systematically validated the solver with several benchmark problems, including phase transitions in BaTiO3 and ferroelectric domain wall profiles. Our simulations reproduce temperature-driven hysteretic phase transitions in BaTiO3. We also reproduce hysteresis loops and demonstrate stabilization of a three-dimensional hybrid skyrmion in a PbTiO3/SrTiO3 bilayer system. Our results show quantitative agreement with predictions from an analytical theory and prior experimental studies. The proposed solver provides an efficient, accurate platform for large-scale simulations of ferroelectric materials including stabilization of topological textures supporting predictive modeling for next-generation of ferroelectric device design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“GPU-based solver”“numerical solver”“simulations”。；研究对象：铁电材料中的极化动力学，具体包括BaTiO₃的相变、PbTiO₃/SrTiO₃双层体系中的三维混合斯格明子等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发的全GPU加速求解器PETASPIN_microelectrics能够高效、准确地模拟铁电材料的全极化矢量场，定量复现了温度驱动的滞后相变、电滞回线，并成功稳定了三维混合斯格明子拓扑结构，与解析理论和实验研究定量一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发的全GPU加速求解器PETASPIN_microelectrics能够高效、准确地模拟铁电材料的全极化矢量场，定量复现了温度驱动的滞后相变、电滞回线，并成功稳定了三维混合斯格明子拓扑结构，与解析理论和实验研究定量一致。；创新点：现有铁电求解器多为CPU基，依赖简化静电处理和降维极化场表示，难以捕捉有限尺寸和边界效应。本工作首次实现了全GPU加速、可扩展的铁电全极化矢量场求解，并集成了完整的静电场计算，显著提升了模拟效率和真实感。
papers.method_zh: 基于Ginzburg-Landau形式论的全GPU加速数值求解器（PETASPIN_microelectrics），包含优化且经过验证的全静电场计算，支持多模拟并行执行。

papers.title: Synthesis and properties of bulk Mg$_3$WN$_4$ in a wurtzite-derived structure
papers.abstract: Experimental synthesis of theoretically predicted materials with controlled elemental coordination environments can lead to realization of useful properties, such as facile ion transport or ferroelectric switching. Among such materials are new ternary nitrides in the Mg-W-N composition space, where several new stable and metastable compounds have been predicted and synthesized recently in bulk and film forms. Here, we report for the first time on the bulk synthesis of Mg$_3$WN$_4$ in a wurtzite-derived crystal structure via a solid state metathesis reaction. $In$ $situ$ synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction shows how the ion exchange proceeds from Li$_6$WN$_4$ + 3 MgCl$_2$ precursors to Mg$_3$WN$_4$ + 6 LiCl products, with the reaction starting slowly near 380 $^\circ$C and completing by 600 $^\circ$C, including the presence of a competing disordered rocksalt-derived phase (Mg,W)N above 440 $^\circ$C. The follow up $ex$ $situ$ powder synthesis at 400 $^\circ$C for 0.5 hour with 10% excess MgCl$_2$ reveals the cation-ordered nature of the wurtzite-derived Mg$_3$WN$_4$ structure with polar symmetry confirmed by second harmonic generation measurements. Optical absorption spectra, chemical composition analysis, and electron microscopy imaging suggests that bulk wurtzite Mg$_3$WN$_4$ is prone to defect formation. Overall, this study shows that selective $ex$ $situ$ synthesis of the phase pure ternary nitrides, informed by \textit{in situ} measurements, is possible by carefully controlling the thermal budget of the reaction, and paves a way towards property characterization of wurtzite Mg$_3$WN$_4$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：experimental synthesis、solid state metathesis reaction、in situ synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction、second harmonic generation measurements。；研究对象：三元氮化物Mg₃WN₄，具体为纤锌矿衍生结构（wurtzite-derived structure）的块体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次通过固态复分解反应成功合成了块体纤锌矿衍生结构的Mg₃WN₄，并发现该材料具有极性对称性（由二次谐波产生测量证实），但易形成缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次通过固态复分解反应成功合成了块体纤锌矿衍生结构的Mg₃WN₄，并发现该材料具有极性对称性（由二次谐波产生测量证实），但易形成缺陷。；创新点：首次实现块体纤锌矿衍生结构Mg₃WN₄的合成，并通过原位与非原位结合的方法揭示了反应路径（包括竞争相的出现），证明了通过精确控制热预算可实现相纯三元氮化物的选择性合成。
papers.method_zh: 固态复分解反应（以Li₆WN₄和MgCl₂为前驱体）；原位同步辐射粉末X射线衍射（监测反应进程及中间相）；非原位粉末合成（400°C、0.5小时、10%过量MgCl₂）；二次谐波产生测量（确认极性对称性）；光学吸收光谱、化学成分分析、电子显微镜成像（表征缺陷形成倾向）。

papers.title: Non-invertible symmetry enriched string net topological orders
papers.abstract: We propose a definition of a non-invertible symmetry enriched topological order (NI-SETO), and we implement our definition for string net models. We do so in two ways, using full inclusions of unitary fusion categories (UFCs), as well as anyon condensation. In both cases, the NI-SETO is a relative center of UFCs. All NI-SETOs can be realized in either model, where we can use enriched UFCs to get chiral examples on the boundary of a 3D Walker-Wang model representing the anomaly. We describe several examples of NI-SETOs and compute the qualitative symmetry action on anyons and symmetry defects using tube algebra techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：定义、实现、相对中心、管代数技术。；研究对象：非可逆对称性富集的弦网拓扑序（NI-SETO），具体为基于幺正融合范畴（UFC）的弦网模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出非可逆对称性富集拓扑序（NI-SETO）的定义，并证明所有NI-SETO均可通过UFC的全包含或任意子凝聚两种方式实现，且均为UFC的相对中心；通过富集UFC可在3D Walker-Wang模型边界获得手征性例子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出非可逆对称性富集拓扑序（NI-SETO）的定义，并证明所有NI-SETO均可通过UFC的全包含或任意子凝聚两种方式实现，且均为UFC的相对中心；通过富集UFC可在3D Walker-Wang模型边界获得手征性例子。；创新点：首次给出非可逆对称性富集拓扑序（NI-SETO）的严格定义，并系统建立其在弦网模型中的实现方案，同时展示了手征性边界构造。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用幺正融合范畴（UFC）的全包含与任意子凝聚两种构造方法，定义NI-SETO为UFC的相对中心；采用管代数技术计算任意子及对称缺陷上的定性对称性作用。

papers.title: Multiscale Vectorial Determination of Magnetic Order Parameters using Electron Magnetic Linear Dichroism
papers.abstract: We demonstrate electron magnetic linear dichroism as a quantitative probe of vectorial magnetic order parameters with nanometer resolution in transmission electron microscopy. Explicit inclusion of vectorial core-level exchange splitting into mixed dynamic form factor simulations accounting for dynamical diffraction enables direct reconstruction of the magnetic spin axis from momentum-resolved electron energy-loss spectra. The resulting dichroic signal is intrinsically separable from nonmagnetic anisotropy, exhibits a well-defined dependence on the Néel vector or magnetization orientation, and remains robust down to the atomic scale. Applied to the collinear antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic phase of cubic FeRh, this approach allows quantitative real-space mapping of the magnetic vector. These results open a pathway to nanoscale spectroscopy and imaging of antiferromagnets and altermagnets where the generalized approach to electron dichroism provides direct access to different magnetic order parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、transmission electron microscopy、electron energy-loss spectra、quantitative probe）；研究对象：立方相FeRh的共线反铁磁和铁磁相中的磁有序参数（Néel矢量/磁化取向）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子磁线性二色性可作为定量探针，在透射电子显微镜中以纳米级分辨率直接重建磁自旋轴，且该二色信号与磁有序参数（如Néel矢量或磁化方向）具有明确依赖关系，可分离非磁性各向异性，并保持原子尺度鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子磁线性二色性可作为定量探针，在透射电子显微镜中以纳米级分辨率直接重建磁自旋轴，且该二色信号与磁有序参数（如Néel矢量或磁化方向）具有明确依赖关系，可分离非磁性各向异性，并保持原子尺度鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将电子磁线性二色性发展为矢量磁有序参数的定量纳米尺度探针，并证明其可区分反铁磁/铁磁有序，为反铁磁和交变磁体的纳米光谱与成像开辟新途径。
papers.method_zh: 透射电子显微镜（TEM）结合动量分辨电子能量损失谱（EELS），通过将矢量级芯能级交换分裂显式纳入混合动态形状因子模拟（考虑动力学衍射效应），实现磁自旋轴的重建。

papers.title: Avoided Stoner instability at a single ordinary Van Hove point
papers.abstract: When the Fermi surface and the Brillouin zone boundary touch at a Van Hove point, mean-field analysis predicts a ferromagnetic (Stoner) instability at finite $T_{MF}$ for any coupling strength due to the divergent density of states. However, the predicted effect has not been observed experimentally. Several qualitative theoretical proposals have been put forward to explain why the mean-field prediction fails. Based on numerically exact results for the two-dimensional Hubbard model with an ordinary Van Hove singularity, we uncover the mechanisms behind the suppression of the ferromagnetic instability. We employ two diagrammatic Monte Carlo approaches: (i) the four-channel self-consistent approximation and (ii) numerically exact method of combinatorial summation of diagrams with controlled resummation of the truncated expansion. We find that the system avoids the Stoner instability down to temperatures an order of magnitude below $T_{MF}$ due to the combination of the downward renormalization of the effective coupling and the suppression of the density of states by the loss of the quasiparticle residue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：numerically exact results、diagrammatic Monte Carlo approaches、mean-field analysis。；研究对象：二维Hubbard模型中普通Van Hove奇点处的铁磁（Stoner）不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统通过有效耦合的下行重整化以及准粒子权重损失导致的态密度抑制，将Stoner不稳定性抑制到远低于平均场预言的转变温度（低一个数量级）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统通过有效耦合的下行重整化以及准粒子权重损失导致的态密度抑制，将Stoner不稳定性抑制到远低于平均场预言的转变温度（低一个数量级）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 两种图解蒙特卡洛方法：(i) 四通道自洽近似；(ii) 数值精确的组合求和法（对截断展开进行受控重求和）。

papers.title: Absolute measurement of penetration depth of superconducting thin films using microwave stripline resonators
papers.abstract: Superconducting microstrip resonators, which leverage kinetic inductance to probe electrodynamics, are sensitive tools for studying superconducting thin films at microwave frequencies. However, extracting the absolute superconducting penetration depth from these measurements remains challenging. In this work, we present a hybrid method to determine the absolute value of penetration depth over a wide temperature range by combining resonator measurements with finite-element electromagnetic simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics. We demonstrate this approach by extracting the penetration depth of NbN films by fabricating resonators from films of various thicknesses. Furthermore, we extend the technique to materials with lower critical temperatures by employing a flip-film geometry. By placing a sample above a NbN resonator, separated by a thin Mylar dielectric, we create a coupled structure where changes in the sample's penetration depth shift the resonant frequency. This non-destructive method provides a reliable, high-sensitivity platform for characterizing the penetration depth of diverse superconducting thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：measurement、fabricating resonators、finite-element electromagnetic simulations、COMSOL Multiphysics）；研究对象：超导薄膜（具体为NbN薄膜）的穿透深度（penetration depth）的绝对测量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种混合方法，通过结合微波微带谐振器测量与有限元电磁仿真，能够在宽温度范围内绝对测量超导薄膜的穿透深度，并成功应用于不同厚度的NbN薄膜以及通过翻转薄膜结构（flip-film geometry）测量低临界温度材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种混合方法，通过结合微波微带谐振器测量与有限元电磁仿真，能够在宽温度范围内绝对测量超导薄膜的穿透深度，并成功应用于不同厚度的NbN薄膜以及通过翻转薄膜结构（flip-film geometry）测量低临界温度材料。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备不同厚度的NbN薄膜微带谐振器，进行微波谐振测量；理论上使用COMSOL Multiphysics进行有限元电磁仿真，结合实验数据提取穿透深度的绝对值。对于低临界温度材料，采用翻转薄膜结构：将待测样品置于NbN谐振器上方，中间以薄Mylar介质层隔开，通过谐振频率变化反推样品穿透深度。

papers.title: Universal Stability of Ga Split Vacancies across α-, β-, and κ-Ga2O3 Polymorphs: A Machine-Learning Accelerated Study
papers.abstract: Split Ga vacancies are the dominant native acceptor in $β$-$Ga_2O_3$; however, their role in $α$ and $κ$ phases has been largely overlooked or assumed to be unfavorable. A detailed understanding of these defects is critical for tailoring the electrical conductivity and optical properties and optimising $Ga_2O_3$-based devices. In this work, we used machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to accelerate the discovery of non-local defect reconstructions, followed by HSE06 hybrid DFT to accurately quantify defect properties of single vacancy $V_{\text{Ga}}$, split vacancy $V_{\text{Ga}}^{\text{i}}$ and substitutional donors ($\mathrm{Hf_{Ga}}$ and $\mathrm{Si_{Ga}}$) across a wide range of experimentally relevant conditions for the oxygen chemical potential. We find that split vacancies are the ground-state vacancy for all studied polymorphs ($β$, $α$, and $κ$). Split vacancies are more stable than simple vacancies by ~0.75 eV ($β$), ~0.41 eV ($α$), and ~0.14 eV ($κ$). Notably, MLIPs correctly identified the specific split-vacancy ground states and yielded an energetic ordering of symmetry-inequivalent defect configurations in excellent agreement with HSE06 results. While Hf and Si show low formation energy and act as shallow donors, especially under oxygen-poor conditions, their efficiency is limited by split-vacancy compensation. The growth under oxygen-poor conditions is a universal requirement to suppress these defects and achieve high n-type conductivity across the $Ga_2O_3$ polymorph.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用了机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）加速缺陷构型搜索，并结合HSE06混合泛函密度泛函理论（DFT）进行精确计算。；研究对象：Ga₂O₃三种多晶型（α、β、κ）中的镓分裂空位缺陷（split Ga vacancies）以及替代施主杂质（Hf和Si）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分裂空位是α、β、κ三种Ga₂O₃多晶型中能量最低的本征空位缺陷，其稳定性普遍高于简单空位；在贫氧条件下生长是抑制分裂空位补偿、实现高n型电导率的通用条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分裂空位是α、β、κ三种Ga₂O₃多晶型中能量最低的本征空位缺陷，其稳定性普遍高于简单空位；在贫氧条件下生长是抑制分裂空位补偿、实现高n型电导率的通用条件。；创新点：首次系统揭示了分裂空位在α和κ相Ga₂O₃中同样是基态空位缺陷，纠正了此前认为其在非β相中不稳定的假设；并证明了MLIPs能够正确识别分裂空位的基态构型及其能量排序，与HSE06结果高度一致。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）加速非局域缺陷重构的发现，随后采用HSE06混合泛函密度泛函理论（HSE06 hybrid DFT）精确量化单空位、分裂空位及替代施主的缺陷性质。

papers.title: Odd spin symmetry and anisotropy switching in p-wave magnet CeNiAsO
papers.abstract: Odd-parity magnets, complementary to altermagnets, exhibit unique properties such as high efficiency in charge-spin conversion and compatibility with conventional superconductivity, of critical importance in the pursuit of energy-efficient spintronics and topological superconductors for quantum computation. For even-parity d-wave and g-wave altermagnets, the magnetic structure, spin-split band structure and physical properties are currently under intensive study. On the contrary, while hundreds of odd-parity magnets and the promising properties have been predicted in theory, experimental studies are scarce. Specifically, the magnetic structure and transport properties of candidates NiI2 and Ga3Ru4Al12 have been reported, yet the characteristic band structure and particularly the odd-parity spin symmetry remain elusive. Here we demonstrate experimentally the deterministic p-wave spin symmetry and resistance anisotropy switching for the prototype odd-parity magnet, CeNiAsO. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) reveals two cleaved terminations with distinct surface band structure. By compensating the polar surface, we achieve intrinsic bulk band structure, for which the spin splitting can be well described by the p-wave magnetic structure through first-principles calculation. The bulk spin polarization measured by spin-resolved ARPES exhibits symmetry with only one degenerate plane, fingerprint of p-wave magnetism. We further demonstrate giant resistance anisotropy and switching between high-resistance and low-resistance states through modest field-induced domain selection, highlighting its potential for antiferromagnetic spin memory devices. The structural similarity between CeNiAsO and 1111-type Fe-based superconductors stimulates further exploration on the interplay between p-wave magnetism, superconductivity and band topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：ARPES、spin-resolved ARPES、实验演示、电阻各向异性开关）；研究对象：奇宇称p波磁体CeNiAsO的磁结构、自旋对称性及电阻各向异性开关行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实CeNiAsO具有确定的p波自旋对称性（仅有一个退化平面的自旋极化对称性），并实现了通过弱场诱导畴选择实现巨大电阻各向异性与高低阻态切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实CeNiAsO具有确定的p波自旋对称性（仅有一个退化平面的自旋极化对称性），并实现了通过弱场诱导畴选择实现巨大电阻各向异性与高低阻态切换。；创新点：首次通过实验直接观测到奇宇称p波磁体的特征自旋对称性（仅一个退化平面），并演示了其电阻各向异性开关功能，填补了理论预测与实验验证之间的空白。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）探测表面能带结构，通过补偿极性表面获得体相能带；自旋分辨ARPES测量体相自旋极化对称性；第一性原理计算描述p波磁结构下的自旋劈裂；电阻测量展示场致畴选择导致的各向异性开关。

papers.title: Magnetic order, magnons, and crystal fields in van der Waals CeSiI
papers.abstract: We report neutron, X-ray absorption, and resonant X-ray spectroscopy of magnetic excitations in the new heavy-fermion van-der-Waals superconductor CeSiI. We determined effective Hamiltonians and ground states of crystal electric fields and magnons. Isotropic Heisenberg interactions on a quasi two dimensional lattice, including ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor exchange as the dominant interaction, provide an excellent account to the low-energy measured dynamics and stabilize a co-rotating spin cycloid. Our study provides the basis to model CeSiI from first principles, thereby laying the ground for microscopic understanding of heavy-fermion physics, their unconventional superconductivity, and quantum criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：neutron, X-ray absorption, resonant X-ray spectroscopy）；研究对象：新型重费米子范德瓦尔斯超导体CeSiI中的磁有序、磁振子与晶体场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了CeSiI的晶体电场基态和有效哈密顿量，发现准二维晶格上的各向同性海森堡相互作用（以铁磁最近邻交换为主导）能很好地解释低能动力学，并稳定一种共旋自旋摆线结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了CeSiI的晶体电场基态和有效哈密顿量，发现准二维晶格上的各向同性海森堡相互作用（以铁磁最近邻交换为主导）能很好地解释低能动力学，并稳定一种共旋自旋摆线结构。；创新点：首次对重费米子范德瓦尔斯超导体CeSiI的磁有序、磁振子和晶体场进行全面的中子与X射线谱学表征，为从第一性原理建模该材料、理解其重费米子物理、非常规超导及量子临界性提供了微观基础。
papers.method_zh: 中子散射、X射线吸收谱、共振X射线谱（用于测量磁激发）；结合有效哈密顿量建模与晶体场分析。

papers.title: Topological lattice gauge theory enriched by non-invertible symmetry
papers.abstract: We use finite group topological lattice gauge theory, also known as the quantum double model, as a lens to explore a notion of topological order enriched by a non-invertible symmetry. For invertible symmetry enriched topological order, there is an established axiomatisation in terms of a G-crossed braided fusion category. We lay the foundations for a generalisation of this notion. By condensing an arbitrary algebra of charges in a quantum double model, we demonstrate that the category of localised excitations in the resulting theory forms a hypergroup-graded extension of the category of deconfined excitations. For every element in the hypergroup, the associated domain wall acts in a typically non-invertible way on these localised excitations. Both this action and the monoidal structure are compatible with the hypergroup grading. The actual categorical action is encoded in a Hopf monad on the category of localised excitations, and gauging the non-invertible symmetry amounts to computing the category of modules over this Hopf monad. Finally, we outline how this framework naturally extends to theories obtained by condensing algebras in a generic string-net model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：拓扑规范场论、范畴学、Hopf 单子。；研究对象：拓扑序与非可逆对称性之间的相互作用。具体体系为有限群拓扑格点规范场论（量子双模型），并推广至一般的弦网模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在量子双模型中凝聚任意电荷代数，得到的局域激发范畴构成了退禁闭激发范畴的一个超群分次扩张。该超群中的每个元素对应的畴壁以非可逆的方式作用于局域激发，且这种作用与超群分次相容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在量子双模型中凝聚任意电荷代数，得到的局域激发范畴构成了退禁闭激发范畴的一个超群分次扩张。该超群中的每个元素对应的畴壁以非可逆的方式作用于局域激发，且这种作用与超群分次相容。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作为将非可逆对称性富集的拓扑序这一概念进行公理化推广奠定了基础，并展示了如何通过凝聚过程在格点模型中实现这一推广。
papers.method_zh: 采用范畴学与代数方法。具体而言，利用电荷凝聚构造，将非可逆对称性引入拓扑序，并通过Hopf单子对局域激发范畴上的非可逆作用进行编码。通过计算该Hopf单子的模范畴来实现非可逆对称性的规范。

papers.title: Determinants of Phase-Separation Propensities, Material States, and Material Properties of Biomolecular Condensates
papers.abstract: Phase separation of various materials has been studied for one and a half centuries. In the last two decades, phase separation of proteins and nucleic acids has received enormous attention, due its relevance to cellular functions. However, many of the observations on the resulting biomolecular condensates lack a theoretical underpinning. The first goal of this Account is to put forward theoretical frameworks for the phase-separation propensities, material states, and material properties of biomolecular condensates. Using these frameworks, I rationalize mechanistic interpretations from our recent experimental and computational studies, and synthesize these studies with prior literature to draw new conclusions. For phase-separation propensities, I relate the threshold (or saturation) concentration to the excess chemical potential in the dense phase, which in turn depends on intermolecular interaction strength and valency. For material states, I posit that liquid droplets form via complete phase separation, whereas amorphous dense liquids, reversible aggregates, and gels arise from premature termination of spinodal decomposition, due to overly weak or overly strong interactions or directional interactions. In particular, gels and aggregates are different forms of dynamically arrested states, with gels driven by tip growth via directional interactions whereas aggregates driven by monomer addition at interior sites to maximize valency. For material properties, I highlight the crucial roles of the stress relaxation time, which is determined by the mean lifetime of intermolecular bonds in a condensate. This relaxation time dictates how the condensate manifests viscoelasticity, including shear thickening and shear thinning, and accounts for the wide variation in zero-shear viscosity among different condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验与计算研究的综合评述）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“put forward theoretical frameworks”“rationalize mechanistic interpretations from our recent experimental and computational studies”。；研究对象：生物分子凝聚体（biomolecular condensates）的相分离倾向、材料状态（液态、凝胶、聚集体等）及材料性质（如粘弹性）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相分离的阈值浓度由稠密相中的过量化学势决定，而该化学势依赖于分子间相互作用强度与价数；材料状态（液滴、非晶态稠密液体、可逆聚集体、凝胶）由旋节线分解是否提前终止决定，其中凝胶与聚集体是不同形式的动力学阻滞态；材料性质（如零剪切粘度、剪切增稠/剪切稀化）由应力松弛时间（即分子间键的平均寿命）主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相分离的阈值浓度由稠密相中的过量化学势决定，而该化学势依赖于分子间相互作用强度与价数；材料状态（液滴、非晶态稠密液体、可逆聚集体、凝胶）由旋节线分解是否提前终止决定，其中凝胶与聚集体是不同形式的动力学阻滞态；材料性质（如零剪切粘度、剪切增稠/剪切稀化）由应力松弛时间（即分子间键的平均寿命）主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建（基于过量化学势、旋节线分解、动力学阻滞等概念），并结合作者团队近期实验与计算研究结果及文献综合分析。

papers.title: Geometric Origin of Macroscopic Alignment in Granular Flows
papers.abstract: Predicting the alignment of non-spherical particles in dense granular flows under shear remains a central challenge in soft matter physics. We demonstrate that the first-order behavior of granular fabric,the anisotropic distribution of contacts, is a direct consequence of particle boundary geometry. By assuming uniform contact probability along a particle's perimeter, we derive a mapping between local curvature and the macroscopic distribution of contact normals. This minimal geometric framework accurately predicts the uniaxial nematic order parameter S2 observed in both three-dimensional discrete element simulations and laboratory experiments using various particle geometries (e.g., rice, fibers, and disks) across a wide range of aspect ratios. Our results show that particle shape dictates the available orientation statistics, providing a purely geometric baseline for the emergence of fabric in dense granular systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：demonstrate、derive a mapping、geometric framework、predicts）；研究对象：非球形颗粒在剪切作用下致密颗粒流中的宏观取向排列现象，具体涉及颗粒织物（granular fabric）的各向异性分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒接触法向的宏观分布（即颗粒织物的单轴取向序参数S2）可由颗粒边界几何形状（局部曲率）直接决定，无需依赖复杂的力学或摩擦模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒接触法向的宏观分布（即颗粒织物的单轴取向序参数S2）可由颗粒边界几何形状（局部曲率）直接决定，无需依赖复杂的力学或摩擦模型。；创新点：提出了一个纯几何框架，将颗粒形状的局部曲率作为颗粒织物各向异性的唯一起源，为致密颗粒系统中取向序的出现提供了无需力学参数的基线解释。
papers.method_zh: 基于均匀接触概率假设，推导出颗粒边界局部曲率与接触法向宏观分布之间的映射关系，并通过三维离散元模拟（DEM）和实验室实验（使用米粒、纤维、圆盘等不同几何形状颗粒）进行验证。

papers.title: Photon correlation microscopy of quantum matter
papers.abstract: Light and matter share fundamental statistical properties, yet the experimental probes of quantum optics and many-body physics have largely evolved along separate trajectories. While many-body physics explores emergent collective phenomena, quantum optics has refined the measurement of correlations between individual photons. Here, we introduce photon correlation microscopy (PCM) - which bridges the two domains by leveraging correlations of emitted light to probe the correlations in quantum matter at mesoscopic scales. We demonstrate this approach using a one-dimensional (1D) ensemble of dipolar excitons confined at a lateral monolayer MoSe$_2$-WSe$_2$ heterojunction. We use gate-defined potentials to confine the 1D excitons to a mesoscopic lengthscale to enhance the visibility of matter correlations in the emitted photon field. Power-dependent spectroscopy reveals a transition from a compressible to an incompressible phase, signaled by the simultaneous saturation of the emission intensity and energy blueshift, which is supported by numerical simulations. Through this crossover, photon correlation measurements show a striking evolution from bunching at low densities to antibunching at high densities. This constitutes a many-body blockade of photon emission emerging directly from a number-stabilized state, driven by collective dipolar repulsion. Our results establish PCM as a powerful probe of many-body physics through the lens of quantum optics, extensible to a broad class of correlated electronic phases, while pointing toward a route to generating non-classical light through many-body correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、power-dependent spectroscopy、photon correlation measurements、supported by numerical simulations）；研究对象：一维偶极激子体系，具体为横向单层MoSe₂-WSe₂异质结中通过门电压势垒约束的激子，以及其从可压缩相到不可压缩相的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过光子关联测量，观察到从低密度下的光子聚束到高密度下的反聚束的显著演化，揭示了由集体偶极排斥驱动的数稳定化态所导致的多体光子发射阻塞效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过光子关联测量，观察到从低密度下的光子聚束到高密度下的反聚束的显著演化，揭示了由集体偶极排斥驱动的数稳定化态所导致的多体光子发射阻塞效应。；创新点：将量子光学中的光子关联测量方法引入多体物理研究，通过探测发射光子的统计性质来直接揭示量子物质中的多体关联，并展示了利用多体关联产生非经典光的途径。
papers.method_zh: 光子关联显微术（PCM），结合门电压定义势垒实现一维激子的介观尺度约束，以及功率依赖的光谱学测量（发射强度与能量蓝移的饱和行为），并辅以数值模拟支持。

papers.title: Ultrafast dynamics of excitons in black phosphorus
papers.abstract: Excitons are key quasiparticles determining the optical properties of solids. As such, they can be utilized to coherently control the electronic structure of materials using optical femtosecond pulses. Identifying the decoherence mechanism during the early non-equilibrium dynamics is crucial to achieve light-induced band-structure engineering in semiconductors. Here, we generate excitons in the direct band gap semiconductor black phosphorus with a resonant mid-infrared photoexcitation. Using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we track their complex ultrafast dynamics on the few-picosecond time scale. We develop a quantum-kinetic theoretical framework to model the decoherence of excitons into dark excitons via phonon scattering. By combining simulation and experiment, we quantify key parameters describing the early dynamics of the excitons. Our work highlights phonon-mediated intravalley scattering as a fundamental limitation for coherent exciton phenomena in single-valley semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论）。判断依据：实验上使用时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES），理论上发展量子动力学框架模拟激子退相干过程。；研究对象：直接带隙半导体黑磷（black phosphorus）中的激子超快动力学，特别是激子通过声子散射退相干为暗激子的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 声子介导的谷内散射是单谷半导体中实现相干激子现象的根本限制因素；通过实验与理论结合，定量提取了激子早期动力学中的关键参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：声子介导的谷内散射是单谷半导体中实现相干激子现象的根本限制因素；通过实验与理论结合，定量提取了激子早期动力学中的关键参数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES），利用共振中红外光激发产生激子。理论框架：量子动力学（quantum-kinetic theoretical framework）模拟激子通过声子散射退相干为暗激子的过程。

papers.title: Fractional short-time dynamics in driven quantum gases
papers.abstract: Quantum gases with short-range attractive interaction have a tendency to form pairs. For time-dependent interaction we find that the pairing amplitude at small separation satisfies a fractional differential equation (FDE). We derive analytic solutions of the pairing evolution for sudden interaction quenches and power-law drives toward resonant scattering. We observe universal short-time dynamics governed by a conformal fixed point at which the momentum distribution exhibits nonthermal, self-similar scaling in time, in quantitative agreement with experiment. At longer times, many-body effects induce relaxation toward an equilibrium state. In this limit, the FDE turns into a Müller-Israel-Stewart type equation that describes a hydrodynamic attractor approaching equilibrium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“推导解析解”、“发现满足分数阶微分方程”、“理论框架”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有短程吸引相互作用的量子气体，特别是随时间变化的驱动下配对振幅的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短时间尺度下，量子气体中配对振幅的演化满足分数阶微分方程，并表现出由共形不动点控制的普适动力学，其动量分布呈现非热、自相似的时间标度行为，与实验定量一致；长时间尺度下，该方程退化为描述流体力学吸引子趋近平衡的Müller-Israel-Stewart型方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短时间尺度下，量子气体中配对振幅的演化满足分数阶微分方程，并表现出由共形不动点控制的普适动力学，其动量分布呈现非热、自相似的时间标度行为，与实验定量一致；长时间尺度下，该方程退化为描述流体力学吸引子趋近平衡的Müller-Israel-Stewart型方程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：推导了相互作用突然淬灭和幂律驱动至共振散射情形下配对演化的解析解；通过共形场论不动点分析短时动力学标度行为；利用分数阶微分方程与相对论流体力学方程的对应关系描述长时弛豫。

papers.title: Thermodynamic properties of chemically disordered compounds via AI-driven estimation of partition function with the PULSE method
papers.abstract: In this article, we present an improved version of the PULSE method (Partition function Unsupervised Learning Sampling and Evaluation) for estimating the thermodynamic properties of chemically disordered compounds. The aim is to reduce the computational cost of Monte Carlo approaches for this type of material and to demonstrate that this generative tool can estimate thermodynamic properties by sampling and estimating the partition function of the system. To validate this innovative approach, we use the 2D Ising model as a benchmark. We demonstrate that our method accurately reproduces average properties with high precision and efficiency compared to traditional Monte Carlo sampling methods. Our results highlight the efficiency and adaptability of the PULSE method, making it a valuable tool for studying materials for which conventional methods are too inefficient to compute properties affected by chemical disorder at low cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“Monte Carlo approaches”、“generative tool”、“sampling and estimating the partition function”、“2D Ising model as a benchmark”。；研究对象：化学无序化合物的热力学性质，具体以二维伊辛模型作为基准体系进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 改进后的PULSE方法能够以高精度和高效性重现化学无序化合物的平均热力学性质，其性能优于传统蒙特卡洛采样方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：改进后的PULSE方法能够以高精度和高效性重现化学无序化合物的平均热力学性质，其性能优于传统蒙特卡洛采样方法。；创新点：提出了一种降低蒙特卡洛方法计算成本的生成式工具，能够通过无监督学习高效采样并估计化学无序系统的配分函数，从而以低成本计算传统方法难以处理的化学无序效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用改进的PULSE方法（配分函数无监督学习采样与评估），这是一种基于生成式人工智能的配分函数估计与采样技术，并以传统蒙特卡洛方法作为对比基准。

papers.title: Third rank permeability in chiral solids
papers.abstract: Effects of a third rank permeability term in chiral solids are studied. Fluid flow through such materials acquires vorticity upon emergence from the material. Materials of interest include chiral surface lattices such as the gyroid, chiral rib lattices, and granular materials comprised of sugar crystals, quartz sand, wheat or beans. A characteristic length scale is associated with the chirality. The length scale can be obtained by several methods. Contacts with nonlocal permeability, elasticity and piezoelectricity are explored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Effects are studied（效应研究）、explored（探索）、nonlocal permeability（非局域渗透率）等理论概念。；研究对象：手性固体中的三阶渗透率张量效应，具体涉及手性表面晶格（如螺旋面）、手性肋状晶格，以及由糖晶体、石英砂、小麦或豆类组成的颗粒材料中的流体流动现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 流体通过手性固体材料后，会获得涡度（vorticity）。手性特征与一个特征长度尺度相关联，该尺度可通过多种方法获得。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：流体通过手性固体材料后，会获得涡度（vorticity）。手性特征与一个特征长度尺度相关联，该尺度可通过多种方法获得。；创新点：首次系统研究了手性固体中三阶渗透率张量项带来的物理效应，特别是流体流出材料后产生涡度的现象，并建立了与特征长度尺度的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。通过建立三阶渗透率张量模型，研究手性固体中的流体动力学行为，并探讨了与非局域渗透率、弹性力学和压电效应的联系。

papers.title: Electron-beam induced methane decomposition for in-situ carbon doping of hexagonal boron nitride
papers.abstract: Controlling the spatial incorporation of carbon into hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is essential for engineering optically active defects, yet existing approaches lack nanoscale precision and control over the carbon supply. Here, we demonstrate a method for carbon doping of hBN using electron-beam irradiation in a low-pressure methane atmosphere, where the beam simultaneously generates vacancies and decomposes methane into individual carbon and hydrogen atoms. Using annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy, we show that increasing the methane partial pressure suppresses pore growth and drives the formation of triangular boron-terminated pores through preferential hydrogen etching of nitrogen. Time-resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) mapping reveals progressive carbon incorporation into the lattice, accompanied by boron and nitrogen depletion. Carbon clustering occurs predominantly within the irradiated area: 84+-7% of carbon-rich regions are confined to the area exposed to the electron beam, while some carbon atoms are also found to diffuse up to an average distance of 4.7+-0.5 nm beyond it. The incorporated carbon atoms arrange in a hexagonal pattern within the lattice, forming patches that do not exceed ~1 nm in size. Analysis of the EELS fine structure indicates modifications to the local electronic environment within these regions, with implications for the optical properties of the resulting carbon-related defects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：electron-beam irradiation、scanning transmission electron microscopy、electron energy-loss spectroscopy。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中碳掺杂的纳米级空间控制，具体为通过电子束诱导甲烷分解实现原位碳掺杂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低压甲烷气氛下，电子束辐照可同时产生空位并分解甲烷，实现碳原子在hBN晶格中的原位掺杂，碳原子主要局限于辐照区域（84±7%），并形成尺寸不超过~1 nm的六方排列碳团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低压甲烷气氛下，电子束辐照可同时产生空位并分解甲烷，实现碳原子在hBN晶格中的原位掺杂，碳原子主要局限于辐照区域（84±7%），并形成尺寸不超过~1 nm的六方排列碳团簇。；创新点：首次利用电子束在低压甲烷气氛中同时实现hBN中空位产生与碳源分解，实现了碳掺杂的纳米级空间精度控制，并定量表征了碳原子的局域分布与扩散距离（平均4.7±0.5 nm）。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段包括：环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜（ADF-STEM）用于观察孔隙形貌；时间分辨电子能量损失谱（EELS）用于追踪碳掺入过程及局域电子环境变化；通过改变甲烷分压调控孔隙生长与氢刻蚀效应。

papers.title: Anisotropic magnetism and Kondo-lattice behavior in the frustrated antiferromagnet Ce3MgBi5
papers.abstract: We report the synthesis and physical characterization of single-crystalline Ce3MgBi5, a previously unexplored member of the Ce3MPn5 family. This compound crystallizes in the hexagonal P63/mcm structure, featuring an anisotropic Ce sublattice composed of zig-zag chains along the c axis and a distorted kagome-like network in the basal plane. Magnetization measurements reveal antiferromagnetic order below TN approximately 4.2 K, accompanied by strong magnetic anisotropy and multiple field-induced metamagnetic transitions for fields applied perpendicular to [001], leading to a dome-shaped H-T phase diagram. Electrical transport exhibits characteristic signatures of a Ce-based Kondo lattice, including broad resistivity maxima and pronounced field-dependent anomalies in the magnetoresistance and Hall response that track the magnetic phase boundaries. Specific-heat measurements confirm the magnetic transition and show that the full R ln 2 entropy expected for a Ce3+ Kramers doublet is recovered by 20 K, indicating an extended temperature range of magnetic fluctuations consistent with Kondo correlations. Our results establish Ce3MgBi5 as a platform within the Ce3MPn5 family for exploring the interplay of geometric frustration, magnetic anisotropy, and Kondo-lattice physics under applied magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“合成”、“物理表征”、“磁化测量”、“电输运”、“比热测量”。；研究对象：新型化合物Ce3MgBi5单晶，属于Ce3MPn5家族。具体研究其晶体结构、磁性（反铁磁序、磁各向异性、变磁转变）以及Kondo晶格行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ce3MgBi5在约4.2 K以下进入反铁磁有序态，表现出强磁各向异性和多个场致变磁转变，同时其电输运和热力学性质显示出Ce基Kondo晶格的特征，为研究几何阻挫、磁各向异性和Kondo晶格物理的相互作用提供了新平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ce3MgBi5在约4.2 K以下进入反铁磁有序态，表现出强磁各向异性和多个场致变磁转变，同时其电输运和热力学性质显示出Ce基Kondo晶格的特征，为研究几何阻挫、磁各向异性和Kondo晶格物理的相互作用提供了新平台。；创新点：首次合成了Ce3MgBi5单晶并对其物理性质进行了系统表征，揭示了该化合物中同时存在的几何阻挫（由畸变的kagome-like网络和zig-zag链引起）、强磁各向异性与Kondo晶格行为的复杂关联。摘要未突出说明与同家族其他化合物的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成、磁化率与磁化强度测量、电输运（电阻率、磁电阻、霍尔效应）测量、比热测量。通过分析这些测量结果构建了H-T相图，并提取了熵变等热力学信息。

papers.title: Electrically driven Rabi dynamics of magnetic-field-induced corner states in a two-dimensional topological insulator
papers.abstract: We study coherent electric manipulation of magnetic-field-induced localized states at a double kink of a helical edge in a HgTe/CdHgTe quantum well. An in-plane magnetic field opens a gap in the one-dimensional edge spectrum, while changes in the edge orientation generate localized in-gap states at the kinks. We show that, for suitable geometry and magnetic-field direction, two such states form an effective lithographically defined two-level subsystem. Using an edge-state model that includes both the localized levels and the continuum states outside the magnetic-field-induced gap, we calculate the electric-dipole matrix elements and solve the time-dependent problem under resonant driving. The resulting dynamics exhibits Rabi oscillations with linear frequencies of $20$--$40$~GHz for realistic parameters. We find that the continuum states provide a leakage channel whose strength is strongly controlled by the driving amplitude: reducing the electric field suppresses leakage below the percent level while preserving GHz-scale coherent oscillations. These results establish a route from magnetic-field-induced corner-state physics to electrically driven two-level dynamics in a realistic two-dimensional topological-insulator edge geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“edge-state model”“calculate”“solve the time-dependent problem”等理论建模与计算关键词，未提及实验数据或实验手段。；研究对象：HgTe/CdHgTe量子阱中螺旋边缘态的双扭结处，由面内磁场诱导的局域态及其电驱动拉比动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在合适的几何结构和磁场方向下，两个磁场诱导的局域态可构成一个有效二能级子系统，在共振电驱动下可实现20–40 GHz的拉比振荡；连续态提供了泄漏通道，其强度可通过降低驱动电场抑制到1%以下，同时保持GHz量级的相干振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在合适的几何结构和磁场方向下，两个磁场诱导的局域态可构成一个有效二能级子系统，在共振电驱动下可实现20–40 GHz的拉比振荡；连续态提供了泄漏通道，其强度可通过降低驱动电场抑制到1%以下，同时保持GHz量级的相干振荡。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于边缘态模型，同时包含局域能级和磁场诱导能隙外的连续态；计算电偶极矩阵元，并求解共振驱动下的含时问题。

papers.title: Wetting of quantum fluids: a route to free-standing shell-shaped quantum droplets
papers.abstract: We investigate wetting phenomena between self-bound quantum fluids in a three-component Bose mixture of $^{23}$Na, $^{39}$K, and $^{41}$K atoms. Within a density-functional approach including mean-field interactions and Lee-Huang-Yang quantum-fluctuation corrections, we consider two binary quantum liquids, formed by components $(1,2)$ and $(2,3)$, and study the adsorption of the softer $(1,2)$ liquid on a stiffer $(2,3)$ substrate. By tuning the interspecies scattering length $a_{12}$, we show that the surface tension of the $(1,2)$ liquid can be strongly varied, driving a transition from partial wetting to complete wetting of the $(2,3)$ phase. The contact angle extracted from cylindrical-cap geometries decreases continuously with increasing $a_{12}$ and vanishes near a critical value $a_{12}^{c}= -42\,a_0$. In the complete-wetting regime, a finite amount of $(1,2)$ liquid wraps around a spherical $(2,3)$ droplet, producing a self-bound core-shell droplet without external confinement, whose component-1 density has a shell-like, hollow projection. We further show that such shell-shaped quantum droplets can sustain quantized vortical excitations. These results identify wetting as a route to engineering free-standing shell-shaped quantum liquids and suggest new possibilities for studying capillarity, topology, and superfluidity in multicomponent quantum droplets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：density-functional approach、理论计算、数值模拟）；研究对象：三组分玻色混合物（²³Na、³⁹K、⁴¹K）中自束缚量子流体的浸润现象，以及由此形成的自由站立壳状量子液滴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节组分间散射长度a₁₂，可驱动软量子液体（1,2）在硬基底（2,3）上从部分浸润到完全浸润的转变；在完全浸润区，软液体会包裹硬液滴形成自束缚的核-壳结构量子液滴，且该壳状液滴可支持量子化涡旋激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节组分间散射长度a₁₂，可驱动软量子液体（1,2）在硬基底（2,3）上从部分浸润到完全浸润的转变；在完全浸润区，软液体会包裹硬液滴形成自束缚的核-壳结构量子液滴，且该壳状液滴可支持量子化涡旋激发。；创新点：首次提出利用浸润现象作为工程化制备自由站立壳状量子液滴的途径，并展示了这种多组分量子液滴中拓扑激发（量子化涡旋）的存在可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用包含平均场相互作用和Lee-Huang-Yang量子涨落修正的密度泛函方法，计算了两种二元量子液体的表面张力、接触角（通过圆柱帽几何提取），并模拟了球形核-壳液滴的密度分布与涡旋激发。

papers.title: Substrate-driven topological engineering in plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chains
papers.abstract: We demonstrate the possibility of engineering the topological band structure of a plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain through the interaction with its electromagnetic environment. We find that the long-range interaction of the in-plane modes of the SSH chain with the surface plasmon polaritons of a planar substrate introduces a band hybridization connected to a change of the Zak phase. On the other hand, the short-range interaction with the substrate introduces a band touching, again with a change in the Zak phase. Surprisingly, this second mechanism enables the emergence of topologically protected edge modes for parameters which correspond to the topologically trivial phase for an isolated plasmonic SSH chain. We study these mechanisms by changing the chain-substrate distance and the dimerization parameter. Finally, we discuss the robustness against disorder and, as one example, the impact of the observed effects on the near-field radiative heat transfer along the chain. Our findings pave the way to the engineering of edge modes in plasmonic topological configurations via the coupling to a plasmonic environment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrate the possibility”、“study these mechanisms by changing...”等表述，未提及具体实验手段，主要基于理论分析和数值计算。；研究对象：等离激元Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，具体研究其与平面衬底（电磁环境）相互作用下的拓扑能带结构工程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过SSH链与衬底表面等离激元的相互作用，可实现两种拓扑相变机制：长程相互作用导致能带杂化并改变Zak相位，短程相互作用导致能带接触并改变Zak相位。后者可使原本拓扑平庸的孤立SSH链参数区域出现拓扑保护的边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过SSH链与衬底表面等离激元的相互作用，可实现两种拓扑相变机制：长程相互作用导致能带杂化并改变Zak相位，短程相互作用导致能带接触并改变Zak相位。后者可使原本拓扑平庸的孤立SSH链参数区域出现拓扑保护的边缘态。；创新点：首次提出通过耦合等离激元环境（衬底）来工程化等离激元SSH链的拓扑相，特别是发现短程相互作用可在拓扑平庸参数区诱导拓扑边缘态，为等离激元拓扑结构的边缘态调控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 通过改变链-衬底距离和二聚化参数，系统研究长程（面内模式与衬底表面等离激元耦合）和短程（与衬底直接相互作用）两种耦合机制对拓扑能带结构的影响。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如紧束缚模型、有限元模拟等）。

papers.title: The Resetting Heat Engine: A Thermodynamic Cycle of Thermal Expansion and Compression
papers.abstract: We consider a Brownian particle confined by an external potential and subject to stochastic resetting to the origin. Motivated by the repetitive nature of the dynamics, we describe the process as a thermodynamic cycle of thermal expansion and collapse, analyzed via a framework based on the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between forward and reversed trajectory ensembles. While the entropy production generally depends on the full trajectory ensemble and cannot be reduced to thermodynamic state variables alone, we show that the harmonic potential constitute a special case, where the entropy production reduces exactly to a state-function-like expression determined solely by the distributions before and after resetting. Explicit analytical results are derived for periodic and Poissonian resetting. At low resetting rates $r$, the entropy production rate grows linearly with $r$ and is proportional to the symmetric KL divergence between the reset and equilibrium distributions. At very high rates, the resetting process becomes effectively perpetual and the entropy production vanishes. Langevin simulations for an anharmonic quartic potential display the same generic behavior, indicating that these features are not restricted to harmonic confinement. Our results establish a direct connection between stochastic resetting, thermodynamic cycles, and information-theoretic measures of irreversibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analyzed via a framework based on the Kullback-Leibler divergence”、“analytical results are derived”、“Langevin simulations”，以理论推导和数值模拟为主，无实验数据。；研究对象：受随机重置（stochastic resetting）到原点约束的布朗粒子系统，具体研究其作为热力学循环（热膨胀与压缩循环）的热力学性质，包括谐振子势和四次非谐振势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在谐振子势的特殊情况下，熵产生可简化为仅由重置前后分布决定的状态函数形式；在低重置率下熵产生率与重置率线性相关，并正比于重置分布与平衡分布之间的对称KL散度，而在极高重置率下熵产生消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在谐振子势的特殊情况下，熵产生可简化为仅由重置前后分布决定的状态函数形式；在低重置率下熵产生率与重置率线性相关，并正比于重置分布与平衡分布之间的对称KL散度，而在极高重置率下熵产生消失。；创新点：建立了随机重置过程、热力学循环与不可逆性信息论度量之间的直接联系，并发现谐振子势下熵产生可精确简化为状态函数形式，这一特性在非谐振势中仍表现出类似行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于正向与反向轨迹系综之间的Kullback-Leibler散度（KL散度）理论框架，推导周期性重置和泊松重置下的解析结果，并辅以Langevin动力学模拟验证非谐振势（四次势）下的行为。

papers.title: Symmetry-Selective Topological Magnon Engineering by Phonon Angular Momentum
papers.abstract: Dynamical control of Berry curvature remains an outstanding challenge in the engineering of topological phases. Here, we demonstrate control of magnon band structures via coherently driven phonons, based on \textit{ab initio} spin-lattice coupling and Floquet theory. We show that this control is symmetry selective: linearly polarized phonons leave the spectrum unchanged, whereas circular and elliptical phonons carrying finite phonon angular momentum (PAM) induce chiral interactions that open and tune gaps at Dirac points, generating and reversing topological magnon phases. The gap magnitude and Chern numbers are directly governed by the PAM, enabling handedness-selective topology control. Applied to monolayer CrI$_3$, and supported by symmetry analysis, our results establish driven lattice dynamics as a general route to engineering topological bosonic excitations and a versatile platform for Floquet control of magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Floquet theory、ab initio spin-lattice coupling、symmetry analysis）；研究对象：单层CrI₃中由声子角动量驱动的拓扑磁振子能带工程
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振或椭圆偏振声子可以诱导手性相互作用，在狄拉克点打开并调控能隙，从而产生和反转拓扑磁振子相；能隙大小和陈数直接由声子角动量决定，实现手性选择性拓扑控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振或椭圆偏振声子可以诱导手性相互作用，在狄拉克点打开并调控能隙，从而产生和反转拓扑磁振子相；能隙大小和陈数直接由声子角动量决定，实现手性选择性拓扑控制。；创新点：揭示了声子角动量对拓扑磁振子能带的对称选择性调控机制（线偏振声子无效，圆/椭圆偏振声子有效），并建立了通过相干驱动晶格动力学工程化拓扑玻色子激发的普适路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的自旋-晶格耦合计算与Floquet理论分析，结合对称性分析。

papers.title: Can MACE Potentials Accurately Describe Magnetism and Phase Stability in Fe-Ni Alloys? A Systematic Benchmark
papers.abstract: We present a systematic benchmark of MACE potentials for iron-nickel alloys, focusing on structural, elastic, magnetic, and finite-temperature properties relevant to phase stability. The reference dataset comprises spin-polarized PBE density functional theory (DFT) calculations for chemically disordered special quasirandom structures (SQS), spanning compositions, bcc and fcc crystal structures, and volumetric and shear deformations. A system-specific MACE-sqs model trained on this dataset achieves validation errors of 2.0 meV/atom for energies and 24.3 meV/Angstrom for forces. Compared with several MACE foundation models, including models trained with Hubbard U corrections, MACE-sqs gives the most consistent agreement with DFT and experiment for equations of state, equilibrium volumes, elastic constants, and thermal expansion trends in bcc and fcc Fe-Ni alloys. For the bcc-to-hcp transition, MACE-sqs predicts a pure-Fe transition pressure closer to experiment than the tested foundation models, but all models predict an incorrect increase of transition pressure with Ni content. This failure indicates that high-pressure magnetic collapse and composition-dependent magnetoelastic effects are not yet fully captured. Overall, targeted SQS-based training substantially improves the accuracy of MACE potentials for Fe-Ni alloys, while phase stability under magnetic collapse remains a key limitation for future model development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“spin-polarized PBE density functional theory (DFT) calculations”、“MACE potentials”等第一性原理计算和机器学习势函数方法。；研究对象：铁镍（Fe-Ni）合金。具体研究其结构、弹性、磁性和有限温度性质，以及这些性质如何影响相稳定性（特别是bcc、fcc和hcp相之间的转变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 针对Fe-Ni合金专门训练的MACE-sqs模型在描述状态方程、平衡体积、弹性常数和热膨胀趋势方面，与DFT和实验符合得最好。然而，所有测试的MACE模型都无法正确预测bcc到hcp相变压力随Ni含量的变化趋势，表明模型尚不能完全捕捉高压下的磁塌缩和成分依赖的磁弹效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：针对Fe-Ni合金专门训练的MACE-sqs模型在描述状态方程、平衡体积、弹性常数和热膨胀趋势方面，与DFT和实验符合得最好。然而，所有测试的MACE模型都无法正确预测bcc到hcp相变压力随Ni含量的变化趋势，表明模型尚不能完全捕捉高压下的磁塌缩和成分依赖的磁弹效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断，其创新点在于：1）系统性地评估了MACE势函数在描述Fe-Ni合金磁性及相稳定性方面的能力；2）通过针对SQS结构进行专门训练，显著提升了MACE势函数在该特定合金体系上的精度；3）明确指出了当前MACE模型在描述高压磁塌缩效应上的根本性局限。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于自旋极化PBE泛函的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，为化学无序的特殊准随机结构（SQS）生成参考数据集。在此基础上，训练了一个系统特定的MACE-sqs机器学习原子间势模型，并与多个MACE基础模型（包括使用Hubbard U校正训练的模型）进行系统对比。

papers.title: Global magnetic phase diagram and multiple unconventional magnets in NiAs-type compounds
papers.abstract: NiAs-type compounds such as CrSb and MnTe host $g$-wave altermagnet (AM) state. In order to search other possible unconventional magnets in this system, we present a global magnetic phase diagram based on a classical $J_1$-$J_2$-$J_3$ Heisenberg model and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. We find another $g$-wave AM state and two $f$-wave OPMs in the phase diagram. Intriguingly, we show that a mixed-parity of the $f$-wave OPM and $g$-wave AM state can naturally emerge in an umbrella-like noncollinear magnetic structure. Our DFT calculations show that CrSe and CrTe$_{1-x}$Se$_x$ are generally in such mixing state with dominated $f$-wave component. The interlayer next-nearest-neighbor coupling $J_3$ is shown to be crucial in determining the phase diagram and in inducing strong competition between conventional and unconventional magnets. Inspired by this, we demonstrate that AM or OPM could be realized by applying chemical doping or strain to conventional magnets. Our results provide a guidance for design of both even- and odd-parity as well as mixed-parity unconventional magnets in NiAs-type compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算与第一性原理计算混合类型。判断依据：基于经典Heisenberg模型和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：NiAs型化合物（如CrSb、MnTe、CrSe、CrTe₁₋ₓSeₓ）中的非常规磁性态，包括g波交变磁体（AM）和f波奇宇称磁体（OPM），以及混合宇称非共线磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NiAs型化合物的全局磁相图中，除了已知的g波AM态外，还发现另一个g波AM态和两个f波OPM态；f波OPM与g波AM的混合宇称态可自然出现在伞状非共线磁结构中，且层间次近邻耦合J₃对相图及非常规磁态的竞争起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NiAs型化合物的全局磁相图中，除了已知的g波AM态外，还发现另一个g波AM态和两个f波OPM态；f波OPM与g波AM的混合宇称态可自然出现在伞状非共线磁结构中，且层间次近邻耦合J₃对相图及非常规磁态的竞争起关键作用。；创新点：首次在NiAs型化合物中系统预测了f波奇宇称磁体（OPM）以及f波与g波混合宇称的非共线磁结构，并指出通过化学掺杂或应变可将常规磁体调控为交变磁体或奇宇称磁体。
papers.method_zh: 经典J₁-J₂-J₃ Heisenberg模型构建全局磁相图；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算验证具体材料（CrSe、CrTe₁₋ₓSeₓ）的磁态。

papers.title: Order by inertia in spinning active matter: holey fluids and spin-textured crystals
papers.abstract: Active matter sustains emergent flows at the expense of preserving structural order. The feedback between structure and viscous flows typically disrupts crystalline and liquid-crystalline organization by amplifying the very deformations they generate. Yet this destabilizing paradigm has recently been challenged by experiments showing that inertial fluid flows can stabilize few-body bound states of active spinners. Whether inertial active matter can sustain genuine cohesion and order at the many-body level, however, remains elusive. Here we investigate two-dimensional assemblies of macroscopic spinners operating at high Reynolds number and uncover two phase transitions leading to the emergence of a dilute percolating fluid and a dense spin-textured crystal. At low density, inertial flows generate two competing interactions: anisotropic attractions and transverse Magnus forces that continuously break and reconfigure bonds. Together they drive a percolation transition toward a dynamically rearranging holey liquid reminiscent of the empty-liquid states observed in equilibrium patchy colloids. At high density, the feedback between spin alignment and particle positions suppresses transverse rearrangements and yields a first-order transition toward a spin-ordered crystal. Our results demonstrate that, beyond the overdamped limit, hydrodynamic feedback can promote rather than destroy collective order, revealing a distinct regime of many-body active matter governed by inertial flows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、uncover、demonstrate，基于理论建模与分析，无实验或计算细节描述）；研究对象：高雷诺数下二维宏观自旋体（active spinners）组装体的惯性主动物质体系，具体研究其多体凝聚与有序相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 惯性主动物质中可涌现两种新相：稀薄渗透流体（holey fluid）和自旋织构晶体（spin-textured crystal），证明惯性流体反馈能促进而非破坏多体有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：惯性主动物质中可涌现两种新相：稀薄渗透流体（holey fluid）和自旋织构晶体（spin-textured crystal），证明惯性流体反馈能促进而非破坏多体有序。；创新点：首次揭示惯性主动物质在高雷诺数下能维持多体凝聚与结构有序，突破传统认为主动物质中结构-流动反馈必然破坏有序的范式，并发现类似平衡态补丁胶体的空液态。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，但涉及相互作用建模、渗透转变与一级相变分析，推测采用分子动力学或连续介质理论）。

papers.title: Unity-order coupling between free electrons and multiphoton waveguided Fock states
papers.abstract: Electron beams enable highly localized near-field excitation of waveguided optical modes, yet their coupling is typically limited by short interaction times along straight-line trajectories with fixed impact parameters. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that electrostatic steering overcomes this limitation by introducing a tunable turning point in grazing electron trajectories, thus controlling the minimum electron--waveguide separation and producing strong coupling to waveguided modes. Specifically, we consider a biased rectangular silicon waveguide, where a repulsive static field deflects a grazing electron. In this configuration, the electron turning point governs both the coupling strength and the modal selectivity, which can be dynamically tuned through the electron incidence angle and the applied bias. In addition, the aloof electron--waveguide interaction suppresses lossy high-energy channels (e.g., above the silicon band gap) while preserving substantial excitation of the targeted waveguided modes. Using a practical biasing configuration and 100~keV electrons, we predict an average yield exceeding ten photons per electron, with voltage-tunable control of the interaction. Our results establish electrostatic steering as a practical route for engineering and enhancing free-electron coupling to waveguided photonic modes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically demonstrate”“we predict”等表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：自由电子与波导多光子Fock态之间的耦合，具体体系为偏置矩形硅波导中掠射电子与波导模式的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过静电偏转引入可调转向点，能够克服自由电子与波导模式耦合受限于短相互作用时间的传统局限，实现单位阶跃量级的耦合强度，并预测每个电子可产生超过十个光子的平均产额。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过静电偏转引入可调转向点，能够克服自由电子与波导模式耦合受限于短相互作用时间的传统局限，实现单位阶跃量级的耦合强度，并预测每个电子可产生超过十个光子的平均产额。；创新点：提出利用静电偏转（而非传统直线轨迹）实现电子-波导耦合的工程化增强，并实现电压可调的耦合控制，同时通过掠射相互作用抑制高能损耗通道。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于静电偏转的电子轨迹控制，考虑偏置矩形硅波导中排斥静电场对掠射电子的偏转作用，通过电子入射角和偏置电压动态调控转向点，从而控制耦合强度与模式选择性。

papers.title: Engineering Molecular Rectification: Mechanisms, Modulation Strategies, and Device Integration
papers.abstract: Molecular rectifiers, as prototypical components of molecular electronics, present unique opportunities for pushing device miniaturization to its ultimate limits. Nevertheless, challenges including limited rectification ratios (RR), insufficient robustness, and poor reproducibility impede their practical deployment. To make molecular rectifiers competitive with silicon-based devices, it is important to fully understand the design principles and fabrication methods from both mechanistic and experimental perspectives. By holistically considering the transport mechanisms, modulation strategies, fabrication, characterization techniques, and theoretical simulations, this review provides a comprehensive overview of molecular rectifiers. Representative examples of conceptually significant and high-performance molecular rectifier systems are highlighted to illustrate the relationships between rectification mechanisms, molecular design strategies, and device realization. Building on these discussions, we present an outlook for current bottlenecks and future directions to guide the development of molecular rectifiers. This review aims to serve as both a conceptual framework and a technical reference for researchers working at the intersection of molecular electronics and nanoscale device engineering in the post-CMOS era.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（关键词：review, comprehensive overview, 讨论transport mechanisms, modulation strategies, fabrication, characterization, theoretical simulations）；研究对象：分子整流器（molecular rectifiers），属于分子电子学（molecular electronics）中的原型器件，涉及电荷输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子整流器在器件微型化方面具有独特潜力，但目前面临整流比有限、鲁棒性不足和可重复性差等挑战；通过全面理解输运机制、调制策略及制备方法，有望使其与硅基器件竞争。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子整流器在器件微型化方面具有独特潜力，但目前面临整流比有限、鲁棒性不足和可重复性差等挑战；通过全面理解输运机制、调制策略及制备方法，有望使其与硅基器件竞争。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出该综述从机制与实验双重视角，系统梳理了分子整流器的设计原理与制备方法，并提供了概念框架与技术参考。
papers.method_zh: 综合评述了输运机制、调制策略、制备与表征技术以及理论模拟方法（摘要未具体列出单一实验或计算手段，而是涵盖多种方法）。

papers.title: SC-1 Etching of Niobium and Titanium Nitride Thin Films
papers.abstract: Dry etching techniques, ubiquitous in microelectronics fabrication, often result in challenging levels of undesired collateral plasma-induced damage. In this work, we demonstrate a wet etching alternative for the patterning of niobium (Nb) and titanium nitride (TiN) thin films using the Standard Cleaning 1 (SC-1) solution. We characterize the etching process through its time-evolution dynamics, supported by scanning-electron and atomic force microscopy assessment of the etched film morphology. The results suggest etch dynamics that are linked to native oxides and film microstructure. Overall, the manageable etch rates, the safe operation and the high material selectivity are attractive for practical use in microelectronics fabrication.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“demonstrate a wet etching alternative”、“characterize the etching process”以及使用扫描电子显微镜和原子力显微镜进行形貌评估。；研究对象：铌（Nb）和氮化钛（TiN）薄膜的湿法刻蚀工艺，具体使用标准清洗1号（SC-1）溶液进行图案化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SC-1溶液能够有效湿法刻蚀Nb和TiN薄膜，其刻蚀动力学与薄膜的天然氧化物和微观结构相关，且刻蚀速率可控、操作安全、材料选择性高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SC-1溶液能够有效湿法刻蚀Nb和TiN薄膜，其刻蚀动力学与薄膜的天然氧化物和微观结构相关，且刻蚀速率可控、操作安全、材料选择性高。；创新点：提出并验证了一种替代干法刻蚀（如等离子体刻蚀）的湿法刻蚀方案，用于Nb和TiN薄膜的图案化，避免了干法刻蚀中常见的等离子体诱导损伤。摘要未突出说明该工作与已有湿法刻蚀研究相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 湿法刻蚀实验（使用SC-1溶液）；扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）用于表征刻蚀后的薄膜形貌；通过时间演化动力学分析刻蚀过程。

papers.title: Energy and Scaling Limits of Phase-Change Memory
papers.abstract: Phase change memory (PCM) relies on a reversible transition between amorphous and crystalline states of a material, and stands as a promising candidate for next-generation, energy-efficient data storage and neuromorphic hardware. Here, we review key innovations that have driven PCM technology to achieve energy consumption down to only tens of femtojoules per bit, and could further advance it closer to its fundamental limits. Because PCM switching is induced thermally, we highlight improvements in energy-efficiency through two primary strategies: by minimizing the active phase change material region to sub-10 nm dimensions, and by enhancing heat confinement within PCM devices to reduce thermal dissipation into the surrounding environment. While the theoretical limits could reach single attojoules per cubic nanometer of memory material, realizing these limits in practice is significantly constrained by electrical and thermal parasitics, particularly at contacts and interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review、key innovations、strategies。；研究对象：相变存储器（PCM）及其非晶态与晶态之间的可逆相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将相变材料有源区缩小至亚10纳米尺寸，并增强器件内的热约束以减少热耗散，PCM的能耗已可低至每比特数十飞焦耳，理论上可进一步接近每立方纳米单阿焦耳的基本极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将相变材料有源区缩小至亚10纳米尺寸，并增强器件内的热约束以减少热耗散，PCM的能耗已可低至每比特数十飞焦耳，理论上可进一步接近每立方纳米单阿焦耳的基本极限。；创新点：系统总结了通过缩小有源区尺寸和改善热约束两种途径提升PCM能效的进展，并指出了电学和热学寄生效应（尤其在接触和界面处）对实现理论极限的显著制约。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，主要基于对PCM器件能量效率改进策略的综述分析，涉及热学与电学设计优化。

papers.title: Dry Glass Reference Perturbation Theory: Development, Applications and Extensions
papers.abstract: This manuscript reviews the development, application and extensions of the dry glass reference perturbation theory (DGRPT) closure to the non-equilibrium thermodynamics of glassy polymers (NETGP). DGRPT was developed to allow for the self-consistent and accurate predictions of sorption from complex liquid mixtures into glassy polymers. DGRPT is applied in the context of diffusion theory to predict the membrane based separations of complex liquid mixtures with glassy polymer membranes. Several examples are given, including the membrane based fractionation of crude oil as well as the membrane based separation of highly non-ideal alcohol / hydrocarbon liquid mixtures. Extensions of the theory to higher order expansions are reviewed and evaluated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbation theory（微扰理论）、closure（闭合）、non-equilibrium thermodynamics（非平衡热力学）。；研究对象：玻璃态聚合物（glassy polymers）及其在复杂液体混合物中的吸附与膜分离过程，具体包括原油的膜基分馏以及高度非理想醇/烃液体混合物的膜分离。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 干玻璃参考微扰理论（DGRPT）能够自洽且准确地预测复杂液体混合物在玻璃态聚合物中的吸附行为，并成功应用于基于膜的液体混合物分离预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：干玻璃参考微扰理论（DGRPT）能够自洽且准确地预测复杂液体混合物在玻璃态聚合物中的吸附行为，并成功应用于基于膜的液体混合物分离预测。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 干玻璃参考微扰理论（DGRPT）闭合方法，结合扩散理论（diffusion theory）应用于非平衡热力学框架（NETGP），并扩展至高阶展开。

papers.title: Nanoscale Confinement Enhances Ultrafast Demagnetization
papers.abstract: Nanoscale miniaturization has revolutionized the field of spintronics by enabling exponential growth in areal bit density. A similar leap is also expected in device speeds through successfully harnessing femtosecond magnetization dynamics. However, combining this with the miniaturization of realistic devices is challenging. To address this, we studied the effect of dimensional confinement on the femtosecond demagnetization of Fe. By gradually increasing the level of confinement while keeping excitation conditions constant, we found that Fe layers thinner than 10 nm exhibit enlarged demagnetization amplitudes, reaching a $\sim75\%$ increase at 2 nm. By combining ultrafast experiments sensitive to the spins, the charge carriers, and the phonons, we establish that this finite$\text{-}$size effect is magnetic in origin and is not phonon$\text{-}$driven. With the support of ab$\text{-}$initio calculations and atomistic spin dynamics simulations, we identify the enhancement effect as due to local weakening of spin order at the Fe$\text{'}$s interface, which becomes significant upon increased confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合计算与模拟）。判断依据关键词：ultrafast experiments、ab-initio calculations、atomistic spin dynamics simulations。；研究对象：纳米尺度限域效应对铁（Fe）薄膜飞秒退磁过程的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当Fe层厚度小于10 nm时，飞秒退磁幅度显著增强，在2 nm厚度时退磁幅度增加约75%；该有限尺寸效应源于磁性起源，而非声子驱动，与界面处自旋有序的局部弱化有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当Fe层厚度小于10 nm时，飞秒退磁幅度显著增强，在2 nm厚度时退磁幅度增加约75%；该有限尺寸效应源于磁性起源，而非声子驱动，与界面处自旋有序的局部弱化有关。；创新点：首次在保持激发条件不变的情况下，系统研究维度限域对飞秒退磁的增强效应，并明确该效应为磁性起源，排除了声子驱动机制。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒超快实验（同时探测自旋、载流子和声子动力学）、第一性原理计算（ab-initio calculations）、原子自旋动力学模拟（atomistic spin dynamics simulations）。

papers.title: High Temperature Jahn-Teller Distortion and Short Range Order in CsCuCl$_3$
papers.abstract: CsCuCl$_3$, chiral and Jahn-Teller distorted at room temperature, takes a more symmetric structure above 423K. Describing this 'simpler' high temperature structure is far from simple and has been the subject of many, sometimes contradicting, studies. Here we reinvestigate the high temperature structure of CsCuCl$_3$, its thermal stability, and its effect on room temperature chirality. In situ pair distribution function data from powder neutron diffraction confirms that CsCuCl$_3$ is Jahn-Teller distorted both below and above T$_c$, and provides a quantitative view of short range order in the high temperature structure. In situ powder x-ray diffraction shows that CsCuCl$_3$ does not undergo any additional structural changes above 423K and is congruently melting. In situ single crystal x-ray diffraction experiments reveal that the phase transition induces domains of mixed handedness in originally homochiral crystals. These findings contribute to a better understanding of phase transitions in Jahn-Teller distorted compounds, and highlight the potential use of phase transitions to control chiral domains.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in situ pair distribution function data、powder neutron diffraction、powder x-ray diffraction、single crystal x-ray diffraction。；研究对象：CsCuCl₃ 在高温（>423K）下的结构，特别是其Jahn-Teller畸变、短程有序性以及相变对手性畴的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CsCuCl₃ 在高温相中仍然存在Jahn-Teller畸变（短程有序），且该材料在423K以上无其他结构变化并一致熔融；相变会在原本单一手性的晶体中引入混合手性畴。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CsCuCl₃ 在高温相中仍然存在Jahn-Teller畸变（短程有序），且该材料在423K以上无其他结构变化并一致熔融；相变会在原本单一手性的晶体中引入混合手性畴。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 原位粉末中子衍射（获取对分布函数PDF数据）、原位粉末X射线衍射、原位单晶X射线衍射。

papers.title: Photon-energy-programmable subnanometric electron birth-site control
papers.abstract: Optical control of electron-generation sites has broadly enabled ultrafast nanoscale imaging, spectroscopy, and functional control. Existing approaches achieve nanoscale site selectivity by shaping localised optical fields around nanostructures, thereby limiting independent site selectivity within the same local-field hotspot. Here, using a single-molecule electron emitter, we show that site selectivity can instead be encoded in the electronic excitation pathway, enabling subnanometric control of electron birth sites within the same local-field hotspot. By tuning the photon energy, we selectively access molecular states of different spatial symmetry and reversibly switch the electron birth site between distinct locations in the same emitter, with the change read out directly in the far-field emission pattern. The switching depends on photon energy alone and is absent under variations in intensity or polarisation. Our results establish optical birth-site selectivity that is not dictated by the local-field distribution, opening a route to electron birth-site control through the electronic excitation pathway.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：single-molecule electron emitter, far-field emission pattern, photon energy tuning。；研究对象：单分子电子发射器中的电子产生位点（electron birth site）控制，具体涉及通过光子能量调控分子不同空间对称性的电子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节光子能量，可以在同一局域场热点内实现亚纳米尺度的电子产生位点可逆切换，且该切换仅依赖于光子能量，而非光强或偏振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节光子能量，可以在同一局域场热点内实现亚纳米尺度的电子产生位点可逆切换，且该切换仅依赖于光子能量，而非光强或偏振。；创新点：突破了传统依赖局域光场分布实现纳米级位点选择性的限制，首次证明电子产生位点选择性可通过电子激发路径（而非局域场分布）编码，实现同一局域场热点内的亚纳米级位点控制。
papers.method_zh: 使用单分子电子发射器，通过改变入射光子能量选择性地激发不同空间对称性的分子电子态，并通过远场发射图案直接读取电子产生位点的变化。

papers.title: Change in charge density wave order beyond the Lifshitz transition in 2H-Ta\textsubscript{1$\pmδ$}S\textsubscript{2}
papers.abstract: We investigate electronic instabilities in 2H-TaS\textsubscript{2} and a self-intercalated variant, 2H$^\dagger$-Ta\textsubscript{1+$δ$}S\textsubscript{2}. In conventional samples, which we determine to be slightly hole-doped, spectral gaps and backfolded features are found as fingerprints of the $3\times3$ charge density wave (CDW). Notably, the backfolded features emerge only at a temperatures below $T\approx$~65~K, substantially lower than the established CDW temperature of 78~K, suggesting an incommensurate-commensurate lock-in transition analogous to the phenomenology of the 2H-TaSe\textsubscript{2}. In contrast, the self-intercalated 2H$^\dagger$ sample exhibits substantial electron doping and signatures of a novel \tworootthree CDW. Using \textit{ab initio} calculations of the phonon spectrum, we demonstrate that the \threebythree instability ($\mathbf{q}=\sfrac{2}{3}\mathbf{ΓM}$) is highly sensitive to band filling. Furthermore, with increased interlayer spacing, a competing soft phonon mode emerges near $\mathbf{q}=\sfrac{1}{2}\mathbf{ΓK}$, corresponding to the superstructure observed in the 2H$^\dagger$ phase, although in our calculations this instability arises under hole doping rather than the electron doping inferred experimentally. These results establish band filling and interlayer spacing as key control parameters for CDW ordering vectors in 2H-TaS\textsubscript{2}, and highlight a route to engineering electronic instabilities in a prototypical layered material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“光谱间隙和背折叠特征”等实验观测，以及“基于第一性原理的声子谱计算”等理论计算手段。；研究对象：2H-TaS₂及其自插层变体2H†-Ta₁₊δS₂中的电荷密度波（CDW）有序，特别是能带填充和层间距对CDW波矢的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在常规2H-TaS₂中，背折叠特征仅在约65 K以下出现，低于已知的78 K CDW转变温度，暗示存在非公度-公度锁定转变；自插层样品则表现出显著电子掺杂和一种新的√3×√3 CDW。第一性原理计算表明，3×3 CDW不稳定性对能带填充高度敏感，而增加层间距会诱发竞争性的软声子模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在常规2H-TaS₂中，背折叠特征仅在约65 K以下出现，低于已知的78 K CDW转变温度，暗示存在非公度-公度锁定转变；自插层样品则表现出显著电子掺杂和一种新的√3×√3 CDW。第一性原理计算表明，3×3 CDW不稳定性对能带填充高度敏感，而增加层间距会诱发竞争性的软声子模。；创新点：首次在2H-TaS₂中观察到类似2H-TaSe₂的非公度-公度锁定转变，并发现自插层可诱导出新型√3×√3 CDW，明确了能带填充和层间距是调控CDW有序波矢的关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用光谱测量（如ARPES或STS，摘要未明确具体技术）观测能隙和背折叠特征；理论上采用基于第一性原理的声子谱计算（DFT声子计算）分析不同掺杂和层间距下的晶格不稳定性。

papers.title: Taming quantum interference: a route to high electrical conductance in carbon nanotube assemblies
papers.abstract: Miniaturized electronics require lightweight conductors that maintain high conductance under demanding conditions. CNT networks are promising candidates, but their transport is governed by inter-nanotube junctions where electron waves interfere. Controlling this interference requires understanding how junction architecture shapes transmission. We explore coherent transport through experimentally relevant junctions, from single and multiple single-walled CNT (SWCNT) contacts to double-walled CNT (DWCNT) and triple-walled CNT (TWCNT) junctions, with atomistic tight-binding non-equilibrium Green's-function calculations, also under a perpendicular magnetic field. We use analytically solvable minimal models to identify transport regimes expected for quasi-1D nanoscale junctions, and an electron-waveguide picture to interpret their CNT-specific manifestations. For single SWCNT--SWCNT junctions, high-transmission windows are set mainly by overlap length, doping and magnetic field. Gateway states can enhance conductance when some CNT subbands are gapped, and in some cases a magnetic field can restore transmission by lifting an interference blockade. In more complex architectures, added paths become selective: multi-junctions generate resonant filtering, while additional walls redistribute transmission instead of acting as independent channels. DWCNT junctions remain outer-wall dominated and SWCNT-like, whereas TWCNT junctions become genuinely multi-channel and more field-sensitive. This explains the lower, more field-sensitive conductance of multi-walled CNT (MWCNT) fibres, in accord with our ultrahigh-field measurements on SWCNT and MWCNT fibres. Ultimately, this work turns microscopic interference mechanisms into design principles for high-conductance, field-stable CNT conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。判断依据：使用“atomistic tight-binding non-equilibrium Green's-function calculations”（原子级紧束缚非平衡格林函数计算）和“analytically solvable minimal models”（可解析求解的最小模型）进行理论建模与数值计算，并结合实验测量（ultrahigh-field measurements）进行验证。；研究对象：碳纳米管（CNT）网络中的量子干涉效应及其对电导的影响，具体包括单壁碳纳米管（SWCNT）、双壁碳纳米管（DWCNT）和三壁碳纳米管（TWCNT）之间的结（junction）结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了通过调控碳纳米管结的几何结构（如重叠长度、掺杂、外加磁场）可以控制电子波的量子干涉，从而设计出高电导且对磁场稳定的碳纳米管导体。多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）纤维的低电导和高磁场敏感性源于其多通道传输特性，而非简单的独立通道叠加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了通过调控碳纳米管结的几何结构（如重叠长度、掺杂、外加磁场）可以控制电子波的量子干涉，从而设计出高电导且对磁场稳定的碳纳米管导体。多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）纤维的低电导和高磁场敏感性源于其多通道传输特性，而非简单的独立通道叠加。；创新点：将微观量子干涉机制（如“gateway states”增强电导、“interference blockade”磁场解除）转化为设计高电导、场稳定碳纳米管导体的工程原则，并首次系统解释了多壁碳纳米管纤维电导低于单壁纤维的物理根源。
papers.method_zh: 采用原子级紧束缚非平衡格林函数（TB-NEGF）方法计算相干输运；使用可解析求解的最小模型识别准一维纳米结的输运区间；采用电子波导图像解释碳纳米管特有的输运现象；并结合超强磁场下的SWCNT和MWCNT纤维电导测量进行验证。

papers.title: Zero-Field Thermal Hall Effect in Insulator
papers.abstract: Fourier's law dictates that heat flow is usually parallel to the applied temperature gradient. However, under a high magnetic field, heat flow carried by both electrons in conductors and phonons in insulators can be deflected, a phenomenon known as thermal Hall effect. Intriguingly, we observe at zero field a spontaneous thermal Hall effect in an antiferromagnetic insulator. Despite a vanishingly small uncompensated magnetization, the magnitude of this effect is surprisingly large, comparable to typical responses induced by several teslas of external field. This zero-field behavior indicates that charge-neutral heat carriers can be governed by an intrinsic effective field arising from the unique spin arrangement. Our discovery challenges the centuries-old preconception of heat conduction and open up new avenues for exploring non-trivial topological responses in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：“observe”（观察）、“measurement”（测量）、“response”（响应）。；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体中的零场热霍尔效应（Zero-Field Thermal Hall Effect），具体材料为一种反铁磁绝缘体（antiferromagnetic insulator）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零外加磁场下，反铁磁绝缘体中自发产生了热霍尔效应，其幅度与数特斯拉外场诱导的典型响应相当，表明电荷中性的热载流子受源于独特自旋排列的内禀有效场支配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零外加磁场下，反铁磁绝缘体中自发产生了热霍尔效应，其幅度与数特斯拉外场诱导的典型响应相当，表明电荷中性的热载流子受源于独特自旋排列的内禀有效场支配。；创新点：首次在零磁场下发现反铁磁绝缘体中的自发热霍尔效应，挑战了传统傅里叶定律关于热流平行于温度梯度的认知，揭示了自旋结构可产生内禀有效场调控中性热载流子的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如具体材料名称、测量装置、温度范围等），仅提及在零场下观测热霍尔效应并测量其大小。
