papers.title: Nonlinear Elasticity at the Damage Threshold of Semiconductor Nanocrystals
papers.abstract: The nonlinear photoacoustic response of indium phosphide nanocrystals on silicon nanotip arrays is investigated using time-resolved optical pump-probe spectroscopy and synchrotron-based X-ray diffraction. Femtosecond laser excitation triggers low-frequency and high-frequency radial breathing modes of the nanocrystals at 8 GHz and 10.3 GHz, respectively. At excitation fluences above 3 mJ/cm^2, nonlinear frequency mixing occurs, including sum- and difference-frequency generation, indicative of strain-induced nonlinear elasticity. A higher-order extension of Hooke's law models the fluence-dependent spectral response and yields a physically valid elastic energy potential. Ex-situ energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy reveals a correlation between nanocrystal oxidation and the emergence of nonlinear acoustic modes. Time-resolved X-ray diffraction confirms the nanocrystals as the origin of the low-frequency modes and supports the hypothesis of acoustic decoupling from the substrate. These findings provide insight into the mechanical limits of semiconductor nanostructures under intense optical excitation and suggest new pathways for material characterization and optomechanical control at the nanoscale. The results advance the understanding of nonlinear phonon dynamics in nanocrystals and highlight their potential for integration into next-generation photonic and quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了时间分辨光泵浦探测光谱、同步辐射X射线衍射、能量色散X射线光谱等实验手段。；研究对象：硅纳米针尖阵列上的磷化铟（InP）半导体纳米晶体，以及其在强光激发下的非线性弹性力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超过3 mJ/cm²的激发通量下，纳米晶体出现非线性频率混合（和频与差频产生），表明应变诱导的非线性弹性；该非线性行为与纳米晶体的氧化有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超过3 mJ/cm²的激发通量下，纳米晶体出现非线性频率混合（和频与差频产生），表明应变诱导的非线性弹性；该非线性行为与纳米晶体的氧化有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 具体使用了时间分辨光泵浦探测光谱（time-resolved optical pump-probe spectroscopy）和基于同步辐射的X射线衍射（synchrotron-based X-ray diffraction）来研究光声响应；使用高阶胡克定律扩展模型（higher-order extension of Hooke's law）对光谱响应进行建模；使用非原位能量色散X射线光谱（ex-situ energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy）分析元素成分变化。

papers.title: Three-component superconductivity: the effect of second-order Josephson couplings
papers.abstract: Recently, a three-component Ginzburg-Landau (GL) model compatible with the 3Q pair-density-wave state has been proposed to explain the fractional quantum magnetic resistance oscillations of period $φ_0/3 = hc/6e$ observed in vanadium-based kagome superconductors. The physics of this model is governed by second-order Josephson-type couplings, which break both time-reversal symmetry and discrete $π$-phase flip symmetry. In this work, we theoretically derive the complete set of ground-state solutions and construct a comprehensive phase diagram in the GL parameter space, characterized by analytically determined phase boundaries. We identify five distinct ground states: an 8-fold degenerate frustrated state and four 4-fold degenerate non-frustrated phase-locked states. Four of these states spontaneously break time-reversal symmetry. Numerical analysis of the collective modes reveals the emergence of a Higgs-Leggett mode unique to the frustrated region, accompanied by mode softening near the phase boundaries. Our findings provide a comprehensive theoretical framework for understanding the multifaceted physics of multicomponent superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：theoretically derive、numerical analysis、Ginzburg-Landau model。；研究对象：基于三组分Ginzburg-Landau模型描述的三组分超导电性，具体针对钒基笼目超导体中观察到的分数量子磁阻振荡现象（周期φ₀/3 = hc/6e）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出三组分超导模型在二阶约瑟夫森耦合下的完整基态解集，构建了包含五个不同基态（一个8重简并阻挫态和四个4重简并非阻挫锁相态）的相图，并在阻挫区域发现了一种独特的Higgs-Leggett集体模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出三组分超导模型在二阶约瑟夫森耦合下的完整基态解集，构建了包含五个不同基态（一个8重简并阻挫态和四个4重简并非阻挫锁相态）的相图，并在阻挫区域发现了一种独特的Higgs-Leggett集体模。；创新点：首次完整解析了三组分超导模型中由二阶约瑟夫森耦合导致的全部基态解，并系统揭示了阻挫区域特有的Higgs-Leggett模及其在相边界附近的软化行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用三组分Ginzburg-Landau理论框架，通过解析推导确定相边界，并结合数值分析研究集体激发模式。

papers.title: Barrier crossing in a two-state system: Effect of bias and stochastic fields
papers.abstract: We study barrier crossing in a two-state system, namely the kinetic Ising model, in the presence of a weak bias field and spatially homogeneous, but time-dependent, Gaussian random fields. We find that the bias field determines the location of the dominant maxima of the probability distribution function of the magnetization, whereas the noise intensity controls their sharpness and stability of the distribution. A moderate stochastic field lowers the effective energy barrier and facilitates transitions between ordered states, while strong noise induces broad distributions and significant backflow, which reduces directional selectivity. Our results suggest that efficient barrier crossing requires a balanced combination of moderate stochastic driving and controlled bias.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study（理论研究）、probability distribution function（概率分布函数）、effective energy barrier（有效能垒）。；研究对象：两态系统中的势垒穿越问题，具体为动力学伊辛模型（kinetic Ising model），在弱偏置场和空间均匀但时间依赖的高斯随机场作用下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偏置场决定磁化概率分布函数中主要极大值的位置，而噪声强度控制分布的尖锐程度和稳定性；适度的随机场可降低有效能垒并促进有序态之间的跃迁，但过强的噪声会导致宽分布和显著回流，降低方向选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偏置场决定磁化概率分布函数中主要极大值的位置，而噪声强度控制分布的尖锐程度和稳定性；适度的随机场可降低有效能垒并促进有序态之间的跃迁，但过强的噪声会导致宽分布和显著回流，降低方向选择性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于动力学伊辛模型，引入弱偏置场和空间均匀、时间依赖的高斯随机场，通过概率分布函数分析磁化行为。

papers.title: Search for high-pressure phases of yttrium via a data assimilation approach
papers.abstract: We investigate the distorted face-centered-cubic (dfcc) phase of yttrium (Y) using a data-assimilation-based structure search that combines high-resolution powder x-ray diffraction (XRD) data with machine-learning interatomic potentials. By exploring supercells containing up to 128 atoms, we identify three low-enthalpy phases: the previously reported $I4_1/a$ structure and two additional structures, $Ibam$ and $R\overline{3}$. No data-assimilation-derived structure relaxes to the previously proposed $R\overline{3}m$ phase. Phonon calculations show that $I4_1/a$, $Ibam$, and $R\overline{3}$ are dynamically stable, whereas $R\overline{3}m$ exhibits imaginary modes near the $Γ$ point, indicating dynamical instability. Enthalpy calculations using both PBE and r$^{2}$SCAN place the four candidate structures within about 10 meV/atom, indicating a complex energy landscape with multiple competing minima, although $R\overline{3}m$ is consistently highest in enthalpy and r$^{2}$SCAN favors $I4_1/a$ throughout the dfcc pressure range. Rietveld refinements of the powder XRD profile at 60 GPa further narrow the viable structural models to $I4_1/a$ and $Ibam$, both of which reproduce the experimental data better than $R\overline{3}m$ and $R\overline{3}$. Taken together with the energetic ordering and dynamical stability, these results identify $I4_1/a$ as the most plausible structure of the dfcc phase of Y, with $Ibam$ remaining a close competing candidate, particularly toward the high-pressure side of the dfcc region.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据：结合了机器学习势函数的结构搜索、第一性原理计算（PBE、r²SCAN）、声子计算，以及高分辨粉末X射线衍射（XRD）实验数据与Rietveld精修。；研究对象：钇（Yttrium, Y）在高压下的畸变面心立方（dfcc）相及其候选晶体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数据同化方法，发现I4₁/a结构是钇dfcc相最合理的结构模型，而此前提出的R3̅m相因存在虚频声子模式而动力学不稳定，且其焓值最高。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数据同化方法，发现I4₁/a结构是钇dfcc相最合理的结构模型，而此前提出的R3̅m相因存在虚频声子模式而动力学不稳定，且其焓值最高。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于数据同化的结构搜索方法（结合机器学习原子间势与高分辨粉末XRD数据），对含最多128个原子的超胞进行探索；采用PBE和r²SCAN泛函进行焓计算；进行声子谱计算以评估动力学稳定性；在60 GPa下对粉末XRD图谱进行Rietveld精修以比较候选结构。

papers.title: Cascade of magnetic-field-induced quantum spin states in a spin-1 honeycomb magnet
papers.abstract: Quantum fluctuations endow spin systems with surprisingly enriched magnetic phase diagrams. In frustrated magnets, strong quantum fluctuations boosted by either geometrical incompatibility or competitive exchange interactions stabilize cascades of unusual phases of matter. Here we reveal the presence of multiple quantum phases in the honeycomb antiferromagnet Na$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$BiO$_{6}$, both inside and beyond its field-induced one-third magnetization plateau. Comprehensive measurements of thermodynamic quantities demonstrate that the one-third plateau comprises at least three distinct spin states with nearly-degenerate net magnetization, separated by first-order transitions that likely involve sequential spin reconfiguration. Upon further increasing the magnetic field, the system evolves across a myriad of peculiar phases before reaching full polarization; these intermediate phases possess copious low-energy excitations, manifested by anomalous upturns of specific heat at ultralow temperatures -- probably hinting at the development of "hidden" ordered ground states. The complex magnetic phase diagram of Na$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$BiO$_{6}$ underlines the preponderant impact of quantum fluctuations on a honeycomb spin lattice with strong exchange frustration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Comprehensive measurements of thermodynamic quantities”（热力学量的综合测量），属于实验手段。；研究对象：自旋-1蜂窝状反铁磁体 Na₃Ni₂BiO₆，及其在磁场诱导下的量子自旋态级联现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Na₃Ni₂BiO₆中，三分之一磁化平台实际上由至少三个净磁化近乎简并的不同自旋态组成，它们之间通过一级相变分离；在更高磁场下，系统经历一系列中间相后才达到完全极化，这些中间相在极低温下表现出比热异常上升，暗示可能存在“隐藏”的有序基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Na₃Ni₂BiO₆中，三分之一磁化平台实际上由至少三个净磁化近乎简并的不同自旋态组成，它们之间通过一级相变分离；在更高磁场下，系统经历一系列中间相后才达到完全极化，这些中间相在极低温下表现出比热异常上升，暗示可能存在“隐藏”的有序基态。；创新点：揭示了在强阻挫蜂窝状自旋晶格中，量子涨落不仅稳定了三分之一磁化平台，还导致该平台内部存在多个近简并的自旋态，以及平台外一系列具有丰富低能激发的中间相。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 热力学量的综合测量（具体手段如比热、磁化率等，摘要未进一步明确说明）。

papers.title: Analytical solution of the Langmuir model for moisture diffusion in cylindrical coordinates
papers.abstract: Moisture diffusion in polymers and bio-based materials frequently exhibits non-Fickian behavior that cannot be described by classical diffusion models. The Langmuir model, which accounts for the coexistence of mobile and bound water molecules, has been widely used to represent such phenomena. However, analytical solutions of this model are generally limited to planar geometries, while cylindrical systems are typically investigated using numerical methods. In this work, the Langmuir diffusion model is solved analytically in cylindrical coordinates. The resulting solution provides both the local evolution of moisture content within the cylinder and the corresponding global moisture uptake kinetics. The analytical solution is validated through comparison with an independent numerical solution based on a finite difference scheme, showing excellent agreement for both the global absorption kinetics and the radial moisture profiles. The proposed formulation therefore provides a simple and efficient analytical framework for studying non-Fickian moisture diffusion in cylindrical systems such as natural fibers, and facilitates the identification of model parameters from experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical solution（解析解）、Langmuir model（Langmuir模型）、cylindrical coordinates（柱坐标）。；研究对象：非菲克型水分扩散现象，具体为聚合物和生物基材料（如天然纤维）中水分在圆柱形体系中的扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作给出了Langmuir扩散模型在柱坐标下的解析解，能够准确描述圆柱体内局部水分含量随时间的演化以及整体吸湿动力学，并通过与数值解对比验证了其准确性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作给出了Langmuir扩散模型在柱坐标下的解析解，能够准确描述圆柱体内局部水分含量随时间的演化以及整体吸湿动力学，并通过与数值解对比验证了其准确性。；创新点：此前Langmuir模型的解析解仅限于平面几何，而圆柱形体系通常依赖数值方法；该工作首次提供了柱坐标下的解析解，为天然纤维等圆柱形体系中的非菲克扩散研究提供了简便高效的分析框架，并有助于从实验数据中提取模型参数。
papers.method_zh: 采用Langmuir扩散模型（考虑可移动水分子与结合水分子的共存），在柱坐标系下推导解析解，并与基于有限差分法的独立数值解进行对比验证。

papers.title: Hall effect in multi-leg bosonic ladders
papers.abstract: We use bosonization to analyze the ground state Hall response of interacting bosonic N-leg ladders threaded by a flux. We derive an explicit expression of the Hall imbalance in a perturbative expansion in the band curvature, retaining fully the interactions. For small magnetic field the Hall resistance is proportional to the derivative of the logarithm of the charge stiffness with respect to density, generalizing the result obtained in the two leg case. We also consider the effect of temperature, and establish that at low temperature, corrections to the Hall resistance are exponentially small in the Meissner phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“bosonization”（玻色化）、“perturbative expansion”（微扰展开）、“derive an explicit expression”（推导显式表达式）。；研究对象：多腿玻色子梯子（multi-leg bosonic ladders）在通量（flux）下的基态霍尔响应，具体为相互作用玻色子N腿梯子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在小磁场下，霍尔电阻与电荷刚度（charge stiffness）对密度的对数导数成正比，将两腿情况的结果推广到了多腿情形；在迈斯纳相（Meissner phase）中，低温下霍尔电阻的修正呈指数小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在小磁场下，霍尔电阻与电荷刚度（charge stiffness）对密度的对数导数成正比，将两腿情况的结果推广到了多腿情形；在迈斯纳相（Meissner phase）中，低温下霍尔电阻的修正呈指数小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻色化（bosonization）理论框架，在能带曲率（band curvature）下进行微扰展开，并完整保留相互作用效应。

papers.title: Effect of Vacancies on Hydrogen Mobility and Trapping in Elemental Fe and Cr: A DFT and kMC Study
papers.abstract: Hydrogen-vacancy interactions play an important role in governing hydrogen transport and embrittlement in body-centered cubic (BCC) metals. In this study, a multiscale approach combining density functional theory (DFT) and kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations is employed to investigate hydrogen behavior in BCC Fe and Cr. The DFT-calculated binding energies and Bader charge analysis indicate stronger hydrogen trapping in Cr than in Fe. Migration and detrapping energy barriers are determined using the climbing-image nudged elastic band method, showing that the detrapping energy generally decreases with increasing hydrogen occupancy. However, the sixth hydrogen atom in Fe exhibits a finite barrier, contrary to some previous reports. kMC simulations are then used to evaluate hydrogen diffusion over extended time and length scales. The results demonstrate that vacancy defects significantly reduce hydrogen mobility and increase the effective activation energy, with a more pronounced effect observed in Cr due to stronger trapping. The combined DFT-kMC framework provides detailed insight into the mechanisms of hydrogen trapping, detrapping, and diffusion in BCC metals, offering important implications for understanding hydrogen embrittlement in structural materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：DFT、kMC、multiscale approach）；研究对象：氢原子在体心立方（BCC）金属Fe和Cr中的行为，特别是空位缺陷对氢迁移和捕获的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空位缺陷显著降低氢在Fe和Cr中的迁移率并提高有效激活能，且由于更强的捕获作用，该效应在Cr中更为显著；此外，Fe中第六个氢原子的脱陷存在有限势垒，与部分先前报道不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空位缺陷显著降低氢在Fe和Cr中的迁移率并提高有效激活能，且由于更强的捕获作用，该效应在Cr中更为显著；此外，Fe中第六个氢原子的脱陷存在有限势垒，与部分先前报道不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结合动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟；具体包括Bader电荷分析、爬坡弹性带方法（CI-NEB）计算迁移和脱陷能垒。

papers.title: Direction-selective intertwined charge, orbital, and lattice orders under uniaxial strain in hole-doped manganite: La0.75Ca0.25MnO3
papers.abstract: The complex interplay of charge, spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom governs emergent phases in quantum materials, making strain a powerful control parameter. Recent advances in free-standing layer techniques have enabled extreme strains of nearly 8%, opening access to novel and often unexpected electronic and magnetic phases. Here, using a density functional theory approach, we investigate the effect of direction-selective uniaxial strain on the prototypical Jahn-Teller system La1-xCaxMnO3 (x = 0.25). We find that different strain directions stabilize qualitatively distinct structural, charge, and orbital responses, rather than merely different strengths of the same phase. In particular, extreme uniaxial strain selectively induces cooperative Jahn-Teller, breathing-like, and site-selective modulations, thereby enabling previously inaccessible intertwined orders in manganites. These results establish direction-selective uniaxial strain as a powerful and selective route for engineering emergent phases in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“using a density functional theory approach”（使用密度泛函理论方法）。；研究对象：空穴掺杂锰氧化物 La₀.₇₅Ca₀.₂₅MnO₃（即 La₁₋ₓCaₓMnO₃，x=0.25）在单轴应变下的电荷、轨道和晶格有序态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同方向的单轴应变会稳定性质截然不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而非仅仅改变同一物相的强度；极端单轴应变可选择性地诱导合作型Jahn-Teller调制、呼吸型调制和位点选择性调制，从而在锰氧化物中实现此前无法获得的交织有序态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同方向的单轴应变会稳定性质截然不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而非仅仅改变同一物相的强度；极端单轴应变可选择性地诱导合作型Jahn-Teller调制、呼吸型调制和位点选择性调制，从而在锰氧化物中实现此前无法获得的交织有序态。；创新点：揭示了方向选择性单轴应变（而非仅应变大小）可作为调控量子材料中新兴物相的选择性工程手段，特别是通过不同应变方向实现不同类型的电荷-轨道-晶格交织有序。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Finite-size occupancy scaling of apparent fractal dimensions in stochastic trajectories
papers.abstract: Estimating a fractal dimension from a finite stochastic trajectory is a finite-size scaling problem: the apparent box-counting exponent is shaped by an occupancy crossover between the resolved range of scales and the finite number of sampled points, and need not equal the dimension of the limiting process. We model this crossover with a balls-in-boxes occupancy law, which predicts the box-count curve, the finite-size saturation scale, and a scaling function for the normalized local slope. Across random-walk traces, fractional Brownian graphs, and Levy flights, the normalized local slope collapses onto a single crossover curve, while the windowed box-counting bias collapses when the regression window is positioned relative to the saturation scale. Inverting the occupancy model gives a finite-size bias correction that reduces error on controlled stochastic trajectories and transfers across held-out model classes. Comparisons with correlation dimension, detrended fluctuation analysis, the variogram, and Higuchi's method show that the dominant bias is specific to point-sampled box-counting over finite scale windows, and that local-slope stability alone is not a reliable diagnostic. A DNA-walk example illustrates the workflow on measured data, and all figures, tables, and in-text numbers are regenerated from released single-seed code.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：finite-size scaling、occupancy model、scaling function、bias correction、code release。；研究对象：随机轨迹（random-walk traces、fractional Brownian graphs、Levy flights）的有限尺寸标度行为，具体为从有限长随机轨迹中估计分形维数时的有限尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限随机轨迹的表观盒计数分形维数受采样点数和尺度范围之间的占据数交叉（occupancy crossover）控制，并不等于极限过程的分形维数；通过占据数模型可给出有限尺寸偏差校正，显著降低估计误差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限随机轨迹的表观盒计数分形维数受采样点数和尺度范围之间的占据数交叉（occupancy crossover）控制，并不等于极限过程的分形维数；通过占据数模型可给出有限尺寸偏差校正，显著降低估计误差。；创新点：提出了一个统一的占据数模型来解释和校正有限随机轨迹中盒计数分形维数的有限尺寸偏差，并证明该偏差是点采样盒计数方法所特有的，局部斜率稳定性不能作为可靠诊断指标。
papers.method_zh: 采用“balls-in-boxes”占据数模型描述盒计数曲线、有限尺寸饱和尺度及归一化局部斜率的标度函数；在随机游走、分数布朗运动、Levy飞行三类轨迹上验证标度塌缩；与关联维数、去趋势波动分析、变异函数、Higuchi方法进行偏差对比；使用单种子代码复现所有图表和数值。

papers.title: Machine-learning-accelerated discovery of synthesizable high-temperature altermagnets with giant spin splitting
papers.abstract: Altermagnets offer a route to spin-polarized electronic states without macroscopic magnetization, because compensated magnetic order can generate momentum-dependent spin splitting through crystal-symmetry-controlled exchange fields. However, experimentally viable altermagnets combining large spin splitting, thermodynamic stability and high magnetic ordering temperatures remain scarce. Here, we develop a machine-learning-accelerated high-throughput framework to explore the tetragonal AB$_2$C$_2$D compounds. Screening 8640 variants identifies 1347 compensated antiferromagnetic candidates satisfying altermagnetic symmetry. An interpretable XGBoost model trained on first-principles spin-splitting data then isolates 34 low-hull-energy candidates,including four previously reported, with giant non-relativistic spin splittings exceeding 1.5 eV near the Fermi level. Detailed first-principles calculations of the representative RbMn$_2$Te$_2$O confirm a maximum spin splitting of $\sim$1.88 eV with dynamical stability and an estimated Néel temperature of $\sim$390 K. The giant splitting originates from symmetry-locked Mn-sublattice exchange fields amplified by directional Mn-d/Te-p hybridization. Furthermore, we uncover a profound soft-mode-driven structural transition associated with an interlayer dimensionality crossover in SrMn$_2$Te$_2$O, yet the unfolded electronic structure demonstrates that the altermagnetic spin splitting remains robust after lattice reconstruction. Hydrostatic pressure provides an additional tuning route, producing non-monotonic modulation of the spin-split Fermi surface governed by local coordination and orbital hybridization. These results establish tetragonal AB$_2$C$_2$D compounds as a tunable materials platform for stray-field-free spintronic devices and provide a general data-driven strategy for discovering robust giant-splitting altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning-accelerated high-throughput framework、first-principles calculations、XGBoost model）；研究对象：四方晶系AB₂C₂D化合物中的交变磁体（altermagnets），具体包括RbMn₂Te₂O、SrMn₂Te₂O等候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习加速高通量筛选，发现34种具有巨大非相对论自旋劈裂（>1.5 eV）且热力学稳定的交变磁体候选材料，其中RbMn₂Te₂O的最大自旋劈裂达~1.88 eV，奈尔温度约390 K，且自旋劈裂在结构相变后仍保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习加速高通量筛选，发现34种具有巨大非相对论自旋劈裂（>1.5 eV）且热力学稳定的交变磁体候选材料，其中RbMn₂Te₂O的最大自旋劈裂达~1.88 eV，奈尔温度约390 K，且自旋劈裂在结构相变后仍保持鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将机器学习加速高通量筛选应用于四方AB₂C₂D化合物体系，系统发现了兼具大自旋劈裂、热力学稳定性和高磁有序温度的交变磁体，并揭示了软模驱动结构相变中自旋劈裂的鲁棒性以及压力调控的非单调费米面调制机制。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习加速高通量筛选框架（基于XGBoost可解释模型）、第一性原理计算（用于自旋劈裂数据训练和候选材料验证）、软模驱动结构相变分析、静水压调控模拟。

papers.title: Dark-Soliton Branch Blocking in Transonic Bose--Einstein Condensate Flows
papers.abstract: Acoustic horizons in Bose--Einstein condensates are usually characterized through long-wavelength Bogoliubov phonons. We study a nonlinear counterpart: whether a one-dimensional dark-soliton branch can sustain upstream laboratory motion in a stationary transonic flow. The mechanism is local at leading order. A regular dark soliton has a bounded fluid-frame velocity, limited by the local sound speed; therefore, in the supersonic region, the background flow exceeds the largest upstream velocity available to the soliton branch. The sonic point is thus the upstream edge of the local dark-soliton branch, rather than a hard wall or a soliton geodesic surface. We construct stationary transonic Gross--Pitaevskii backgrounds and evolve the full order parameter in an open, nonperiodic domain. The simulations show upstream propagation on the subsonic side, finite-depth stalling on the subsonic side, and downstream advection for defects initialized in the supersonic region with upstream velocity relative to the fluid. Convergence, branch-consistency, local-density, phase-jump, and a dense scan of dimensionless upstream attempts support the soliton-like interpretation. The result is a branch-existence constraint, not a rigorous lower bound on arbitrary density minima of the Gross--Pitaevskii field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：construct stationary transonic Gross--Pitaevskii backgrounds, evolve the full order parameter, simulations。；研究对象：玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate）中的跨声速流动，具体研究一维暗孤子分支在稳态跨声速流中的上游传播行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在跨声速流中，暗孤子分支的上游运动被声学视界（声点）所阻断：在超声速区域，背景流速超过了孤子分支所能达到的最大上游速度，因此声点成为暗孤子分支的上游边界，而非硬壁或孤子测地线表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在跨声速流中，暗孤子分支的上游运动被声学视界（声点）所阻断：在超声速区域，背景流速超过了孤子分支所能达到的最大上游速度，因此声点成为暗孤子分支的上游边界，而非硬壁或孤子测地线表面。；创新点：揭示了暗孤子分支在跨声速流中受到分支存在性约束（而非严格的Gross-Pitaevskii场任意密度极小值的下界），将声学视界的概念从长波Bogoliubov声子推广到非线性暗孤子分支。
papers.method_zh: 构建稳态跨声速Gross-Pitaevskii背景，在开放非周期域中演化完整序参量。通过数值模拟观察暗孤子在亚声速侧的上游传播、亚声速侧的有限深度停滞，以及超声速区域初始化的缺陷（具有相对于流体的上游速度）的下游平流。还进行了收敛性、分支一致性、局域密度、相位跳跃以及无量纲上游尝试的密集扫描分析。

papers.title: Magneto-Optical Detection of Anisotropic Spin Currents in Altermagnetic RuO2
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are a recently identified class of collinear antiferromagnets that host large spin-split electronic bands, offering a promising platform for efficient spin-current generation. Among proposed candidates, the metallic oxide RuO2 is predicted to exhibit strong altermagnetic spin splitting; however, whether it sustains robust magnetic order beyond the ultrathin thickness limit remains unresolved. Here, we employ optical probes to investigate charge-to-spin conversion in a 12-nm-thick (101)-oriented RuO2 film grown on sapphire. Polarization-resolved second-harmonic generation reveals nonlinear optical responses consistent with the surface symmetry and Néel order of RuO2. Under an applied current, both second-harmonic generation and polar magneto-optical Kerr effect measurements detect a pronounced, directionally anisotropic spin polarization, exhibiting enhanced signals for current along [010] and strongly suppressed responses for current along [-101], in agreement with the symmetry of the altermagnetic spin-splitter effect. Non-magnetic or Rashba-type mechanisms cannot explain this symmetry-selective response. Scanning transmission electron microscopy further reveals that substantial strain persists even in relatively thick films, providing a possible explanation for the observed behavior. Therefore, these results establish RuO2 as an efficient spin source and demonstrate the potential of altermagnets for field-free spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“employ optical probes”、“measurements detect”、“Scanning transmission electron microscopy further reveals”等实验手段和观测结果。；研究对象：论文研究了12纳米厚的(101)取向RuO2薄膜中的电荷-自旋转换现象，具体聚焦于交变磁体（altermagnet）中产生的各向异性自旋流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了RuO2薄膜在12纳米厚度下仍能保持交变磁有序，并观测到与交变磁自旋劈裂效应（spin-splitter effect）对称性一致的方向各向异性自旋极化，确立了RuO2作为高效自旋源材料的潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了RuO2薄膜在12纳米厚度下仍能保持交变磁有序，并观测到与交变磁自旋劈裂效应（spin-splitter effect）对称性一致的方向各向异性自旋极化，确立了RuO2作为高效自旋源材料的潜力。；创新点：首次通过光学手段（SHG和MOKE）在相对较厚的RuO2薄膜（12 nm）中直接探测到与交变磁对称性相关的各向异性自旋流，排除了非磁性或Rashba型机制的解释，并揭示了残余应变对稳定磁有序的可能作用。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用了偏振分辨二次谐波产生（SHG）和极向磁光克尔效应（MOKE）测量，并结合扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）进行结构表征。

papers.title: Quantum anomalous Hall effect in chiral semimetals
papers.abstract: The quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effect is conventionally understood to exist only in Chern insulators, while a recent study has shown that ferromagnetic metals can also host the QAH effect. Between insulators and metals, we demonstrate that QAH can persist even in a chiral semimetal, where conduction and valence bands touch at zero energy. Transport calculations demonstrate that the Hall conductivity of such a system can be quantized in the presence of dephasing. Interestingly, its longitudinal conductivity remains finite and exhibits semimetallic behavior, in contrast to Chern insulators. This unusual transport behavior originates from the quantization of the Berry curvature integral over occupied states and the semimetallic band structure. This chiral semimetal can transition into a Chern insulator, accompanied by the vanishing of longitudinal conductivity and a reduction of the intrinsic length scale of the Hall response. Our results extend the concept of QAH and uncover the semimetallic QAH transport signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“demonstrate”“transport calculations”“originates from the quantization of the Berry curvature”等理论推导与计算分析，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：手性半金属中的量子反常霍尔效应（QAH），具体关注其能带结构（导带与价带在零能处接触）及输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性半金属中，即使能带在费米能级处接触（非绝缘态），量子反常霍尔效应仍可存在：霍尔电导在退相干存在下可量子化，而纵向电导保持有限且呈现半金属行为，这与陈绝缘体截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性半金属中，即使能带在费米能级处接触（非绝缘态），量子反常霍尔效应仍可存在：霍尔电导在退相干存在下可量子化，而纵向电导保持有限且呈现半金属行为，这与陈绝缘体截然不同。；创新点：将量子反常霍尔效应的存在范围从陈绝缘体（绝缘态）和铁磁金属（金属态）拓展至半金属态，揭示了半金属中QAH的独特输运特征（有限纵向电导与量子化霍尔电导共存）。
papers.method_zh: 输运计算（transport calculations），通过分析贝里曲率在占据态上的积分量子化以及半金属能带结构，解释反常输运行为；并讨论从手性半金属到陈绝缘体的转变。

papers.title: Spin-Hall-Like Magnon Transport in a Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmion Lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate spin-Hall-like magnon edge transport in a synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmion lattice composed of two antiferromagnetically coupled skyrmion lattice layers with opposite magnetic textures. Based on a relaxed bilayer texture from micromagnetic simulations, we construct the bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian within linear spin-wave theory and calculate the bulk and strip magnon spectrum. We find counterpropagating in-gap edge modes with opposite layer polarization, whose layer-resolved propagation is further confirmed by dynamical micromagnetic simulations. A symmetry analysis shows that the fully coupled system lacks the pseudo-time-reversal symmetry required for a genuine bosonic Z2 topological phase. Thus, the observed edge modes are not Z2-protected helical magnon edge states, but layer-polarized, spin-Hall-like modes originating from the opposite Hall tendencies of the two skyrmion lattice layers. These results establish synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmion lattices as a platform for spin-Hall-like magnon transport beyond a strict bosonic Z2 classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：micromagnetic simulations、linear spin-wave theory、Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian、symmetry analysis）；研究对象：由两个磁织构相反的反铁磁耦合斯格明子晶格层构成的人工反铁磁斯格明子晶格中的类自旋霍尔磁子边缘输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该体系中发现了具有相反层极化的反向传播带隙边缘模，这些模式并非受Z2拓扑保护的螺旋磁子边缘态，而是源于两层斯格明子晶格相反霍尔趋势的层极化类自旋霍尔模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该体系中发现了具有相反层极化的反向传播带隙边缘模，这些模式并非受Z2拓扑保护的螺旋磁子边缘态，而是源于两层斯格明子晶格相反霍尔趋势的层极化类自旋霍尔模式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于微磁模拟获得的弛豫双层织构，在线性自旋波理论框架下构建玻色子Bogoliubov-de Gennes哈密顿量，计算体态和条带磁子能谱；并通过动力学微磁模拟确认层分辨的传播行为。

papers.title: Chirality in Structural Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Chirality, defined by the absence of mirror and inversion symmetries, has attracted considerable attention owing to its unique physical phenomena, including cross-correlated responses such as current-induced magnetization (CIM) and chiral phonons. Recently, it has been established that chirality is characterized by electric toroidal (ET) multipoles: the ET monopole $G_0$ in cubic systems and the ET quadrupole $G_u$ in noncubic systems. In this paper, we investigate achiral-to-chiral (AtC) structural phase transitions driven by atomic displacements and construct $G_{0,u}$ as explicit functions of the displacement order parameter $η$ based on a group-theoretical approach. We show that the leading-order dependence of $G_{0,u}(η)$ is determined by the symmetry of the parent structure and the character of the displacive mode, providing a symmetry-based classification of AtC transitions beyond a binary distinction between achiral and chiral phases. We also demonstrate that $G_{0,u}(η)$ is directly reflected in observable quantities such as CIM and chiral phonon splitting (CPS), both of which scale consistently with $G_{0,u}(η)$. We further clarify the microscopic mechanism by which AtC transitions give rise to chiral phonons and CPS through the coupling between $G_{0,u}(η)$ and phonon degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：group-theoretical approach（群论方法）、construct explicit functions（构建显式函数）、symmetry-based classification（基于对称性的分类）。；研究对象：手性结构相变（achiral-to-chiral structural phase transitions），具体研究由原子位移驱动的非手性到手性（AtC）相变，以及与之相关的电环形多极子（electric toroidal multipoles）、电流诱导磁化（CIM）和手性声子分裂（CPS）等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于群论方法，将电环形多极子 \(G_{0,u}\) 构建为位移序参量 \(\eta\) 的显式函数，发现其主导阶依赖由母体结构对称性和位移模式特征决定，从而提供了超越简单二元分类的AtC相变对称性分类方案；同时，\(G_{0,u}(\eta)\) 可直接反映在CIM和CPS等可观测量中，两者均与 \(G_{0,u}(\eta)\) 一致标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于群论方法，将电环形多极子 \(G_{0,u}\) 构建为位移序参量 \(\eta\) 的显式函数，发现其主导阶依赖由母体结构对称性和位移模式特征决定，从而提供了超越简单二元分类的AtC相变对称性分类方案；同时，\(G_{0,u}(\eta)\) 可直接反映在CIM和CPS等可观测量中，两者均与 \(G_{0,u}(\eta)\) 一致标度。；创新点：提出了基于电环形多极子 \(G_{0,u}(\eta)\) 的AtC相变对称性分类方案，超越了传统仅区分手性与非手性相的二元分类；并阐明了AtC相变通过 \(G_{0,u}(\eta)\) 与声子自由度耦合产生手性声子和CPS的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用群论方法（group-theoretical approach），通过对称性分析构建电环形多极子 \(G_{0,u}\) 作为位移序参量 \(\eta\) 的显式函数，并基于对称性对AtC相变进行分类。摘要未明确说明使用第一性原理计算或数值模拟。

papers.title: Lattice-Trapped Atom Interferometry with a Bose-Einstein condensate: Observation and Control of Interactions
papers.abstract: Precision interferometry with atomic wavepackets confined in a one-dimensional optical lattice is an emergent paradigm in quantum sensing of forces and fields, with applications in gravimetry, accelerometry, geophysics, and fundamental physics tests. We report on the realization of a lattice-trapped interferometer where the two arms are sourced from a weakly-interacting ytterbium Bose-Einstein condensate, coherently split and trapped by pulsed optical standing waves before recombination. We directly observe atomic interactions through contrast changes and phase shifts of the interferometer. By changing either the atom number or the sample volume to vary the density, we demonstrate control over interactions and optimize interferometer performance. Our observations are effectively captured by a mean-field theoretical model of the system. This work experimentally probes the boundary where improved performance from source brightening through higher phase space density transitions into a regime beyond single-atom physics in lattice-trapped atom interferometry, and opens a door to incorporating many-body effects for metrological advances in such platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We report on the realization of”“We directly observe”“we demonstrate control”等表述，描述了实验实现和观测结果。；研究对象：一维光学晶格中囚禁的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）原子干涉仪，具体使用弱相互作用的镱（Ytterbium）BEC作为干涉仪两臂的源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变原子数或样品体积来调控密度，可以直接观测并控制原子相互作用对干涉仪对比度和相位的影响，从而优化干涉仪性能。实验观测结果与平均场理论模型吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变原子数或样品体积来调控密度，可以直接观测并控制原子相互作用对干涉仪对比度和相位的影响，从而优化干涉仪性能。实验观测结果与平均场理论模型吻合。；创新点：该工作实验上探索了从通过提高相空间密度来增强源亮度（改善性能）到超越单原子物理的边界区域，为在晶格囚禁原子干涉仪中引入多体效应以实现计量学进步打开了大门。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用脉冲光学驻波对弱相互作用的镱BEC进行相干分束和囚禁，实现晶格囚禁原子干涉仪；通过改变原子数或样品体积来调控密度，观测相互作用效应。理论上使用平均场模型对系统进行描述。

papers.title: On the Equivariant Learning of the $Q$-tensor Order Parameter
papers.abstract: We construct and evaluate group-equivariant neural networks for the prediction of the two-dimensional $Q$-tensor order parameter of nematic liquid crystals from synthetically generated microscopic textures. Seven architectures, equivariant to cyclic groups $C_k$ of order $k$ for $k=4,\,8,\,16,\,32,\,64,\,128,\, 256$, are built using a combination of weight-sharing constraints, equivariant activations and regularization techniques. To do this, we construct rotation-like permutation matrix groups with elements $\varrho_{C_k}(g)$ that act on row-wise vectorized images, thereby approximating a $\frac{2π}{k}$ rotation of the circular subdomain on square images. We show that all seven equivariant models satisfy the $Q$-tensor equivariance constraint to within single-precision floating point accuracy. Comparing against approximate parameter-matched non-equivariant benchmarks, with and without data augmentation, we find that the equivariant models consistently achieve lower errors and generalize more robustly to unseen defect configurations. Performance increases with group order, suggesting that the incorporation of finer rotational symmetry leads to lower errors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：neural networks、synthetically generated textures、weight-sharing constraints、equivariant activations。；研究对象：向列相液晶的二维Q张量序参量，从合成生成的微观纹理图像中预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建的群等变神经网络模型能够以单精度浮点精度满足Q张量等变约束，且相比非等变基准模型（包括使用数据增强的模型）持续获得更低的预测误差，并对未见过的缺陷构型具有更强的泛化能力；模型性能随群阶数增加而提升。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建的群等变神经网络模型能够以单精度浮点精度满足Q张量等变约束，且相比非等变基准模型（包括使用数据增强的模型）持续获得更低的预测误差，并对未见过的缺陷构型具有更强的泛化能力；模型性能随群阶数增加而提升。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用群等变神经网络架构，通过权重共享约束、等变激活函数和正则化技术构建了七种分别对循环群C_k（k=4,8,16,32,64,128,256）等变的模型。具体构造了作用于行向量化图像的旋转类置换矩阵群，近似实现方形图像上圆形子域的2π/k旋转。

papers.title: Spontaneous breaking of non-invertible symmetries and duality to beyond-Landau transitions
papers.abstract: Spontaneous symmetry breaking is a well-understood mechanism for generating distinct phases of matter. Recently, the notion of symmetry has been broadened to include operations without inverses, leading to the concept of non-invertible symmetries. How do symmetry-breaking phases associated with non-invertible symmetries differ from those arising from conventional invertible symmetries? We address this question using concrete lattice models of the gapped phases with non-invertible Rep($H_8$) symmetry as an example. We find that, despite the symmetry being non-invertible, the symmetry-breaking phases can still be characterized by the long-range correlation of local order parameters, which obey a more general algebraic structure than in the invertible setting. Furthermore, via generalized gauging, certain non-invertible symmetry-breaking transitions can be mapped to deconfined quantum critical points of invertible symmetries, and vice versa. We establish precise conditions under which this duality holds and illustrate them with several families of examples, providing a systematic route to studying beyond-Landau phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：lattice models、generalized gauging、duality。；研究对象：非可逆对称性自发破缺的相及其相变，具体以具有非可逆Rep(H₈)对称性的能隙相为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非可逆对称性的自发破缺相仍可由局域序参量的长程关联来刻画，但序参量服从比可逆对称性情形更一般的代数结构；通过广义规范变换，某些非可逆对称性破缺相变可映射为可逆对称性的退禁闭量子临界点，反之亦然。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非可逆对称性的自发破缺相仍可由局域序参量的长程关联来刻画，但序参量服从比可逆对称性情形更一般的代数结构；通过广义规范变换，某些非可逆对称性破缺相变可映射为可逆对称性的退禁闭量子临界点，反之亦然。；创新点：首次系统建立了非可逆对称性自发破缺相变与超越朗道相变（退禁闭量子临界点）之间的对偶关系，并给出了该对偶成立的精确条件，为研究超越朗道相变提供了系统化途径。
papers.method_zh: 使用具体晶格模型构建具有非可逆Rep(H₈)对称性的能隙相，通过广义规范变换（generalized gauging）建立非可逆对称性破缺相变与可逆对称性退禁闭量子临界点之间的对偶关系，并给出该对偶成立的精确条件。

papers.title: A supersymmetric study of charge and spin transport in Weyl semimetals under axionic electrodynamic response
papers.abstract: We investigate the charge and spin transport properties of a Weyl semimetal under an external magnetic field using a low-energy effective theory. By performing a chiral transformation, we remove the axial term from the fermionic Lagrangian, while its physical effects are retained through the system's electromagnetic response. This response, derived from integrating out the fermionic degrees of freedom, takes the form of axionic electrodynamics and enters the Dirac equation via minimal coupling. The resulting dynamics separate naturally into magnetic and electric components: the magnetic sector admits a supersymmetric factorization, while the electric part exhibits a PT-supersymmetric structure. Robin boundary conditions are applied to the spinor, setting the energy spectrum and defining exact spinor solutions. We obtain the chiral projections of probability and current densities, exhibiting a chiral imbalance in the material. We show that in the x-direction, only one chirality contributes to the chiral current ($j^x_l = 0$). Spin density and currents where also computed. Our results demonstrate how the interplay between axionic response and supersymmetry governs transport phenomena in our specific setup, offering novel insights into the effective field theory description of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：low-energy effective theory（低能有效理论）、supersymmetric factorization（超对称分解）、PT-supersymmetric structure（PT超对称结构）。；研究对象：外磁场下的外尔半金属（Weyl semimetal）中的电荷与自旋输运现象，特别是其轴子电动力学响应（axionic electrodynamic response）与超对称性（supersymmetry）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过手征变换将费米子拉格朗日量中的轴子项转化为系统的电磁响应（轴子电动力学），该响应导致系统的动力学自然分离为具有超对称结构的磁部分和具有PT超对称结构的电部分。研究发现，在特定方向（x方向）上，手征电流仅由单一手性贡献（j^x_l = 0），揭示了材料中的手征不平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过手征变换将费米子拉格朗日量中的轴子项转化为系统的电磁响应（轴子电动力学），该响应导致系统的动力学自然分离为具有超对称结构的磁部分和具有PT超对称结构的电部分。研究发现，在特定方向（x方向）上，手征电流仅由单一手性贡献（j^x_l = 0），揭示了材料中的手征不平衡。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比，但其核心创新在于将外尔半金属中的轴子电动力学响应与超对称性（包括PT超对称性）联系起来，并利用这种结构解析地求解了特定边界条件下的输运性质，揭示了手征电流在特定方向上的选择性贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用低能有效理论框架。具体步骤包括：1）对手征费米子拉格朗日量进行手征变换以移除轴子项；2）通过积分掉费米子自由度得到系统的轴子电动力学电磁响应；3）将该响应通过最小耦合引入狄拉克方程；4）对旋量施加罗宾边界条件（Robin boundary conditions）以求解能谱和精确旋量解；5）计算概率流密度和自旋流密度的手征投影。

papers.title: A method for calculating entropy production without knowing transition rates or dwell times
papers.abstract: The entropy production rate is central to the study of non-equilibrium systems. This parameter is closely connected to violation of time-reversal symmetry, energy consumption, efficiency, and other properties of interest; in short, it quantifies how far a system is from thermodynamic equilibrium. Standard formulas for the entropy production require knowledge of the system's underlying dynamics, but this knowledge may be hard to acquire in practice. Here, I present a method for inferring the entropy production rate of a Markovian system from the sequence of states that the system occupies on a single long trajectory or many shorter trajectories, and the total time of the trajectory or trajectories. The method does not require knowledge of the dwell times in the various states, the times at which transitions occur, or of the transition rates characterizing the Markov process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出了一种推断熵产生率的方法，属于理论推导与数据分析方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：非平衡马尔可夫系统的熵产生率，具体针对状态序列可观测但跃迁速率和驻留时间未知的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种仅从系统占据的状态序列及其总时间即可计算熵产生率的方法，无需知道驻留时间、跃迁时刻或跃迁速率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种仅从系统占据的状态序列及其总时间即可计算熵产生率的方法，无需知道驻留时间、跃迁时刻或跃迁速率。；创新点：该方法突破了传统熵产生率计算需要知道系统微观动力学（如跃迁速率或驻留时间）的限制，仅依赖可观测的状态序列，适用于实际中动力学参数难以获取的场景。
papers.method_zh: 基于马尔可夫过程的状态序列分析，利用单条长轨迹或多条短轨迹的状态序列信息，结合总时间推断熵产生率。

papers.title: Zero modes of non-abelian Dirac operator in topologically non-trivial band insulator
papers.abstract: We show that the local gauge-invariance of the quantum geometric tensor (QGT) defined in the Block-momentum space of a generic $N$-level (sublattice degrees of freedom) band insulator implies the existence of zero modes of non-abelian Dirac operator in such momentum space. Solutions of these zero modes equations in the two-dimensional Brillouin zone torus, in terms of Jacobi Theta function determine the probability amplitudes associated with the $N$-component ground state wave-function under adiabatic approximation in this Hilbert space. These solutions subjected to normalization, defines a complex projective ($CP$) space of $N-1$ dimension ($CP^{N-1}$ space) when one or more degeneracy points exist in the dispersion spectrum of such band-isulator. We show how the non-abelian generalization of the vortexability criterion of Chern bands automatically follows from these zero-mode equations, and also demonstrate their connection with momentum space-version of Lowest landau level algebra. Subsequently we write an Euclidean action from which these zero mode equations follow. We point out that the non-interacting part of different paradigms used to understand fractional Chern insulator(FCI) like phases in a host of two-dimensional material can be understood within this approach. We analyse two effective hamiltonian : lattice Dirac (QZW) model and two-band model for rhombohedral $N$-layer graphene in our propsoed framework and obtain important conclusions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、define、demonstrate、write an Euclidean action、analyse。；研究对象：拓扑非平凡能带绝缘体中的非阿贝尔狄拉克算子的零模，以及与之相关的量子几何张量、分数陈绝缘体（FCI）相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了布洛赫动量空间中量子几何张量的局域规范不变性意味着非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模的存在；这些零模方程的解（用雅可比Theta函数表示）定义了CP^{N-1}空间，并自动导出了陈带的非阿贝尔涡旋判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了布洛赫动量空间中量子几何张量的局域规范不变性意味着非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模的存在；这些零模方程的解（用雅可比Theta函数表示）定义了CP^{N-1}空间，并自动导出了陈带的非阿贝尔涡旋判据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于N能带绝缘体布洛赫动量空间中的量子几何张量，推导非阿贝尔狄拉克算子零模方程；利用雅可比Theta函数在二维布里渊区环面上求解；构建欧几里得作用量；将框架应用于两个有效哈密顿量：晶格狄拉克（QZW）模型和菱面体N层石墨烯的两带模型。

papers.title: MATBG Josephson diode as an universal thermal machine
papers.abstract: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene Josephson junctions (MATBG-JJ) with a gate-tunable valley-polarized weak link exhibit an intrinsic Josephson diode effect originating from broken symmetries associated with valley polarization and band-structure anisotropy. Exploiting this nonreciprocal superconducting platform, we construct quantum Stirling (QSC), Otto (QOC), and Carnot (QCC) thermodynamic cycles, where the valley-polarization potential $Δ_v$ acts as the principal control parameter, in contrast to conventional Josephson thermal machines driven by superconducting phase bias. We systematically compare the performance of MATBG-based Josephson diode thermal machines (MATBG-JDTM) with MATBG-based Josephson junction thermal machines (MATBG-JJTM) and AA-stacked bilayer graphene Josephson junction thermal machines (AABLG-JJTM). Owing to the flat-band-enhanced density of states and electrically tunable nonreciprocal transport in MATBG, both MATBG-JDTM and MATBG-JJTM exhibit significantly enhanced work output and efficiency over a broad operating regime compared to AABLG-JJTM. In particular, the gate-controlled MATBG-JDTM provides a flux-free alternative to conventional phase-driven architectures, mitigating limitations associated with magnetic-flux control and flux-noise effects. Our results establish MATBG Josephson diode platforms as a promising route toward electrically tunable quantum thermal machines and nonreciprocal superconducting caloritronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述构建热力学循环、比较性能、分析机制，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）约瑟夫森二极管，以及基于其构建的量子热机（斯特林、奥托、卡诺循环）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用MATBG约瑟夫森二极管中由谷极化和能带各向异性导致的非互易超导特性，构建了以谷极化势为控制参数的热力学循环，其功输出和效率显著优于基于AA堆叠双层石墨烯的约瑟夫森结热机。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用MATBG约瑟夫森二极管中由谷极化和能带各向异性导致的非互易超导特性，构建了以谷极化势为控制参数的热力学循环，其功输出和效率显著优于基于AA堆叠双层石墨烯的约瑟夫森结热机。；创新点：提出了无需磁通控制的电可调热机方案，利用MATBG的平带增强态密度和电可调非互易输运特性，克服了传统相位驱动架构中磁通控制和磁通噪声的限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论构建量子热力学循环（量子斯特林、奥托、卡诺循环），以谷极化势Δ_v作为主要控制参数，并与传统相位偏置约瑟夫森热机及AA堆叠双层石墨烯约瑟夫森结热机进行性能对比。

papers.title: Relaxation-driven topological domains in moiré materials
papers.abstract: Spatial control of topology is highly desirable for realizing tunable quantum functionalities in materials. Moiré superlattices formed by twisting van der Waals heterostructures provide a natural platform for spatially modulated electronic phases, yet the emergence of tunable topological domains in these systems remains largely unexplored. Here we show that structural relaxation in twisted bilayer BiSb drives the formation of a distinct moiré topological phase, characterized by coexisting topologically nontrivial (Z$_2$ = 1) and trivial (Z$_2$ = 0) domains within a single moiré unit cell. As the twist angle is reduced, relaxation-induced modulation of the interlayer separation stabilizes an expanding network of topological regions embedded within trivial backgrounds of the moiré unit cell. The resulting internal domain boundaries host topologically-protected gapless 1D edge states that are directly visible in our simulated scanning-tunnelling microscopy maps.Furthermore, we demonstrate that the real-space topological domain structure and associated gapless edge states can be reversibly tuned by an out-of-plane electric field. Together, these results establish twisted BiSb as a promising platform for programmable topological domain patterning, where intrinsic networks of edge channels can be continuously tuned and electrically reconfigured in moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章（关键词：simulated scanning-tunnelling microscopy maps、structural relaxation模拟、拓扑不变量Z₂计算）；研究对象：扭曲双层BiSb形成的莫尔超晶格中的拓扑畴结构及其可调性
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结构弛豫驱动扭曲双层BiSb形成单个莫尔原胞内同时存在拓扑非平庸（Z₂=1）和拓扑平庸（Z₂=0）畴的莫尔拓扑相，且畴边界处存在受拓扑保护的1D边缘态，可通过垂直电场可逆调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结构弛豫驱动扭曲双层BiSb形成单个莫尔原胞内同时存在拓扑非平庸（Z₂=1）和拓扑平庸（Z₂=0）畴的莫尔拓扑相，且畴边界处存在受拓扑保护的1D边缘态，可通过垂直电场可逆调控。；创新点：首次在莫尔材料中实现可编程的实空间拓扑畴图案化，并展示其内部边缘态网络可通过电场连续调谐和电学重构。
papers.method_zh: 基于结构弛豫模拟（relaxation-induced modulation of interlayer separation）、拓扑不变量Z₂计算、模拟扫描隧道显微镜（simulated STM maps）图像分析

papers.title: Atomic-Scale Observation of Symmetry Breaking in Altermagnetic MnTe
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of altermagnetism has sparked growing interest in compensated magnetic systems as promising platforms for highly scalable spintronics. Altermagnetism is a distinct magnetic order where opposite spin sublattices are connected by rotation, yielding zero net magnetization but momentum-dependent spin splitting. To date, experimental verification of altermagnetic order has been achieved predominantly through bulk-sensitive techniques, including spin-dependent electronic spectra and transport responses. However, direct atomic-scale evidence that explicitly correlates crystal symmetry, local structural distortions, and magnetic ordering has remained unexplored. Here, we report the direct atomic-scale observation of coexisting polar distortions and altermagnetic order in MnTe, combining atomic resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) imaging with electron magnetic chiral dichroism (EMCD) measurements. We reveal that MnTe is not an ideal uniform P63/mmc g-wave altermagnet at the atomic scale. Instead, it hosts ubiquitous inversion-symmetry-breaking distortions that lower the spin-space-group (SSG) symmetry, admits d-wave altermagnetic components, and in lower-symmetry regimes, even allow s-wave spin splitting (net magnetization). The coexistence of ferroelectric signatures and altermagnetic order establishes local lattice symmetry in MnTe as a control knob for altermagnetic spin splitting, spin current generation, and multiferroic memory applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：atomic resolution scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) imaging, electron magnetic chiral dichroism (EMCD) measurements。；研究对象：反铁磁材料MnTe中的交变磁性（altermagnetism）及其与晶格对称性破缺的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在原子尺度上直接观察到MnTe中同时存在极性畸变和交变磁序，且局域晶格对称性破缺会降低自旋空间群对称性，引入d波甚至s波自旋劈裂（净磁化），表明MnTe并非理想的均匀g波交变磁体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在原子尺度上直接观察到MnTe中同时存在极性畸变和交变磁序，且局域晶格对称性破缺会降低自旋空间群对称性，引入d波甚至s波自旋劈裂（净磁化），表明MnTe并非理想的均匀g波交变磁体。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上直接建立晶格对称性、局域结构畸变与交变磁序之间的明确关联，揭示了理想交变磁体模型中未考虑的局域对称性破缺及其对自旋劈裂模式的调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 结合原子分辨扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）成像与电子磁手性二色性（EMCD）测量。

papers.title: Emergence of an antiferromagnetic topological Anderson insulator in the interacting Haldane model
papers.abstract: We examine the emergence of topological Anderson insulating phases in the spinful Haldane model with Hubbard and next-neighbor density-density interactions, subject to Anderson disorder. Using finite-size exact diagonalization, we characterize the phases that arise from the interplay between topology, interactions, and disorder. In addition to standard $C=2$ topological Anderson phases, we observe an antiferromagnetic $C=1$ topological Anderson phase, consistent with the antiferromagnetic quantum anomalous Hall insulator previously identified in the clean model at finite staggered mass. We further analyze these phases using a neural network trained on the exact diagonalization data. Our results support the hypothesis that an explicit charge imbalance is required to induce the $C=1$ phase, generated by Anderson disorder rather than by a staggered mass.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、neural network（神经网络）。；研究对象：自旋分辨的Haldane模型，包含Hubbard相互作用、次近邻密度-密度相互作用以及Anderson无序，研究拓扑、相互作用与无序共同作用下的物相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标准C=2拓扑Anderson绝缘相之外，还观察到一种反铁磁C=1拓扑Anderson绝缘相，该相与清洁模型中有限交错质量下的反铁磁量子反常霍尔绝缘体一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标准C=2拓扑Anderson绝缘相之外，还观察到一种反铁磁C=1拓扑Anderson绝缘相，该相与清洁模型中有限交错质量下的反铁磁量子反常霍尔绝缘体一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 有限尺寸精确对角化（finite-size exact diagonalization），并利用基于精确对角化数据训练的神经网络进行辅助分析。

papers.title: Inelastic Neutron Scattering of the layered Kitaev ferromagnet Li$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$
papers.abstract: Cobalt-based quantum magnets forming layered honeycomb arrangements have attracted much attention recently, as they are considered as a potential platform for materials with exotic Kitaev spin exchange. Amongst the discussed candidate materials are Na$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ and Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$, both possessing a low-temperature ground state with magnetic zigzag ordering, similar to Na$_2$IrO$_3$ and $α$-RuCl$_3$. Here we report inelastic neutron scattering experiments on the quantum magnet Li$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$, which features ferromagnetic honeycomb planes with opposite magnetizations in neighboring planes. By comparing with linear spin wave theory, we show that the magnetic properties of Li$_3$Co$_2$SbO$_6$ can be well-modelled by an extended Kitaev--Heisenberg model, establishing it as a Kitaev-ferromagnet, or more specifically, as a Kitaev A-type antiferromagnet. Our analysis is complemented by magnetic field measurements and simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：inelastic neutron scattering experiments、magnetic field measurements and simulations）；研究对象：层状Kitaev铁磁体Li₃Co₂SbO₆，一种具有反铁磁型层间耦合的钴基蜂窝状量子磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Li₃Co₂SbO₆的磁性质可由扩展的Kitaev-Heisenberg模型很好地描述，从而将其确立为Kitaev铁磁体（更具体地说是Kitaev A型反铁磁体）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Li₃Co₂SbO₆的磁性质可由扩展的Kitaev-Heisenberg模型很好地描述，从而将其确立为Kitaev铁磁体（更具体地说是Kitaev A型反铁磁体）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非弹性中子散射实验、线性自旋波理论分析、磁场测量与模拟。

papers.title: Quantum criticality of the ferromagnetic Dicke-Ising model
papers.abstract: We describe the quantum phase transitions in the ferromagnetic Dicke-Ising model using a Landau theory approach. The theory quantitatively captures the change from a second- to a first-order transition between the normal and superradiant phases through a tricritical point. We identify virtual correlated nearest-neighbor double spin-flip processes as the crucial mechanism responsible for this behavior. The tricritical point constitutes a quantum phase transition above the upper critical dimension. We discuss the modifications to finite-size scaling required for the correct interpretation of numerical data at the tricritical point. Our results emphasize the need for adapted finite-size scaling forms in all-to-all interacting quantum systems and establish the ferromagnetic Dicke-Ising model as a paradigmatic platform for quantum phase transitions above the upper critical dimension, encompassing both standard $φ^4$ criticality and beyond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Landau theory approach”（朗道理论方法）、“finite-size scaling”（有限尺寸标度）等理论分析工具，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：铁磁Dicke-Ising模型中的量子相变，具体关注正常相与超辐射相之间的相变行为，以及三临界点处的量子临界性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型中的量子相变从二级相变转变为一级相变，通过一个三临界点实现；该三临界点位于上临界维度之上，需要修正有限尺寸标度才能正确解释数值数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型中的量子相变从二级相变转变为一级相变，通过一个三临界点实现；该三临界点位于上临界维度之上，需要修正有限尺寸标度才能正确解释数值数据。；创新点：揭示了虚拟关联最近邻双自旋翻转过程是导致相变级次改变的关键机制；指出在全连接量子系统中需要采用适配的有限尺寸标度形式，并将铁磁Dicke-Ising模型确立为研究上临界维度以上量子相变（包括标准φ⁴临界性及超越）的范例平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用朗道理论框架进行解析分析，识别出虚拟关联最近邻双自旋翻转过程作为关键机制，并讨论了上临界维度以上三临界点处有限尺寸标度的修正形式。

papers.title: Atomic Structure of Amorphous Optical Coatings of TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$ by Grazing-Incidence Total X-ray Scattering Measurements
papers.abstract: Reducing coating thermal noise in future gravitational-wave detectors requires identifying the atomic motifs that control mechanical loss in amorphous optical coatings. We combine grazing-incidence X-ray pair distribution function measurements with atomic-structure modeling to study amorphous TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$ films over Ti cation concentrations from $\sim$11 % to $\sim$48 %, before and after annealing. The structural analysis reveals systematic composition- and annealing-dependent changes in short- and intermediate-range order. Increasing Ti content raises the average Ti coordination and promotes edge- and face-sharing polyhedral connections, while Ge remains predominantly fourfold coordinated. Annealing reduces these compact shared-polyhedron motifs and sharpens the first sharp diffraction peak, indicating a more relaxed intermediate-range network. Among the structural descriptors examined, the clearest correlation with the annealing-induced reduction in mechanical loss is the decrease in edge- and face-sharing polyhedra. These results connect composition, annealing, atomic structure, and mechanical dissipation in TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$, providing microscopic guidance for optimizing low-noise mirror coatings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：grazing-incidence X-ray pair distribution function measurements、atomic-structure modeling、实验与建模结合）；研究对象：非晶TiO₂掺杂GeO₂光学薄膜（Ti阳离子浓度约11%至约48%），用于引力波探测器减反射涂层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退火处理减少了非晶TiO₂掺杂GeO₂薄膜中边缘共享和面共享多面体连接，这种结构变化与机械损耗的降低呈现最清晰的相关性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退火处理减少了非晶TiO₂掺杂GeO₂薄膜中边缘共享和面共享多面体连接，这种结构变化与机械损耗的降低呈现最清晰的相关性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 掠入射X射线对分布函数测量（GIXPDF）结合原子结构建模，分析不同Ti掺杂浓度及退火前后薄膜的短程和中程有序结构。

papers.title: Competition for Survival and the Maximum Entropy Production Principle in Self-Organized Silver Particle Chains
papers.abstract: The maximum entropy production (MEP) principle is a hypothetical law of physics which dictates that complex systems, far from equilibrium, evolve into an ordered dissipative structure (DS) which generates as much entropy per second as possible. An important problem is whether the natural competition for resources, limits the ability of DS to achieve the maximum of the entropy production rate (EPR). We investigate this competition between DS by performing high precision electrical measurements on suspensions of silver particles under electric fields. To establish the impact of competition on MEP principle, precise electrical measurements are performed on two Ag suspension samples connected in parallel. The samples are able to self-organize, dissipate energy, generate entropy, and compete with each other for resources, i.e., electrical current. Our findings are as follows: (1) There is a competition between the two samples, which prevents both systems from achieving their maximum possible contribution to the global entropy production rate. (2) Due to this competition, we find that only one out of two samples can self-organize, while the other deteriorates and approaches zero EPR. (3) The global EPR, i.e., the entropy produced by the samples and the energy supply circuit, is also reduced from its possible maximum due to the competition between the sub-systems. Based on these observations, we propose that the competition effect constitutes an essential constraint that must be incorporated into formulations of the MEP. This principle parallels real-world phenomena, reflecting the competition for resources observed among species and individual organisms in natural systems. We also examine the global implications of the MEP and propose that it serves as a driving mechanism propelling the hypothetical ascent of civilizations along the Kardashev scale.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“performing high precision electrical measurements”、“precise electrical measurements are performed on two Ag suspension samples connected in parallel”。；研究对象：银颗粒悬浮液在电场作用下自组织形成的耗散结构链，以及两个并联样品之间的竞争行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个自组织银颗粒链样品之间存在对电流资源的竞争，这种竞争阻止了每个子系统达到其最大熵产生率，并导致全局熵产生率也低于可能的最大值。竞争效应应被视为最大熵产生原理的一个必要约束条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个自组织银颗粒链样品之间存在对电流资源的竞争，这种竞争阻止了每个子系统达到其最大熵产生率，并导致全局熵产生率也低于可能的最大值。竞争效应应被视为最大熵产生原理的一个必要约束条件。；创新点：通过实验直接展示了多个耗散结构之间对资源的竞争如何限制最大熵产生原理的实现，并指出竞争效应是该原理的一个本质约束。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 高精度电学测量：对两个并联的银颗粒悬浮液样品施加电场，测量其自组织过程中的电流和熵产生率变化。

papers.title: High-temperature instability of artificial cuprorivaite: a study using thermal analysis, X-ray powder diffractometry and polarized light microscopy
papers.abstract: CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ powder was studied by differential scanning calorimetry and thermogravimetry methods in the range from room temperature to 1450$\,^{\circ}$C at heating and cooling rates of 20$\,^{\circ}$C/min. The process of decomposition of cuprorivaite, the composition and transformations of its decomposition products during successive heat treatments were also studied by powder X-ray diffraction and polarization optical microscopy techniques. It was found that CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ starts to decompose by incongruent melting at a temperature of about 1020$\,^{\circ}$C, with the minimum of the endothermic DSC peak associated with this process being at 1064.4$\,^{\circ}$C. CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ decomposes irreversibly and subsequent cyclic annealings up to a temperature of 1450$\,^{\circ}$C at heating and cooling rates of 20$\,^{\circ}$C/min do not cause its re-synthesis. CaCuSi$_4$O$_{10}$ transforms into a two-phase system consisting of acicular crystals of monoclinic tridymite fused with green glass with the composition CuO$\,-\,$Cu$_2$O$\,-\,$CaO$\,-\,$SiO$_2$, with the weight ratio of tridymite to glass being about $12:13$, as a result of two successive annealings up to the temperature of 1450$\,^{\circ}$C.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了差示扫描量热法（DSC）、热重分析（TG）、粉末X射线衍射（XRD）和偏光显微镜（PLM）等实验手段。；研究对象：人工合成的硅碱钙石（cuprorivaite，化学式CaCuSi₄O₁₀）粉末的高温不稳定性及其分解过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CaCuSi₄O₁₀在约1020°C开始发生不一致熔融分解，分解过程不可逆，后续循环退火至1450°C无法使其重新合成。最终分解产物为单斜鳞石英针状晶体与含CuO-Cu₂O-CaO-SiO₂的绿色玻璃构成的两相体系，鳞石英与玻璃的质量比约为12:13。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CaCuSi₄O₁₀在约1020°C开始发生不一致熔融分解，分解过程不可逆，后续循环退火至1450°C无法使其重新合成。最终分解产物为单斜鳞石英针状晶体与含CuO-Cu₂O-CaO-SiO₂的绿色玻璃构成的两相体系，鳞石英与玻璃的质量比约为12:13。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 差示扫描量热法（DSC）与热重分析（TG），升温/降温速率20°C/min，温度范围室温至1450°C；粉末X射线衍射（XRD）用于鉴定分解产物及其相变；偏光显微镜（PLM）用于观察产物形貌。

papers.title: Dirac-Line Criticality and Emergent Horizons in Weyl Lifshitz Transitions
papers.abstract: Type-II Weyl fermions may emerge behind the event horizon of black holes. We employ the Painlevé-Gullstrand metric to study the surface of the Lifshitz transition at the horizon, equivalent to the interface separating the type-I and type-II Weyl states. We find several analogies between the black hole horizon and the transformation of type-I to type-II Weyl fermions through the Dirac line. We analyze the symmetry-protected topological order at the Lifshitz transition originating in semimetals. The emergence of Hawking radiation in Weyl semimetals is discussed. We show that the transition state from type-I to type-II Dirac fermions can be viewed as a black-hole horizon, which exhibits unique characteristics, including a Dirac-line Fermi surface with a nontrivial topological invariant and a critical chiral anomaly effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们采用...度量”、“我们分析...拓扑序”、“我们讨论...”等理论分析框架和类比推理的表述，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：Weyl半金属中从第一类（type-I）到第二类（type-II）Weyl费米子的Lifshitz相变，以及该相变界面与黑洞视界的理论类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 第一类到第二类Weyl费米子的转变界面（即Lifshitz相变面）可以类比为黑洞的事件视界，该转变态具有独特的Dirac-line费米面、非平凡拓扑不变量以及临界手征反常效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：第一类到第二类Weyl费米子的转变界面（即Lifshitz相变面）可以类比为黑洞的事件视界，该转变态具有独特的Dirac-line费米面、非平凡拓扑不变量以及临界手征反常效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其核心创新在于将黑洞视界的几何描述（Painlevé-Gullstrand度规）与凝聚态物理中的Lifshitz相变界面进行精确类比，并预言了该转变态特有的拓扑和输运性质（如Dirac-line费米面和临界手征反常）。
papers.method_zh: 采用Painlevé-Gullstrand度规（一种常用于描述黑洞时空的坐标系统）来理论分析Weyl半金属中Lifshitz相变界面（即第一类与第二类Weyl态的分界面）的物理性质。

papers.title: A cryogenic apparatus for coupling two-dimensional materials to a confocal multimode optical cavity
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals materials exhibit a variety of correlated electron phases, and optical driving offers a promising route toward manipulating them. For example, cavity-enhanced, continuous-wave (CW) Raman excitation has been suggested as a way to coherently and superradiantly populate phonons or charge density waves via material excitons. A steady-state phonon population may be sustained with sufficiently strong electron-phonon coupling to drive novel collective response. We describe an apparatus built to meet the requirements of such an experimental program: Namely, an ultrahigh-vacuum system housing a length-tunable confocal Fabry-Pérot cavity with an intracavity sample, both cryogenically cooled and stabilized against vibrations. A four-axis nanopositioner aligns the sample and supports electrical leads for sample carrier density modulation and transport measurements. Transmission through the multimode cavity enables in situ sample imaging for alignment; the sample is a transition metal dichalcogenide in this work. Operating near the confocal geometry concentrates the optical field into a localized supermode that substantially enhances light-matter coupling. This enhancement is preserved despite the millimeter-scale cavity length, which provides room for sample alignment and exchange.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“apparatus”（装置）、“built”（搭建）、“ultrahigh-vacuum system”（超高真空系统）、“nanopositioner”（纳米定位器）等，描述了具体的实验设备搭建。；研究对象：二维范德华材料（具体为过渡金属硫族化合物）与光学腔的耦合系统，以及通过光驱动（特别是腔增强连续波拉曼激发）操控其关联电子相（如声子或电荷密度波）的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现，主要描述了一套为研究腔增强拉曼激发而设计的低温实验装置的搭建和性能。该装置通过共焦多模腔结构，在毫米级腔长下仍能显著增强光-物质耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理发现，主要描述了一套为研究腔增强拉曼激发而设计的低温实验装置的搭建和性能。该装置通过共焦多模腔结构，在毫米级腔长下仍能显著增强光-物质耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该工作相对于已有研究的理论或物理创新点，其核心贡献在于设计并实现了一套满足特定实验需求（腔增强连续波拉曼激发）的低温、超高真空、可调腔长且具备原位电学测量能力的实验装置。
papers.method_zh: 实验装置搭建。具体包括：一套超高真空系统，内含一个长度可调的共焦法布里-珀罗腔，样品置于腔内；整个系统低温冷却并进行了振动稳定化处理；使用四轴纳米定位器进行样品对准并集成电引线，用于载流子密度调制和输运测量；通过多模腔的透射光实现原位样品成像对准。

papers.title: How reproducible are first-principles simulations of liquid water?
papers.abstract: Liquid water is fundamentally important, and its accurate computer simulation has been the driving force for myriad methodological developments. Ab initio molecular dynamics with forces obtained from density functional theory (DFT) is now a standard tool widely used by researchers. However, we reveal that previous studies of liquid water using the same widely-used density functional (revPBE-D3) exhibit significant discrepancies with one another, varying by over 20% in the diffusion coefficient and 10% in the density, raising fundamental questions about reproducibility. By combining modern long-range machine-learning interatomic potentials that enable robust statistical sampling with carefully converged DFT training data, we resolve these discrepancies, achieving consensus across six diverse community codes. Our predictions differ markedly from previous literature: we show that most previous results overestimate the density and underestimate the diffusion coefficient of revPBE-D3 water due to basis set incompleteness and pseudopotential inconsistencies, coupled with limitations in statistical sampling (in some cases). These benchmark values provide a reliable reference for validating current and future implementations of DFT-based ab initio molecular dynamics. Reaching agreement establishes confidence and credibility and serves as a prerequisite for the systematic assessment of new density functionals and numerical approximations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles simulations、ab initio molecular dynamics、density functional theory (DFT)、machine-learning interatomic potentials。；研究对象：液态水（liquid water），具体为使用revPBE-D3密度泛函描述的液态水体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 以往使用相同密度泛函（revPBE-D3）对液态水的第一性原理模拟结果之间存在显著差异（扩散系数差异超过20%，密度差异超过10%），而通过结合现代长程机器学习原子间势与收敛的DFT训练数据，可以消除这些差异，得到跨六个不同社区代码的一致基准结果，且该结果与以往文献显著不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：以往使用相同密度泛函（revPBE-D3）对液态水的第一性原理模拟结果之间存在显著差异（扩散系数差异超过20%，密度差异超过10%），而通过结合现代长程机器学习原子间势与收敛的DFT训练数据，可以消除这些差异，得到跨六个不同社区代码的一致基准结果，且该结果与以往文献显著不同。；创新点：揭示了同一密度泛函（revPBE-D3）下液态水模拟结果不可重复的严重问题，并首次通过机器学习势与收敛DFT数据的结合，解决了这一长期存在的分歧，提供了可靠的基准值。摘要未突出说明具体代码名称或机器学习势的架构细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）中的revPBE-D3泛函进行第一性原理分子动力学模拟，并利用长程机器学习原子间势（long-range machine-learning interatomic potentials）实现稳健的统计采样，同时结合经过仔细收敛的DFT训练数据。最终通过六个不同的社区代码进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Three-dimensional orbital-free density functional theory description of nuclear pasta in the inner crust of neutron stars
papers.abstract: Background: In the bottom layer of the inner crust of neutron stars, various crystalline structures are expected to emerge that are collectively called ``nuclear pasta.'' It is desired to know properties of nuclear pasta in a wide variety of conditions for astrophysical applications. However, three-dimensional fully-microscopic calculations require huge computational effort that makes it still challenging to carry out systematic calculations. Purpose: In this paper, we propose an efficient method to calculate various nuclear pasta configurations in a non-empirical manner, based on three-dimensional orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT). We demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach by applying it to densities throughout the inner crust of neutron stars. Methods: As a first application of OF-DFT for nuclear pasta, we employ the second-order extended Thomas-Fermi (ETF) expansion of Skyrme energy density functional (EDF) to construct an EDF that depends only on neutron and proton number densities. Based on the variational principle, we derive Euler-Lagrange equations to determine optimal neutron and proton density distributions and solve them self-consistently. In this work, we call this approach the self-consistent ETF (SC-ETF) method. Results: We perform three-dimensional SC-ETF calculations with various box sizes. We successfully obtain various pasta structures, depending on given average nucleon number densities, consistent with earlier studies. Moreover, we find other exotic structures, such as bending and/or connected rods, slabs with a hole, etc., underlining the advantage of the self-consistent formalism. Conclusions: We demonstrate that the SC-ETF method proposed in this study, which can be regarded as a realization of OF-DFT, is a promising tool that can efficiently describe complex pasta structures without empirical assumptions on geometric shapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“orbital-free density functional theory (OF-DFT)”、“self-consistent ETF (SC-ETF) method”等理论计算方法，并进行了三维数值计算。；研究对象：中子星内壳底层的“核意面”（nuclear pasta）结构，即各种晶体状核物质构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于三维无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）的自洽扩展Thomas-Fermi（SC-ETF）方法能够高效、非经验地描述多种核意面结构，包括弯曲/连接的棒状、带孔板状等奇异构型，且结果与早期研究一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于三维无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）的自洽扩展Thomas-Fermi（SC-ETF）方法能够高效、非经验地描述多种核意面结构，包括弯曲/连接的棒状、带孔板状等奇异构型，且结果与早期研究一致。；创新点：首次将无轨道密度泛函理论（OF-DFT）应用于核意面计算，提出无需对几何形状做经验假设的自洽形式（SC-ETF），能够自动发现弯曲、连接等复杂构型，克服了传统全微观三维计算计算量巨大的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 采用Skyrme能量密度泛函（EDF）的二阶扩展Thomas-Fermi（ETF）展开，构建仅依赖于中子与质子数密度的能量密度泛函；基于变分原理导出Euler-Lagrange方程，自洽求解最优密度分布（即SC-ETF方法），并在不同盒子尺寸下进行三维计算。

papers.title: Heatomics
papers.abstract: Living cells are energy- and information-processing systems that sustain a nonequilibrium steady state (NESS) by continuously consuming energy and dissipating heat, as required by the second law of thermodynamics. The rate of heat dissipation, or the entropy production rate $σ$, is the universal primal life signal and a unique descriptor of the cellular state. Living matter dissipates $P_{\mathrm{life}} \sim 1$ Watt/kilogram (W/kg), a remarkably conserved value across scales, from molecular reactions to entire organisms. Surprisingly, this high power density is $10^{4}$ times larger than that of the Sun and comparable to the universe's average, $P_U = c^2 H_0 \sim 1$ W/kg, where $c$ is the speed of light and $H_0$ the Hubble constant, a striking coincidence that aligns with Dirac's large number hypothesis. We hypothesize that this large $P_{\mathrm{life}}$ sets the scale for generating negentropy, the negative contribution to the overall positive $σ$ that sustains biological organization, distinguishing animate from inanimate matter. Here, I introduce heatomics, the science of studying $σ$ at the cellular and molecular scales, and the Variance Sum Rule, an experimental--theoretical framework that extracts $σ$ from fluctuations of a dynamical probe combined with the equation of state for a NESS. The emerging field of heatomics aims to elucidate the fundamental principles governing heat power generation, optimization of energy resources, and negentropy in living systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：introduce、hypothesize、experimental–theoretical framework、Variance Sum Rule）；研究对象：活细胞中热耗散率（熵产生率σ）及其与生命状态、宇宙平均功率密度的关系，以及由此提出的“heatomics”学科。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 生命物质的热耗散功率密度（约1 W/kg）是太阳的10⁴倍，且与宇宙平均功率密度（c²H₀ ≈ 1 W/kg）惊人一致，这一巧合与狄拉克大数假说相符。该功率密度为生命系统产生“负熵”提供了尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：生命物质的热耗散功率密度（约1 W/kg）是太阳的10⁴倍，且与宇宙平均功率密度（c²H₀ ≈ 1 W/kg）惊人一致，这一巧合与狄拉克大数假说相符。该功率密度为生命系统产生“负熵”提供了尺度。；创新点：首次系统提出“heatomics”这一研究细胞和分子尺度熵产生率σ的新学科，并揭示了生命热耗散功率密度与宇宙平均功率密度之间的数值巧合及其可能蕴含的物理意义。
papers.method_zh: 提出了“Variance Sum Rule”这一实验-理论框架，通过动力学探针的涨落结合非平衡稳态（NESS）的状态方程来提取熵产生率σ。

papers.title: Formation of bound composite vortices of a singly-quantized $^1$S$_0$ vortex and half-quantized $^3$P$_2$ vortices in the $^1$S$_0$-$^3$P$_2$ coexisting phase in neutron stars
papers.abstract: Pulsar glitches are believed to originate from the dynamics of quantized vortices in the neutron superfluid interior. The outer core of a neutron star hosts a $^3\text{P}_2$ spin-triplet superfluid, whose half-integer quantum vortices (HQVs) are qualitatively different from the $^1\text{S}_0$ singly quantized vortices (SQVs) in the inner crust. It has recently been proposed that the coupling between these two vortex species gives rise to a large-scale vortex network, providing a candidate mechanism for the diversity of observed pulsar glitch phenomena. Using the Gross--Pitaevskii equations for the $^1\text{S}_0$ and $^3\text{P}_2$ condensates, we perform two-dimensional simulations of one SQV and two HQVs in a coexistence phase near the crust-core boundary, varying the density--density and Josephson coupling constants. We find that the Josephson term, arising from the relative phase between the two condensates, induces a strong attractive interaction between the two HQVs and the SQV, which dominates over the density--density coupling. When pinning potentials are applied to the HQVs and the SQV at spatially separated locations, this attraction is found to be sufficiently strong to drive vortex depinning. These results suggest that two HQVs and one SQV can form a tightly bound composite vortex at the crust-core boundary, with implications for the glitch mechanism in neutron stars.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用Gross–Pitaevskii方程进行二维数值模拟。；研究对象：中子星内部$^1$S$_0$超流与$^3$P$_2$超流共存相中，单量子化涡旋（SQV）与半量子化涡旋（HQV）之间的相互作用及复合涡旋的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 约瑟夫森耦合项在$^1$S$_0$与$^3$P$_2$凝聚体之间诱导出强吸引作用，使两个HQV与一个SQV形成紧密结合的复合涡旋；该吸引力足以驱动涡旋从钉扎势中脱钉，可能影响中子星脉冲星自转突变（glitch）机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：约瑟夫森耦合项在$^1$S$_0$与$^3$P$_2$凝聚体之间诱导出强吸引作用，使两个HQV与一个SQV形成紧密结合的复合涡旋；该吸引力足以驱动涡旋从钉扎势中脱钉，可能影响中子星脉冲星自转突变（glitch）机制。；创新点：首次在$^1$S$_0$-$^3$P$_2$共存相中明确揭示约瑟夫森耦合对涡旋束缚的主导作用，并证明该强吸引可克服空间分离的钉扎势，形成紧密束缚的复合涡旋，为解释脉冲星glitch现象的多样性提供了新的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于$^1$S$_0$和$^3$P$_2$凝聚体的Gross–Pitaevskii方程，在二维空间中对一个SQV和两个HQV进行数值模拟，并改变密度-密度耦合常数与约瑟夫森耦合常数。

papers.title: Orbital Altermagnetic Photonic Crystal
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism features momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, extending spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism. However, the photonic realization of altermagnetism has remained a formidable challenge due to the fundamental differences between fermionic electrons and bosonic photons. Here, we report the first experimental realization of an orbital altermagnetic photonic crystal, based on an antiunitary $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry enforced correspondence between a local $p$-orbital $σ/π$ doublet and crystal momentum. We experimentally demonstrate that the resulting system exhibits momentum-dependent spin splitting with alternating pseudospin polarization and a $d_{xy}$-wave form factor, as confirmed by measured band structures and iso-frequency contours. Moreover, we show that the orbital altermagnetic photonic crystal supports unique pseudospin-selective transport of electromagnetic waves, including photonic pseudospin splitting and pseudospin filtering. Our results extend the field of alternagnetism to photonic systems, opening a new avenue for designing spinphotonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“first experimental realization”（首次实验实现）、“measured band structures”（测量能带结构）等关键词。；研究对象：轨道交变磁性光子晶体（Orbital Altermagnetic Photonic Crystal）。具体体系是基于反幺正 \( C_{4z}\mathcal{T} \) 对称性构建的、具有局域 \( p \) 轨道 \( \sigma/\pi \) 二重态的光子晶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在实验上实现了光子体系中的交变磁性（altermagnetism），证明了该光子晶体具有动量依赖的自旋劈裂、交替的赝自旋极化以及 \( d_{xy} \)-波形式因子，并展示了独特的赝自旋选择性电磁波输运（包括赝自旋劈裂和赝自旋滤波）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在实验上实现了光子体系中的交变磁性（altermagnetism），证明了该光子晶体具有动量依赖的自旋劈裂、交替的赝自旋极化以及 \( d_{xy} \)-波形式因子，并展示了独特的赝自旋选择性电磁波输运（包括赝自旋劈裂和赝自旋滤波）。；创新点：将交变磁性（altermagnetism）的概念从费米子（电子）体系首次拓展到玻色子（光子）体系，实现了光子交变磁性，为设计自旋光子学器件开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过测量能带结构和等频轮廓来表征系统的性质。理论框架基于反幺正 \( C_{4z}\mathcal{T} \) 对称性，该对称性将局域 \( p \) 轨道的 \( \sigma/\pi \) 二重态与晶体动量联系起来。

papers.title: Thermodynamic-limit dispersion relations on trapped-ion quantum hardware
papers.abstract: We run a numerical linked-cluster expansion with a quantum algorithm (NLCE+QA), computing ground-state energies and one quasi-particle dispersions in the thermodynamic limit using a 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum processing unit (QPU). The NLCE+QA framework extracts thermodynamic-limit properties from small-cluster calculations, making it naturally suited for near-term quantum devices. Projector-based block-diagonalization schemes such as projective cluster-additive transformation (PCAT) are essential to NLCE+QA, and they involve matrix inversion and square root operations that amplify measurement noise. A central question is therefore whether current hardware can provide expectation values that are accurate enough to withstand non-linear classical post-processing. We explore this challenge for the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) in one dimension, on a ladder geometry, as well as in a longitudinal field in one dimension. For the quantum algorithm, we consider adiabatic state preparation (ASP), as well as a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) trained on a classical device. The final expectation values are obtained from the QPU, using a novel alternative to the Hadamard test that we name the CX-test. We explore the regimes currently attainable on quantum devices and comment on the improvements needed for quantum computers to achieve results beyond classical reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。关键词：quantum algorithm、trapped-ion quantum processing unit (QPU)、numerical linked-cluster expansion (NLCE)、adiabatic state preparation (ASP)、variational quantum eigensolver (VQE)。；研究对象：横场伊辛模型（TFIM）在一维、梯子几何以及一维纵场下的热力学极限基态能量和单准粒子色散关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在20量子比特的离子阱量子处理器上，通过数值链接簇展开结合量子算法（NLCE+QA）成功提取了热力学极限下的基态能量和准粒子色散，并验证了当前硬件在非经典后处理（如矩阵求逆和开平方）下仍能提供足够精度的期望值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在20量子比特的离子阱量子处理器上，通过数值链接簇展开结合量子算法（NLCE+QA）成功提取了热力学极限下的基态能量和准粒子色散，并验证了当前硬件在非经典后处理（如矩阵求逆和开平方）下仍能提供足够精度的期望值。；创新点：首次在真实离子阱量子硬件上实现NLCE+QA框架，并引入CX-test作为Hadamard测试的替代方案，系统评估了当前量子设备在非线性经典后处理下的噪声容忍度。
papers.method_zh: 数值链接簇展开结合量子算法（NLCE+QA），使用投影簇可加变换（PCAT）进行块对角化；量子算法采用绝热态制备（ASP）和经典训练的变分量子本征求解器（VQE）；测量方案采用新型CX-test替代Hadamard测试。

papers.title: Surface Contact Approximation for Magneto-Thermal Finite Element Analysis of No-Insulation HTS Coils
papers.abstract: High-temperature superconducting (HTS) coated conductors (CCs) can be wound into no-insulation (NI) coils, in which electrical current can partially bypass local normal zones via turn-to-turn contact layers (T2TCLs). Accurate magneto-thermal simulation of such coils, therefore, requires an efficient representation of the electrical and thermal behavior of the T2TCLs. This paper introduces a magneto-thermal surface contact approximation (SCA) for finite element analysis of NI HTS coils. The formulation is derived as a special case of the more general thin shell approximation (TSA) by introducing suitable approximations such as negligible tangential surface currents and eddy-current effects inside the T2TCL. The resulting SCA formulation replaces the thin volumetric contact layer with a dedicated surface weak formulation based on the electric contact resistance and thermal contact conductance. In contrast, the TSA formulation requires the definition of electric resistivities and thermal conductivities as well as the thickness of the T2TCL. The SCA is implemented in the Pancake3D module of the free and open-source Finite Element Quench Simulator. It is verified through transient magneto-thermal simulations of a model NI pancake coil. Numerical results are compared against the established TSA formulation. The results show that the SCA accurately reproduces the relevant electromagnetic and thermal behavior.
