We employ fitting of elemental phase reference energies to zero-temperature total energies for improved calculation of formation enthalpies, along with machine-learned interatomic potentials for rapid determination of vibrational entropy and heat capacity. The resulting predominance diagrams can be intuitively understood by experimentalists and can be used to translate energies above stability hulls into synthesis conditions. Predominance diagrams are generated for selected oxide, nitride, sulfide, and phosphide systems, as well as for 48 more complex ternary metal phosphosulfide systems. The calculated predominance diagrams generally show good agreement with the experimental synthesis literature, with a drastic reduction in computational cost compared to a conventional approach relying on DFT-based phonon calculations. We identify several compounds predicted to be stable under well-defined thermodynamic windows, even though they appear as metastable in a zero-temperature stability hull picture. The method can be applied to rapidly estimate synthesis conditions for any inorganic material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“first principles”、“high-throughput generation”、“machine-learned interatomic potentials”、“DFT-based phonon calculations”。；研究对象：无机材料的合成条件窗口，具体包括氧化物、氮化物、硫化物、磷化物以及三元金属磷硫化物体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于第一性原理的高通量方法，能够快速生成材料在不同温度和气体分压下的相优势图，从而将零温稳定性凸包上的亚稳态材料与实验可实现的合成条件联系起来，显著降低计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于第一性原理的高通量方法，能够快速生成材料在不同温度和气体分压下的相优势图，从而将零温稳定性凸包上的亚稳态材料与实验可实现的合成条件联系起来，显著降低计算成本。；创新点：通过拟合元素相参考能到零温总能来提升生成焓计算精度，并利用机器学习势能加速振动熵和热容的获取，从而在保持与实验良好一致的前提下，大幅降低传统基于DFT声子计算的计算成本。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（零温总能）拟合元素相参考能，以改进生成焓计算；结合机器学习原子间势能快速计算振动熵和热容；生成温度与气体反应物分压的函数相优势图。

papers.title: Identifying and designing altermagnetic crystals in real space
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism is a compensated magnetic phase characterized by zero net magnetization and exchange-driven spin splitting. However, identifying altermagnets among collinear antiferromagnets usually requires full magnetic-space-group or spin-group analysis, which is not intuitive. Here we formulate a simple real-space criterion based on how the crystallographic operations of the host nonmagnetic structure permute the two opposite-spin sublattices. For simplicity, we focus on collinear compensated antiferromagnets commonly described by type-III magnetic space groups, whose magnetic primitive cell coincides with the host nonmagnetic crystallographic primitive cell. In this class, altermagnetic spin splitting is generally allowed unless inversion operation exists which transfer between the two opposite-spin sublattices. First-principles calculations on representative noncentrosymmetric and centrosymmetric materials demonstrate these criterions. Similar rules can also be applied to low-dimensional crystals or pseudocrystals. Our work reduces the identification of altermagnetism to a transparent real-space symmetry test and provides a practical route for discovering altermagnetic crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“formulate a simple real-space criterion”（提出实空间判据）和“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：交变磁性（altermagnetism）晶体，具体针对共线补偿反铁磁体中由III类磁空间群描述的材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个简单的实空间判据：在共线补偿反铁磁体中，若存在将两个自旋相反的子格相互交换的反演操作，则禁止交变磁自旋劈裂；否则，交变磁自旋劈裂通常被允许。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个简单的实空间判据：在共线补偿反铁磁体中，若存在将两个自旋相反的子格相互交换的反演操作，则禁止交变磁自旋劈裂；否则，交变磁自旋劈裂通常被允许。；创新点：将交变磁性的识别从完整的磁空间群或自旋群分析简化为直观的实空间对称性检验，并推广至低维晶体或赝晶体。
papers.method_zh: 基于晶体学操作对两个自旋相反子格的置换关系，建立实空间对称性判据；并通过代表性非中心对称和中心对称材料的第一性原理计算验证该判据。

papers.title: Subdiffusion equation with Cattaneo effect
papers.abstract: The ordinary subdiffusion equation, with a fractional time derivative of at most first order, describes a process in which the propagation velocity of diffusing molecules is unlimited. To avoid this non-physical property different forms of the Cattaneo subdiffusion equation have been proposed. We define the Cattaneo effect as a delay of the ordinary subdiffusion flux activation by a random time. By incorporating this effect into the flux equation we get a Cattaneo--type subdiffusion equation (CTSE). We consider a subdiffusion process in which the Cattaneo effect is generated by the time-delay probability distribution controlled by the Mittag-Leffler function. Then, CTSE differs from the ordinary subdiffusion equation by a term with a fractional time derivative, whose order can be independent of the subdiffusion exponent. The influence of the Cattaneo effect on the solutions to the CTSE is discussed. We show that the process described by CTSE is subdiffusion in the entire time domain even though the temporal evolution of the mean square displacement of diffusing particle in the short-time limit is typical for superdiffusion. The delay in the flux activation in the subdiffusion equation should also cause a flux delay in a boundary condition. As an example, we study subdiffusion with the Cattaneo effect in a system with a partially absorbing wall at which the Robin boundary condition is assumed. We also propose a method for experimentally identifying the Cattaneo effect in a subdiffusive system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：定义、方程、讨论、提出方法。；研究对象：亚扩散过程中的Cattaneo效应（即亚扩散通量激活的随机时间延迟），以及该效应对亚扩散方程及其解的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入由Mittag-Leffler函数控制的时间延迟概率分布后，得到的Cattaneo型亚扩散方程（CTSE）在短时间极限下，扩散粒子的均方位移时间演化表现出超扩散特征，但整个过程仍属于亚扩散。此外，通量延迟也应体现在边界条件中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入由Mittag-Leffler函数控制的时间延迟概率分布后，得到的Cattaneo型亚扩散方程（CTSE）在短时间极限下，扩散粒子的均方位移时间演化表现出超扩散特征，但整个过程仍属于亚扩散。此外，通量延迟也应体现在边界条件中。；创新点：提出了由Mittag-Leffler函数控制时间延迟的Cattaneo效应模型，使得CTSE中新增的分数阶时间导数阶数可独立于亚扩散指数；揭示了短时间极限下均方位移表现为超扩散但整体仍为亚扩散的反常行为；将通量延迟效应引入边界条件（如Robin边界条件），并给出了实验识别方案。
papers.method_zh: 通过将Cattaneo效应（通量激活的随机时间延迟）纳入通量方程，推导出Cattaneo型亚扩散方程（CTSE）。采用分数阶时间导数（阶数可独立于亚扩散指数）描述延迟效应，并分析方程解的行为。以部分吸收壁（Robin边界条件）系统为例进行研究，并提出了实验识别该效应的方法。

papers.title: Light-induced Faraday effect from dynamical breakdown of Kleinman symmetry
papers.abstract: The observation of anomalously large polarization rotations in pump-probe experiments with circularly polarized light has recently challenged the conventional understanding of the inverse Faraday effect. The striking magnitude of these responses implies the generation of effective magnetic fields orders of magnitude larger than theoretical expectations, raising fundamental questions about the nature of light-induced time-reversal symmetry breaking. In this work we demonstrate that a static polarization rotation can originate entirely from the antisymmetric component of the third-order optical susceptibility, without generating a macroscopic magnetization of the material. We show that this light-induced Faraday effect is inherently dynamical, emerging when Kleinman symmetry breaks down. Using a minimal sp tight-binding model on a square lattice, we demonstrate that the light-induced Faraday response can be sizable even far from dissipative resonances. While the effect emerges at a purely electronic level, we show that resonant coupling with phonons can significantly enhance the pump-probe response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrate、theoretical expectations、minimal sp tight-binding model。；研究对象：光诱导法拉第效应，具体为圆偏振光泵浦-探测实验中由克莱曼对称性动态破缺引起的静态偏振旋转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静态偏振旋转可完全源于三阶光学磁化率的反对称分量，无需产生宏观磁化；该效应本质上是动态的，在克莱曼对称性破缺时出现，且远离耗散共振时仍可显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静态偏振旋转可完全源于三阶光学磁化率的反对称分量，无需产生宏观磁化；该效应本质上是动态的，在克莱曼对称性破缺时出现，且远离耗散共振时仍可显著。；创新点：揭示了光诱导法拉第效应并非必须通过逆法拉第效应产生有效磁场，而是由三阶非线性光学响应的反对称分量直接导致，挑战了传统理解。
papers.method_zh: 采用正方晶格上的最小sp紧束缚模型进行理论计算，并分析了电子层面及与声子共振耦合对泵浦-探测响应的增强作用。

papers.title: Origin of the Temperature-Induced Gap Bowing of Formamidinium-Methylammonium Lead Iodide Perovskites: Role of Cationic Rattlers
papers.abstract: A thorough understanding of the temperature dependence of semiconductor band gaps is essential for optimizing optoelectronic devices. In this respect, the origin of the pronounced temperature-induced gap bowing observed in low-temperature phases of formamidinium-methylammonium (FA-MA) lead iodide perovskites has remained elusive until now. By combining temperature and pressure-dependent photoluminescence measurements on a series of FA$_x$MA$_{1-x}$PbI$_3$ mixed-cation single crystals with $x\in[0,1]$, we unravel the origin of this bowing. Both thermal expansion as well as electron-phonon interaction effects are responsible. However, the latter is the leading term, driven by the activation of an anomalous electron-phonon coupling mechanism linked to mixed vibrational modes, which combine inorganic-cage phonons involving octahedral tilting with low-frequency FA librations, i.e., FA rattler modes. This occurs in the orthorhombic and (pseudo)tetragonal low-temperature phases, presumably featuring stripe domains with alternating octahedral tilt-axis patterns for FA concentrations between 20\% and 90\%. In this way, we have shed light on an intriguing behavior of lead halide perovskites that directly affects their optoelectronic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：photoluminescence measurements、single crystals、temperature and pressure-dependent）；研究对象：FAₓMA₁₋ₓPbI₃混合阳离子钙钛矿单晶中低温相的温度诱导带隙弯曲现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 温度诱导带隙弯曲由热膨胀和电子-声子相互作用共同导致，其中电子-声子相互作用是主导因素，其源于一种反常的电子-声子耦合机制——混合振动模式（无机笼八面体倾斜声子与低频FA平动模式即“阳离子摇振子”的耦合）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：温度诱导带隙弯曲由热膨胀和电子-声子相互作用共同导致，其中电子-声子相互作用是主导因素，其源于一种反常的电子-声子耦合机制——混合振动模式（无机笼八面体倾斜声子与低频FA平动模式即“阳离子摇振子”的耦合）。；创新点：首次揭示了FA-MA混合阳离子铅碘钙钛矿低温相中温度诱导带隙弯曲的微观起源，将其归因于FA阳离子摇振子与无机笼八面体倾斜声子的耦合，并指出该机制在FA浓度为20%至90%时可能与条纹状八面体倾斜轴交替排列的畴结构有关。
papers.method_zh: 对一系列不同FA浓度（x∈[0,1]）的FAₓMA₁₋ₓPbI₃混合阳离子单晶进行变温和变压光致发光（PL）测量。

papers.title: Antisymmetric spontaneous resistivity anisotropy due to hard-axis collapse in polycrystalline Co thin films
papers.abstract: We investigate magnetoresistance phenomena associated with the magnetization hard-axis collapse in polycrystalline Co thin films. Transport measurements reveal that, for specific orientations of the applied magnetic field, the system exhibits distinct remanent resistance levels in both the in-plane longitudinal and transverse voltage responses. In particular, the planar Hall resistance shows multiple stable and reproducible levels at room temperature, enabling the identification of at least three remanent states that can be distinguished and used for information storage. These resistance levels originate from non-uniform magnetic configurations stabilized after the application and removal of the external magnetic field in the hard-axis region. Since this phenomenon remains largely unexplored, we present an incipient study addressing its potential implications from an applied-physics perspective. The observation of such behavior in polycrystalline Co thin films grown on Si substrates suggests a simple and low-cost platform for spintronic memory and sensing devices based on the remanent planar Hall effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Transport measurements、voltage responses、planar Hall resistance。；研究对象：多晶Co薄膜中与磁化难轴坍塌相关的磁电阻现象，特别是平面霍尔效应中的剩余电阻态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多晶Co薄膜中，当外加磁场沿特定方向施加并撤去后，系统在纵向和横向电压响应中表现出多个稳定且可区分的剩余电阻态，至少三个剩余态可用于信息存储。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多晶Co薄膜中，当外加磁场沿特定方向施加并撤去后，系统在纵向和横向电压响应中表现出多个稳定且可区分的剩余电阻态，至少三个剩余态可用于信息存储。；创新点：首次系统研究了多晶Co薄膜中因磁化难轴坍塌导致的反对称自发电阻率各向异性，并指出该现象在室温下可产生多个稳定剩余态，为基于剩余平面霍尔效应的自旋电子存储和传感提供了低成本平台。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（包括面内纵向和横向电压响应），具体为测量平面霍尔电阻随磁场的变化，并观察磁场撤去后的剩余电阻态。

papers.title: Electron Polaron at Neutral 180$^\circ$ Domain Wall in PbTiO$_3$: Stability, Trapping Energies, and Transverse Polarization
papers.abstract: We use density-functional theory with a Hubbard correction to investigate Ti-centered electron polarons at neutral PbO-centered $180^\circ$ domain walls in tetragonal PbTiO$_{3}$. The Hubbard parameter for Ti $3d$ states is determined using the finite-size-corrected polaronic energy-level alignment procedure, yielding stable electron-polaron formation in bulk PbTiO$_3$ with a trapping energy of $-$0.06 eV. In the domain-wall supercell, the excess electron localizes on Ti and forms a Ti$^{3+}$ center with an occupied $d_{xy}$ orbital in-gap state. Comparison of bulk-like and near-wall Ti sites shows that their trapping energies differ by only about 0.01 eV, indicating that this neutral domain wall does not provide a significant thermodynamic driving force for electron-polaron segregation. While the Ising-like reversal of the out-of-plane polarization is preserved, the localized electron induces a finite transverse polarization component normal to the wall, enhancing a local Néel-like distortion that is strongest when the polaron is located at the wall. These results show that neutral $180^\circ$ domain walls in PbTiO$_3$ do not substantially alter the stability of Ti-centered electron polarons, but they can couple to the polaron-induced lattice distortion through a localized transverse polarization response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用密度泛函理论（density-functional theory）加Hubbard修正（DFT+U）进行计算研究。；研究对象：四方相钛酸铅（PbTiO₃）中中性PbO中心180°畴壁处的钛中心电子极化子（Ti-centered electron polaron），具体研究其稳定性、俘获能及横向极化响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中性180°畴壁对钛中心电子极化子的热力学稳定性影响极小（俘获能差异仅约0.01 eV），但极化子会在畴壁处诱导出垂直于壁面的有限横向极化分量，增强局域类Néel畸变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中性180°畴壁对钛中心电子极化子的热力学稳定性影响极小（俘获能差异仅约0.01 eV），但极化子会在畴壁处诱导出垂直于壁面的有限横向极化分量，增强局域类Néel畸变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT+U方法，通过有限尺寸校正的极化子能级对齐程序确定Ti 3d态的Hubbard参数U，在体相和畴壁超胞中计算电子极化子的形成与俘获能。

papers.title: Molecular Dynamics Study of Defect Evolution Mechanisms in 3C-SiC for Quantum Technologies
papers.abstract: The migration of point defects and formation of spin defects in 3C-SiC were investigated using molecular dynamics simulations, with migration barriers obtained from Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) calculations and finite temperature diffusivities evaluated using both mean square displacement (MSD) and jump frequency approaches. While both methods reproduce Arrhenius behavior, the jump frequency formulation exhibits improved statistical stability. Activation energies of 2.12~eV for carbon vacancies and 0.88~eV for carbon interstitials are obtained, consistent with literature. The resulting mobility hierarchy governs defect evolution and complex formations. Interstitial vacancy recombination competes with vacancy aggregation into divacancies, influencing the stabilization of spin active defect centers. The study also provides a consistent framework for diffusion analysis in atomistic simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：分子动力学模拟、Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) 计算、均方位移 (MSD) 与跳跃频率方法。；研究对象：3C-SiC（立方碳化硅）中的点缺陷迁移与自旋缺陷形成机制，具体涉及碳空位、碳间隙原子及双空位等缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碳空位与碳间隙原子的迁移能垒分别为2.12 eV和0.88 eV，间隙原子-空位复合与空位聚集成双空位之间存在竞争关系，这一过程影响自旋活性缺陷中心的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碳空位与碳间隙原子的迁移能垒分别为2.12 eV和0.88 eV，间隙原子-空位复合与空位聚集成双空位之间存在竞争关系，这一过程影响自旋活性缺陷中心的稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟研究缺陷演化，通过Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) 计算获取迁移能垒，并利用均方位移 (MSD) 与跳跃频率两种方法评估有限温度下的扩散系数。

papers.title: Quantum Geometric Origin of Hall Viscosity and Nonlocal Hall Conductivity in Lattice Bands
papers.abstract: We show that Hall viscosity in lattice bands is governed by a band-projected electric quadrupole encoded within the quantum geometry: Berry curvature sets the projected-coordinate algebra, while the quantum metric determines the quadrupolar spread of a wave packet. The same structure enters the quadratic wave-vector coefficient of the nonlocal Hall conductivity, yielding a lattice viscosity-conductivity relation. In ideal bands, the deviation from the Landau-level form is quantified by Berry curvature fluctuations. Our results establish the nonlocal Hall response as an electrical signature of the quantum geometry underlying Hall viscosity and as a transport diagnostic of geometric idealness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show that”“Our results establish”等理论推导和结论表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：晶格能带中的霍尔粘滞度（Hall viscosity）和非局域霍尔电导率（nonlocal Hall conductivity）的量子几何起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 霍尔粘滞度由能带投影的电四极矩（band-projected electric quadrupole）决定，该四极矩编码于量子几何中：贝里曲率决定投影坐标代数，量子度量决定波包的四极展宽。非局域霍尔电导率的二次波矢系数包含相同结构，从而建立了晶格中的粘滞度-电导率关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：霍尔粘滞度由能带投影的电四极矩（band-projected electric quadrupole）决定，该四极矩编码于量子几何中：贝里曲率决定投影坐标代数，量子度量决定波包的四极展宽。非局域霍尔电导率的二次波矢系数包含相同结构，从而建立了晶格中的粘滞度-电导率关系。；创新点：揭示了霍尔粘滞度与非局域霍尔电导率在晶格能带中共同的量子几何起源，并建立了二者之间的定量关系；同时提出非局域霍尔响应可作为量子几何理想性（geometric idealness）的输运诊断工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于量子几何（Berry曲率与量子度量）的能带投影方法，推导霍尔粘滞度与非局域霍尔电导率的表达式，并讨论理想能带偏离朗道能级形式的行为。

papers.title: Individual Characterization of Fast-Responding Trap States at the NO-Annealed SiO$_2$/4H-SiC Interface
papers.abstract: Fast-responding trap states introduced by NO-annealing are suspected to limit the channel mobility of 4H-SiC MOSFETs, yet their microscopic characterization remains challenging because conventional electrical methods are spatially averaged and do not readily isolate such fast processes. Here, we visualize and analyze individual fast-responding trap states at the NO-annealed SiO$_2$/4H-SiC interface using the energy dissipation signal in frequency-modulation atomic force microscopy (FM-AFM), which selectively probes charge-exchange dynamics on sub-$μ$s time scales. Ring-shaped dissipation patterns were observed in the NO-annealed sample but not in the control sample without NO-annealing, indicating that the detected states are associated with nitridation. Spectroscopic measurements were also performed to determine the dependence of energy dissipation on the tip bias and the tip-sample distance. Combined with finite-element electrostatic calculations, this analysis allowed us to determine trap energies relative to the Fermi level, $E_t - E_f$, and revealed that the trap-energy distribution extends toward the interfacial conduction-band edge. These results provide microscopic evidence that NO-annealing generates fast-responding trap states near the SiO$_2$/4H-SiC interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了使用频率调制原子力显微镜（FM-AFM）进行实验观测和分析。；研究对象：NO退火处理的SiO₂/4H-SiC界面处的快速响应陷阱态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NO退火会在SiO₂/4H-SiC界面附近产生快速响应的陷阱态，其能量分布延伸至界面导带边缘，这些陷阱态是限制4H-SiC MOSFET沟道迁移率的潜在因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NO退火会在SiO₂/4H-SiC界面附近产生快速响应的陷阱态，其能量分布延伸至界面导带边缘，这些陷阱态是限制4H-SiC MOSFET沟道迁移率的潜在因素。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 频率调制原子力显微镜（FM-AFM）的能量耗散信号，用于选择性探测亚微秒时间尺度上的电荷交换动力学；结合有限元静电计算进行能级分析；对比实验（NO退火样品与未退火对照样品）。

papers.title: Designing Multivalent Copolymers for Selective Targeting of Multicomponent Surfaces
papers.abstract: Selective targeting of membranes with a specific receptor profile is an ongoing challenge in targeted drug delivery. We investigate the adsorption of copolymers on a multicomponent receptor-covered surface using grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations and demonstrate that polymers can be designed to target a particular receptor density profile. To achieve this, the ligand profile on the polymers should match the targeted receptor profile, and the ligand--receptor affinity should be inversely proportional to the ligand profile. While the same can be obtained using multivalent nanoparticles, the entropic effects due to polymer conformations significantly enhance the binding selectivity of multivalent polymers compared to nanoparticles. Surprisingly, the ligand distribution on the polymer plays a crucial role, whereas the persistence length does not. The optimal selectivity to the overall receptor concentration is obtained by the Poisson distribution of ligands (random copolymer), whereas the maximal selectivity to a specific receptor profile is obtained by a defined sequence of grouped alternating ligands (regular copolymer). Interestingly, the regular copolymer can become anti-selective when ligands of the same type are in homogenous blocks, showing that specific ligand distribution qualitatively affects the targeting ability. These findings suggest that sequence control is necessary to selectively target a specific density profile of membrane receptors using linear copolymers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：共聚物在含有多组分受体的膜表面上的选择性吸附行为，具体涉及靶向药物递送中的受体密度分布识别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计共聚物的配体分布（使其与靶向受体密度分布匹配，且配体-受体亲和力与配体分布成反比），可实现对特定受体密度分布的高选择性靶向；与多价纳米颗粒相比，聚合物构象的熵效应显著增强了结合选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计共聚物的配体分布（使其与靶向受体密度分布匹配，且配体-受体亲和力与配体分布成反比），可实现对特定受体密度分布的高选择性靶向；与多价纳米颗粒相比，聚合物构象的熵效应显著增强了结合选择性。；创新点：揭示了共聚物中配体分布（而非持续长度）对靶向选择性的决定性作用，并发现规则共聚物在特定配体分组排列下可表现出反选择性（anti-selective），表明序列控制对线性共聚物靶向膜受体密度分布的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟（grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations），用于模拟共聚物在多组分受体覆盖表面上的吸附过程。

papers.title: Anomaly-Induced Hybrid Bulk Electromagnetic Mode in Weyl Semimetals
papers.abstract: Collective modes provide direct fingerprints of quantum matter. We predict a previously unidentified hybrid bulk electromagnetic mode in Weyl semimetals arising from the interplay between the chiral anomaly and the orientation of its associated chiral magnetic response relative to the direction of the wave-vector. When the anomaly-induced chiral magnetic current has a component along the propagation direction, oscillations of valley imbalance hybridize with plasmonic charge oscillations, producing a linearly dispersing mode that undergoes avoided crossing with the bulk plasmon, producing a hybrid bulk excitation absent in ordinary metals. The hybrid mode provides a direct signature of Weyl semimetals and a probe of the chiral anomaly and its associated chiral magnetic effect, with observable features in electron energy-loss spectroscopy. Studying this interplay can uncover various optical and electronic properties of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“predict”（预测）、“interplay”（相互作用）、“producing”（产生）等，表明该工作是基于理论模型进行预言，而非实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：Weyl半金属中的集体激发模式，具体为一种由手征反常（chiral anomaly）与手征磁效应（chiral magnetic effect）共同诱导的混合体电磁模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预言了一种在普通金属中不存在的混合体电磁模式。该模式源于手征反常诱导的手征磁电流沿波矢方向的分量，导致谷极化振荡与等离激元电荷振荡发生杂化，产生一个线性色散的模式，并与体等离激元发生避免交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预言了一种在普通金属中不存在的混合体电磁模式。该模式源于手征反常诱导的手征磁电流沿波矢方向的分量，导致谷极化振荡与等离激元电荷振荡发生杂化，产生一个线性色散的模式，并与体等离激元发生避免交叉。；创新点：首次预言了由手征反常与波矢方向相对取向共同作用而产生的一种新型混合体电磁模式。该模式是Weyl半金属独有的特征，可作为探测手征反常及其相关手征磁效应的直接指纹。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。摘要未明确说明具体的理论框架（如是否使用流体动力学模型、线性响应理论或有效场论），但核心是基于手征反常与手征磁效应的物理图像进行推导。

papers.title: Kinetic Superselectivity in Multivalent Binding
papers.abstract: Multivalent binding employs multiple simultaneous supramolecular interactions, increasing avidity and selectivity compared with monovalent binding. While equilibrium aspects of multivalency are well characterized, non-equilibrium behavior remains poorly understood. By combining experiments on hyaluronic acid polymers with kinetic modeling based on stochastic chemical kinetics and molecular dynamics simulations, we systematically investigate the kinetics of multivalent binding. Notably, we find that both association and dissociation kinetics can be more selective than equilibrium binding. We explain this behavior using a two-step binding model featuring a combination of fast, weak and slow, strong interactions. These findings demonstrate a new approach: superselective targeting based on the association rate instead of the equilibrium state. The kinetic theory and experiments presented here provide a fundamental understanding of multivalent kinetics and establish design rules for superselective targeting in out-of-equilibrium systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“结合实验”、“动力学建模”和“分子动力学模拟”。；研究对象：多价结合的动力学过程，具体以透明质酸聚合物为实验体系，研究其结合与解离的动力学选择性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多价结合中，结合与解离的动力学过程可以比平衡态结合具有更高的选择性，提出了一种基于结合速率而非平衡态的超选择性靶向新方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多价结合中，结合与解离的动力学过程可以比平衡态结合具有更高的选择性，提出了一种基于结合速率而非平衡态的超选择性靶向新方法。；创新点：揭示了多价结合在非平衡态下的动力学选择性优于平衡态选择性，并建立了基于结合速率的超选择性靶向设计规则。摘要未突出说明与已有平衡态多价结合研究的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用透明质酸聚合物进行结合实验；理论上采用基于随机化学动力学的动力学建模；计算上使用分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Temperature dependence of the magnon-phonon coupling in yttrium iron garnet/gadolinium gallium garnet high overtone bulk acoustic resonators
papers.abstract: Weexperimentally study the temperature dependence of the magnon-phonon coupling in a yttrium iron garnet (YIG)/gadolinium gallium garnet (GGG) heterostructure. More specifically, we use broadband ferromagnetic resonance to investigate the magneto-elastic coupling between the Kittel mode of a YIG thin film and the transverse acoustic phonon modes of the YIG/GGG high overtone bulk acoustic wave acoustic resonator for in and out-of-plane field directions in the temperature range between T = 5K and 300K. We find that for a magnetic field applied normal to the film surface, magneto-elastic coupling decreases with decreasing temperature, whereas it increases for the in-plane magnetic field configuration. The observed temperature dependence differs from earlier observations on bulk YIG samples, which might be due to the temperature dependent stress imposed by the GGG substrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally study”，并描述了具体的实验测量（broadband ferromagnetic resonance）。；研究对象：钇铁石榴石（YIG）/钆镓石榴石（GGG）异质结构中的磁振子-声子耦合，具体为YIG薄膜的Kittel模与YIG/GGG高次泛音体声波谐振器的横向声学声子模之间的磁弹耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁弹耦合强度随温度的变化依赖于磁场方向：当磁场垂直于薄膜表面时，耦合随温度降低而减弱；当磁场平行于薄膜表面时，耦合随温度降低而增强。这一温度依赖行为与先前在块体YIG样品中的观测结果不同，可能源于GGG衬底施加的温度依赖应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁弹耦合强度随温度的变化依赖于磁场方向：当磁场垂直于薄膜表面时，耦合随温度降低而减弱；当磁场平行于薄膜表面时，耦合随温度降低而增强。这一温度依赖行为与先前在块体YIG样品中的观测结果不同，可能源于GGG衬底施加的温度依赖应力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 宽带铁磁共振（broadband ferromagnetic resonance）技术，在5K至300K温度范围内，分别对垂直于薄膜表面和平行于薄膜表面的磁场方向进行测量。

papers.title: Inter-Landau-Level Pair Tunneling Rigidifies the Long-Wavelength Structure Factor of the ν=1/3 Laughlin State
papers.abstract: A textbook chain of reasoning, originating with Girvin, MacDonald, and Platzman, predicts that Landau-level mixing (LLM) at nu=1/3 should soften the long-wavelength structure factor S(L): virtual excitations suppress V_1, the magnetoroton gap closes, and the single-mode approximation then forces S(L) to increase. We test this chain on the Haldane sphere at nu=1/3, N=6, 2Q=15. (i) Perturbatively, via first-order Schrieffer-Wolff dressing of the LLL Laughlin state, fed Lowdin-renormalised pseudopotentials: the dressed state gives Delta S(1) at kappa=10 of approximately +21%, consistent with the GMP prediction (~19% softening of V_1^eff). (ii) Non-perturbatively, via rigorous two-Landau-level (LLL+SLL) exact diagonalisation using a repaired DiagHam 2LL module that retains, for the first time on the sphere, the full inter-LL scattering channels. The response reverses sign: S(1) rigidifies monotonically from 0.118 at kappa->0 to 0.080 at kappa=10, a 32% suppression. Perturbative and non-perturbative results thus disagree in sign, with a gap of ~53 percentage points between +21% (SW) and -32% (full ED). Channel-mask ablation localises the reversal to the DD<->UU pair-tunneling channel (98% of the shift). A four-way decomposition shows the three-body coherent content overpowers the perturbative admixture by ~2.5x. Repaired code: https://github.com/Cannan-1/DiagHamOnSphereOpenSource (v2.0).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：perturbatively、non-perturbatively、exact diagonalisation、DiagHam 2LL module）；研究对象：ν=1/3 Laughlin态的朗道能级混合效应，具体研究长波结构因子S(L)在Haldane球面上的行为（N=6, 2Q=15）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非微扰的严格对角化结果显示，朗道能级混合使长波结构因子S(1)从κ→0时的0.118单调刚性化至κ=10时的0.080（抑制32%），与微扰Schrieffer-Wolff方法预测的软化（+21%）符号相反。这一反转主要由DD↔UU对隧穿通道（占98%的偏移）驱动，三体相干效应以约2.5倍强度压制了微扰混合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非微扰的严格对角化结果显示，朗道能级混合使长波结构因子S(1)从κ→0时的0.118单调刚性化至κ=10时的0.080（抑制32%），与微扰Schrieffer-Wolff方法预测的软化（+21%）符号相反。这一反转主要由DD↔UU对隧穿通道（占98%的偏移）驱动，三体相干效应以约2.5倍强度压制了微扰混合。；创新点：首次在Haldane球面上实现了保留完整能级间散射通道的两朗道能级严格对角化，揭示了微扰理论（Schrieffer-Wolff）与非微扰严格对角化在朗道能级混合效应上的定性分歧，并定位了反转机制为DD↔UU对隧穿通道的三体相干效应。
papers.method_zh: 采用两种互补方法：(i) 微扰方法：通过一阶Schrieffer-Wolff变换对LLL Laughlin态进行修饰，并输入Löwdin重整化赝势；(ii) 非微扰方法：使用修复的DiagHam 2LL模块在Haldane球面上进行严格的两朗道能级（LLL+SLL）精确对角化，首次完整保留了球面上的所有能级间散射通道。还使用了通道掩膜消融（channel-mask ablation）和四路分解分析。

papers.title: A tridiagonal matrix-valued process with stochastic resetting for arbitrary Dyson index $β>0$
papers.abstract: We introduce a symmetric tridiagonal matrix-valued process ($β$-TMP) $H(t)$ whose diagonal entries $H_{k,k}(t)$ evolve independently via an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process starting at the origin and the off-diagonal entries $H_{k,k+1}(t)$ evolve independently via the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process, starting at the origin and with parameters that depend on the row index $k$. We show that the joint distribution of the entries of the matrix can be computed exactly at all times and moreover, the joint distribution of its $N$ real eigenvalues can be computed exactly at all times too. We then subject this time-evolving matrix-valued process to stochastic resetting with rate $r$ in two different settings: (i) simultaneous resetting of the matrix entries to the origin with rate $r$ ($β$-SRTMP process) and (ii) independent resetting of the matrix entries to the origin with rate $r$ ($β$-IRTMP process). We show that the joint distribution of the eigenvalues of the $β$-SRTMP process at long times can be computed analytically and it coincides with the joint distribution of the positions of the resetting Dyson Brownian motion in its stationary state for arbitrary $β>0$. For the $β$-IRTMP stationary ensemble, computing analytically the joint distribution of eigenvalues or even the average density of eigenvalues is difficult. However, generating the stationary $β$-IRTMP ensemble numerically is relatively straightforward and we compare its numerical average eigenvalue density to the corresponding analytical results for the $β$-SRTMP stationary ensemble with same parameter values, showing that they are quite different from each other. Finally, we provide a simple and concrete application of this tridiagonal matrix-valued process in computing the annealed partition function of a disordered quantum tight-binding Hamiltonian on a one-dimensional lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：论文引入并分析了一个随机矩阵过程，推导了其本征值联合分布的解析表达式，属于数学物理与随机过程理论范畴。；研究对象：一个具有随机重置（stochastic resetting）的对称三对角矩阵值过程（β-TMP），其本征值动力学对应于任意Dyson指数β>0的Dyson布朗运动。具体体系包括两种重置机制：同时重置（β-SRTMP）和独立重置（β-IRTMP）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于同时重置过程（β-SRTMP），在长时间极限下，其本征值的联合分布可以解析计算，并且与重置Dyson布朗运动在稳态下的本征值分布一致（对任意β>0）。对于独立重置过程（β-IRTMP），解析求解困难，但其数值平均本征值密度与β-SRTMP的解析结果显著不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于同时重置过程（β-SRTMP），在长时间极限下，其本征值的联合分布可以解析计算，并且与重置Dyson布朗运动在稳态下的本征值分布一致（对任意β>0）。对于独立重置过程（β-IRTMP），解析求解困难，但其数值平均本征值密度与β-SRTMP的解析结果显著不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机矩阵理论和随机过程方法：对角元由Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程驱动，非对角元由Cox-Ingersoll-Ross过程驱动，并引入泊松率为r的随机重置。通过解析计算联合分布，并与数值模拟（针对β-IRTMP）进行比较。

papers.title: Long-range deformations in Gaussian States
papers.abstract: Imaginary-time evolution by a local Hamiltonian cannot induce a phase transition in one dimension, but longer-range interactions may subvert such constraints. Starting from the ground state of the Kitaev Majorana chain, we modify the wave function by an imaginary-time evolution generated by a quadratic Hamiltonian with power-law couplings that enhance pairing correlations, typically of the form $1/r^α$, where $r$ is the distance between two sites. As the state remains Gaussian, entanglement and correlation functions can be computed analytically. We find that the decay exponent $α$ controls three distinct infrared regimes: for $α>1$, the deformation produces only smooth crossovers at finite deformation strength, while the topological regime is reached only asymptotically as the deformation strength tends to infinity. At $α=1$, the deformation induces an immediate flow to the topological phase: an infinitesimal deformation strength drives the system to a topological regime, and in a particular case, an emergent Kramers-Wannier symmetry enforces Ising-like scaling at long distances. For $α<1$, the deformed state shows the same critical-like behavior for all non-zero deformation strength. We observe that even with arbitrarily long-range interactions, these models do not display a sharp phase transition at non-zero deformation strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Gaussian States、imaginary-time evolution、analytically computed。；研究对象：Kitaev Majorana链的基态通过长程相互作用（幂律耦合 \(1/r^\alpha\)）的虚时演化所得到的变形高斯态，以及该变形态中的拓扑相变与关联行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 变形强度非零时，系统不会出现尖锐的相变；但长程相互作用的幂指数 \(\alpha\) 决定了三种不同的红外行为：\(\alpha>1\) 时仅出现平滑交叉，\(\alpha=1\) 时无穷小变形即可驱动系统进入拓扑相，\(\alpha<1\) 时所有非零变形强度下均呈现类似临界行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：变形强度非零时，系统不会出现尖锐的相变；但长程相互作用的幂指数 \(\alpha\) 决定了三种不同的红外行为：\(\alpha>1\) 时仅出现平滑交叉，\(\alpha=1\) 时无穷小变形即可驱动系统进入拓扑相，\(\alpha<1\) 时所有非零变形强度下均呈现类似临界行为。；创新点：揭示了在长程相互作用的高斯态中，变形强度非零时不存在尖锐相变，但幂指数 \(\alpha=1\) 时存在由无穷小变形驱动的即时拓扑相变，并出现 emergent Kramers-Wannier 对称性导致的 Ising 型标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：从Kitaev Majorana链的基态出发，利用具有幂律耦合的二次型哈密顿量进行虚时演化，保持态为高斯态，从而解析计算纠缠与关联函数。

papers.title: Structure and energetics of grain boundaries in self-assembled double-gyroid block copolymer networks
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) are ubiquitous defects in crystalline materials. However, they remain less explored in block copolymer ordered phases. Here, we develop a self-consistent field theory framework to investigate GB structure and energetics in double-gyroid (DG) diblock copolymer networks. The GB energy landscape is obtained as a function of GB orientation, which reveals multiple local minima representing distinct network-switching GBs. Remarkably, the global minimum is a previously unidentified asymmetric-tilt network-switching GB (ATNS), exhibiting a lower energy than the experimentally observed $(422)$ twin boundary (TB). Comparative analyses of representative low- (ATNS, $(422)$ TB) and high-energy twist ($(0\bar{1}\bar{1})$, $(100)$ TNSs) GBs reveal that, unlike enthalpy-dominated hard matter, GB stability in DG networks is predominantly entropy-driven. Twist-type GBs generate new nodes and disrupt nodal coplanarity, causing chain packing frustration and large entropy penalties. Conversely, the ATNS preserves favorable network connectivity and minimizes conformational constraints on polymer chains, making it the energetically preferred GB.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：self-consistent field theory framework（自洽场理论框架）、energetics（能量学分析）。；研究对象：双螺旋（double-gyroid, DG）二嵌段共聚物网络中的晶界（grain boundaries, GBs）结构与能量学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种此前未被识别的非对称倾斜网络切换晶界（ATNS）具有全局最低能量，其能量低于实验上已观测到的(422)孪晶界；双螺旋网络中晶界的稳定性主要由熵驱动，而非焓驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种此前未被识别的非对称倾斜网络切换晶界（ATNS）具有全局最低能量，其能量低于实验上已观测到的(422)孪晶界；双螺旋网络中晶界的稳定性主要由熵驱动，而非焓驱动。；创新点：首次在嵌段共聚物双螺旋网络中系统构建了晶界能量景观，并揭示了熵效应在决定晶界稳定性中的主导作用，这与传统硬物质中焓主导的晶界行为形成鲜明对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽场理论（self-consistent field theory, SCFT）框架，系统计算了不同取向晶界的能量景观，并对代表性低能（ATNS、(422)孪晶界）和高能（扭转型(0ĪĪ)、(100) TNSs）晶界进行了对比分析。

papers.title: Dynamics of ring polymer melts: Memory function approach
papers.abstract: We investigated the static and dynamic properties of a Rouse ring polymer modified by introducing an effective, spherically symmetric, attractive potential of entropic nature and a memory function describing the effect of dynamic entanglement. Renormalized Rouse formalism is used to approximate the time dependence of the memory matrix. The results obtained are in good agreement with existing experimental data and the results of computer simulations of ring polymer ring with , , where N_e is the number of Kuhn segments in linear polymer melts between neighboring entanglements and , the number of Kuhn segments. For large molecular weights, a refined self-consistent approximation is proposed to describe the time dependence of the memory function. It is shown that this approximation allows us to describe an exponential decrease in the self-diffusion coefficient with molecular weight of the rings, i.e., the effect of dynamic localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Rouse ring polymer、memory function approach、renormalized Rouse formalism、self-consistent approximation。；研究对象：环状聚合物熔体的动力学行为，具体为通过引入有效吸引势和记忆函数修正的Rouse环状聚合物模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过自洽近似方法，成功描述了环状聚合物自扩散系数随分子量指数衰减的现象，即动态局域化效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过自洽近似方法，成功描述了环状聚合物自扩散系数随分子量指数衰减的现象，即动态局域化效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用重正化Rouse形式论近似记忆矩阵的时间依赖性，并针对高分子量体系提出了改进的自洽近似来描述记忆函数的时间演化。

papers.title: Active learning of collinear magnetic Moment Tensor Potentials using the spin-MLIP package from soft-constrained spin-polarized DFT calculations: a case study of Fe-Pd
papers.abstract: Explicit incorporation of magnetic degrees of freedom in machine-learning interatomic potentials (magnetic MLIPs) plays a crucial role in the correct description of magnetic materials and their properties. An important ingredient for fitting of magnetic MLIPs is spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) calculations with non-equilibrium magnetic moments, i.e. DFT calculations with constraints on magnetic moments. In this study, we present a workflow for active learning of magnetic Moment Tensor Potential (mMTP) during molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Magnetic MTP and its active learning algorithm were implemented in the open-source spin-MLIP code, DFT soft-constrained spin-polarized calculations were performed with the VASP code, and MD simulations were conducted in the open-source LAMMPS code. We test our workflow on the Fe-Pd crystal. The dependencies of magnetization and density of states (DOSs) on the volume of a supercell (or, pressure) are in good agreement with those calculated with DFT. Furthermore, the calculated DOSs correspond to the experimental ones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning interatomic potentials、spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) calculations、active learning、molecular dynamics (MD) simulations。；研究对象：Fe-Pd晶体（铁-钯体系），具体研究其磁性（磁化强度）与电子结构（态密度）随体积/压力的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过主动学习流程训练的磁性矩张量势（mMTP）能够准确描述Fe-Pd晶体的磁化强度和态密度随体积（或压力）的变化，计算结果与DFT及实验数据吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过主动学习流程训练的磁性矩张量势（mMTP）能够准确描述Fe-Pd晶体的磁化强度和态密度随体积（或压力）的变化，计算结果与DFT及实验数据吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用软约束自旋极化DFT计算（VASP代码）生成训练数据，结合主动学习算法在分子动力学模拟（LAMMPS代码）中训练磁性矩张量势（mMTP），所有流程集成于开源spin-MLIP代码中。

papers.title: Orbital Magnetization from Uniform and Periodic Magnetic Fields
papers.abstract: Magnetization is thermodynamically defined as the derivative of the grand potential with respect to a uniform magnetic field. However, a uniform magnetic field makes the kinetic momentum operators noncommuting and Landau-quantizes the electron motion. This changes the zero-field momentum-space to Landau-levels and raises a fundamental question: how can the thermodynamic response to a uniform field be reproduced by a linear-response calculation carried out in the momentum space of the zero-field problem? We address this question analytically in a quantum Hall ferromagnet that allows the orbital magnetization $M$ to be computed in a closed form. We first compute $M$ from the local Hartree--Fock projector response to a periodic magnetic field with zero net flux. We then compute $M$ from the derivative of the grand potential with respect to a uniform magnetic field along the Středa line. The two approaches give the same result, even though the first keeps the Hilbert space fixed while the second changes the Landau-level degeneracy. Their agreement suggests that we should view orbital magnetization as the energy associated with the spectral flow that gives rise to the Středa formula. Our work provides a tutorial introduction to orbital magnetization and its relation to the Středa formula.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：thermodynamically defined、linear-response calculation、analytically、Hartree-Fock projector。；研究对象：轨道磁化（orbital magnetization）在均匀磁场和周期性磁场下的热力学定义与计算，具体以量子霍尔铁磁体（quantum Hall ferromagnet）为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过周期性磁场（零净通量）与均匀磁场两种方式计算轨道磁化，得到相同结果，表明轨道磁化应被理解为与产生Středa公式的谱流（spectral flow）相关的能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过周期性磁场（零净通量）与均匀磁场两种方式计算轨道磁化，得到相同结果，表明轨道磁化应被理解为与产生Středa公式的谱流（spectral flow）相关的能量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论分析。采用局域Hartree-Fock投影算符方法计算对周期性磁场的响应，并沿Středa线（Středa line）通过巨势对均匀磁场的导数计算轨道磁化。

papers.title: Self-Consistent Spectral Quadrature Approach to Many-Body Green Functions
papers.abstract: We develop a self-consistent spectral quadrature (sc-SQ) framework for the calculation of many-body Green functions. The method approximates the Källén--Lehmann spectral measure by Gauss--Christoffel (GC) quadrature, yielding a rational Green function representation with guaranteed spectral positivity that exactly reproduces the first $2N$ spectral moments at pole order $N$. A key component is an SVD-based rank-selection criterion on the Hankel matrix, which identifies the numerically resolvable pole rank $N^*$ from the singular-value gap and acts as a precision-guided diagnostic of correlation complexity. The scheme is made self-consistent by requiring that the spectral function used to evaluate expectation values coincides with the spectral function generated by the quadrature reconstruction. This defines a fixed-point hierarchy that connects systematically to established approximations, including Hartree--Fock and Hubbard-I, and incorporates non-perturbative features such as multi-peak spectral structure. We benchmark the approach for the Anderson impurity model against numerical renormalization group (NRG) results and apply it within dynamical mean-field theory for the Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice. The method captures the three-peak Anderson impurity spectrum and the suppression of quasiparticle weight in the half-filled Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice, including Mott-gap formation on the insulating branch for $N\geqslant 5$, in qualitative agreement with NRG references.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：self-consistent spectral quadrature (sc-SQ) framework、many-body Green functions、benchmark、dynamical mean-field theory。；研究对象：多体格林函数计算方法，具体应用于Anderson杂质模型和Bethe晶格上的Hubbard模型（包括Mott绝缘体转变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该方法能够通过自洽谱求积（sc-SQ）精确再现前2N个谱矩，并捕捉到Anderson杂质模型的三峰谱结构以及半满Hubbard模型在Bethe晶格上的准粒子权重抑制和Mott能隙形成，与数值重整化群（NRG）结果定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该方法能够通过自洽谱求积（sc-SQ）精确再现前2N个谱矩，并捕捉到Anderson杂质模型的三峰谱结构以及半满Hubbard模型在Bethe晶格上的准粒子权重抑制和Mott能隙形成，与数值重整化群（NRG）结果定性一致。；创新点：将谱求积方法自洽化，并引入基于SVD的秩选择准则作为相关复杂度的精度引导诊断，同时该方法可系统连接至Hartree-Fock和Hubbard-I等近似，并包含非微扰的多峰谱结构。
papers.method_zh: 提出自洽谱求积（sc-SQ）框架，利用Gauss-Christoffel（GC）求积近似Källén-Lehmann谱测度，得到有理函数形式的格林函数；通过Hankel矩阵的SVD奇异值间隙自动确定数值可分辨的极点阶数N*；通过要求用于计算期望值的谱函数与求积重构的谱函数一致，实现自洽性。

papers.title: Ultrafast signatures of Dirac / flat-band hybrid states from time-resolved ARPES
papers.abstract: Hybridization of highly itinerant Dirac electrons with localized flat-band states is predicted to yield emergent phenomena such as exotic heavy-fermion behaviour. Epitaxial graphene on two-dimensional adsorbate structures on SiC(0001), which host flat bands, offers a promising platform to explore these effects. However, direct experimental evidence of interlayer hybridization in such systems has so far been lacking. Here, we address this gap using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (trARPES) where interlayer hybridization manifests in three key observations: (1) accelerated Dirac-carrier relaxation arising from additional electronic and phononic decay channels provided by the flat-band subsystem, (2) transient charging of the Dirac cone enabled by direct optical excitation from the flat bands, and (3) ultrafast back-transfer of charge into the flat bands on timescales governed by the interlayer coupling strength. We further demonstrate that the degree of hybridization can be tuned via the atomic number of the atoms intercalated at the graphene-SiC interface, establishing a controllable platform for investigating exotic correlated ground states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（trARPES）作为主要实验手段，并涉及材料制备（外延石墨烯、插层原子）。；研究对象：SiC(0001)上外延石墨烯与二维吸附层（平带宿主）形成的异质结构，具体研究狄拉克电子与平带杂化产生的超快动力学现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过trARPES观测到层间杂化的三个关键超快特征：狄拉克载流子弛豫加速、狄拉克锥瞬态充电、以及电荷超快回传至平带，并证明杂化强度可通过插层原子序数调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过trARPES观测到层间杂化的三个关键超快特征：狄拉克载流子弛豫加速、狄拉克锥瞬态充电、以及电荷超快回传至平带，并证明杂化强度可通过插层原子序数调控。；创新点：首次通过trARPES直接提供了石墨烯/平带体系中层间杂化的实验证据，并展示了通过原子插层调控杂化强度的可控性。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱（trARPES），结合SiC(0001)上外延石墨烯与二维吸附层（平带宿主）的样品制备，以及不同原子（插层）的界面调控。

papers.title: Electronic properties governing the phase stability and elastic anisotropy of C14 and C15 Cr-Hf-Nb Laves phases
papers.abstract: This study utilizes Density Functional Theory (DFT) to investigate the thermodynamic stability, elastic anisotropy, and electronic properties of C14 and C15 Laves phases within the Cr--Hf--Nb system. Both formation enthalpies and comprehensive elastic property analyses confirm the energetic and mechanical stability of the C14 (HfNb$_2$, HfCr$_2$, NbCr$_2$) and C15 (HfCr$_2$, NbCr$_2$) phases. Furthermore, the evaluation of elastic anisotropy reveals a descending order of HfCr$_2$ > NbCr$_2$ > HfNb$_2$ for the C14 phase, contrasting with NbCr$_2$ > HfNb$_2$ > HfCr$_2$ for the C15 phase. Finally, electronic structure and COHP analyses indicate that strong anti-bonding behavior near the Fermi level within the XM$_2$ M--M bonds acts as a primary destabilization mechanism for both of these Laves phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Density Functional Theory (DFT)”、“formation enthalpies”、“electronic structure and COHP analyses”。；研究对象：Cr-Hf-Nb 体系中的 C14 和 C15 型 Laves 相（具体包括 HfNb₂、HfCr₂、NbCr₂ 等化合物）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过电子结构和 COHP 分析发现，费米能级附近 XM₂ 结构中 M-M 键的强反键行为是导致这两种 Laves 相失稳的主要机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过电子结构和 COHP 分析发现，费米能级附近 XM₂ 结构中 M-M 键的强反键行为是导致这两种 Laves 相失稳的主要机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合形成焓分析、弹性常数计算、弹性各向异性评估以及电子结构分析（COHP，即晶体轨道哈密顿布居分析）。

papers.title: Radiative electronic bound states in the continuum from defects in semiconductors
papers.abstract: Continuum-buried defect states in semiconductors are generally expected to be optically inactive due to their strong coupling to continuum bands. Here, we show that such defects can instead host radiative electronic bound states in the continuum (BICs), using the silicon G-center as a prototypical example. Hybrid-functional first-principles calculations with a Hubbard $U$ correction reveal that a localized defect state, initially buried below the valence band maximum (VBM) in the ground state, undergoes exchange-driven energy-level reordering under optical excitation and shifts above the VBM. This exchange-induced transition suppresses nonradiative decay and enables robust radiative emission. By computing temperature-dependent nonradiative lifetimes and comparing them with experimental photoluminescence (PL) lifetimes, we quantitatively reproduce the observed temperature dependence of the emission. These results uncover a stabilization mechanism for continuum-embedded defect states and establish electronic BICs as a general paradigm for designing defect-based optical systems, including quantum emitters and qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles calculations、hybrid-functional、Hubbard \(U\) correction）；研究对象：半导体中缺陷形成的连续谱束缚态（continuum-buried defect states），以硅G中心（silicon G-center）为具体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原本被认为光学惰性的连续谱埋藏缺陷态，在光激发下可通过交换驱动的能级重排转变为辐射性电子束缚态（radiative electronic bound states in the continuum, BICs），从而抑制非辐射衰减并实现稳定发光。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原本被认为光学惰性的连续谱埋藏缺陷态，在光激发下可通过交换驱动的能级重排转变为辐射性电子束缚态（radiative electronic bound states in the continuum, BICs），从而抑制非辐射衰减并实现稳定发光。；创新点：揭示了连续谱嵌入缺陷态的一种稳定化机制，并将电子型BICs确立为设计缺陷基光学系统（如量子发射器和量子比特）的通用范式。
papers.method_zh: 采用含Hubbard \(U\)修正的杂化泛函第一性原理计算（hybrid-functional first-principles calculations with a Hubbard \(U\) correction），计算温度依赖的非辐射寿命并与实验光致发光（PL）寿命对比。

papers.title: Terahertz spin-current transparency through rough interfaces
papers.abstract: Spin transport across interfaces is critical for spintronic devices, yet remains difficult to probe on ultrafast timescales. We use terahertz emission spectroscopy on Co|Pt heterostructures whose interface roughness is tuned through the thickness of an underlying Au buffer layer, while leaving other growth parameters unchanged. From the measured THz electric field, we extract the interface spin-current transparency ts after correcting for the changes in sample impedance and optical absorption of the stack. Surprisingly, we find that ts decreases by only approximately 30% as the interface root-mean-square roughness and the lateral grain size both increase by a factor of three, with no measurable change in the THz spectrum. These results demonstrate that interfacial spin transport is relatively robust against morphological variations on ultrafast timescales, establishing terahertz emission spectroscopy as a reliable probe of spin dynamics across imperfect interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：terahertz emission spectroscopy（太赫兹发射谱）、measured、extract、results demonstrate。；研究对象：Co|Pt异质结中界面粗糙度对自旋输运的影响，具体研究超快时间尺度下界面自旋电流透明度（spin-current transparency）与界面形貌（粗糙度、晶粒尺寸）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面均方根粗糙度和横向晶粒尺寸均增大三倍时，界面自旋电流透明度仅下降约30%，且太赫兹频谱无显著变化，表明超快时间尺度下界面自旋输运对形貌变化具有较强鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面均方根粗糙度和横向晶粒尺寸均增大三倍时，界面自旋电流透明度仅下降约30%，且太赫兹频谱无显著变化，表明超快时间尺度下界面自旋输运对形貌变化具有较强鲁棒性。；创新点：首次利用太赫兹发射光谱定量研究界面粗糙度对超快自旋输运的影响，并发现界面自旋输运在形貌变化下具有出乎意料的鲁棒性，从而验证了太赫兹发射光谱可作为探测非理想界面自旋动力学的可靠手段。
papers.method_zh: 使用太赫兹发射光谱（terahertz emission spectroscopy）测量Co|Pt异质结，通过改变底层Au缓冲层厚度调控界面粗糙度，同时保持其他生长参数不变。从测得的太赫兹电场中，在修正样品阻抗和光学吸收变化后，提取出界面自旋电流透明度。

papers.title: Influence of helicoidal spin-orbit coupling and Rabi coupling in dynamics of 2D Bose-Einstein Condensates
papers.abstract: This study explores the dynamics of Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) with helicoidal spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and Rabi coupling, confined under a two-dimensional harmonic potential. The relationship between helicoidal SOC, non-linear interactions along with Rabi coupling and their impact on the stability and non linear trapped modes of the condensate is analyzed using a coupled Gross-Pitaevski (GP) framework. A linearized GP equation is used to investigate modulation instability (MI), demonstrating the impact of strong coupling effects and anisotropic confinement on the instability dynamics. It has been shown that the modulation instability in the condensate is predominantly governed by the competition between the attractive and repulsive mean-field interactions. Additionally, stability regimes are altered by the harmonic confinement, enhancing their susceptibility to SOC-induced asymmetry and intra- and intercomponent interactions. These results shed light on the possibility for unique quantum phases and emergent characteristics of helicoidal SOC-driven condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“coupled Gross-Pitaevski (GP) framework”“linearized GP equation”等理论框架进行分析，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：二维谐波势阱中具有螺旋自旋-轨道耦合（helicoidal SOC）和拉比耦合（Rabi coupling）的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 调制不稳定性主要由平均场相互作用的吸引与排斥竞争主导；谐波束缚会改变稳定性区域，增强凝聚体对SOC诱导的不对称性以及组分内/间相互作用的敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：调制不稳定性主要由平均场相互作用的吸引与排斥竞争主导；谐波束缚会改变稳定性区域，增强凝聚体对SOC诱导的不对称性以及组分内/间相互作用的敏感性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用耦合Gross-Pitaevskii方程框架分析非线性束缚模的稳定性；利用线性化Gross-Pitaevskii方程研究调制不稳定性（MI），并考察强耦合效应和各向异性束缚对不稳定动力学的影响。

papers.title: Defect engineering of ultrathin gallium nitride via electric fields for advanced electronic, magnetic, and gas sensing applications
papers.abstract: Scaling wide-band-gap semiconductors to the ultrathin limit offers a transformative pathway for power electronics, with gallium nitride (GaN) representing a cornerstone material in this class. However, the operational resilience and functional tunability of its two-dimensional form (g-GaN) remain underexplored. This work shifts the focus from idealized systems to the complex materials behavior under realistic conditions, investigating how the synergistic effects of point vacancy defects, strain, and external electric fields govern its electronic, magnetic, and sensing landscapes. We demonstrate that these factors are not merely perturbations but are fundamental to modulating the material response. Our first-principles calculations suggest g-GaN maintains electronic stability under intense electric fields; notably, gallium vacancies are predicted to further extend the theoretical stability limit. While in-plane tension preserves the band gap evolution under an electric field, in-plane compression facilitates low-field metallization. Using nitrogen monoxide (NO) adsorption as a prototype, we find that the interaction is defect-modulated and potentially tunable by electric fields. Analysis of adsorption energetics and diffusion barriers suggests the gallium vacancy may act as a thermodynamic trap for NO. Targeted hybrid-functional (HSE06) validation confirms the reliability of observed adsorption trends and theoretical metallization thresholds, while revealing that precise electronic-exchange treatment is critical for capturing the magnetic ground state of nitrogen vacancies. By systematically examining the geometry, energetics, band structure, density of states, magnetic response, and charge transfer, this study clarifies the interplay between defects and external electric fields, providing insights into theoretical upper bounds for property tuning and semiconductor device engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）、“hybrid-functional (HSE06) validation”（混合泛函验证）。；研究对象：超薄氮化镓（g-GaN）二维材料，具体研究其点缺陷（空位）、应变与外加电场协同作用下的电子、磁性和气体传感特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄氮化镓在强电场下仍能保持电子稳定性，且镓空位可进一步扩展其理论稳定极限；氮氧化物（NO）的吸附行为受缺陷调控，并可通过电场进行调节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄氮化镓在强电场下仍能保持电子稳定性，且镓空位可进一步扩展其理论稳定极限；氮氧化物（NO）的吸附行为受缺陷调控，并可通过电场进行调节。；创新点：将研究焦点从理想化系统转向实际条件下的复杂材料行为，系统揭示了点缺陷、应变和电场三者协同效应对超薄氮化镓物性的调控机制，而非仅考虑单一因素。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论，DFT），并采用混合泛函（HSE06）对吸附趋势、金属化阈值及氮空位的磁基态进行验证。分析了几何结构、能量、能带、态密度、磁响应和电荷转移。

papers.title: Neural Autoregressive Control Variates for the Quantum Monte Carlo Sign Problem
papers.abstract: We train a pair of autoregressive models to construct zero-mean control variates to mitigate the sign problem in quantum Monte Carlo simulations. The two autoregressive networks are confined to the positive- and negative-sign sectors with strictly disjoint support, and each is exactly normalized over its sector. Their difference is therefore structurally zero-mean, providing an unbiased auxiliary observable whose correlation with the sign estimator controls the variance reduction. We implement the method within the stochastic series expansion framework, which we extend to frustrated lattices by developing an incremental loop-topology update. Sign-ergodic sampling is achieved through a twist channel, which is the unique sign-changing mechanism on non-bipartite lattices. We implement the control variates as autoregressive transformers with an end-of-sequence parity mask that enforces exact sign-sector resolution, while the incremental loop-count change and cumulative frustration parity are incorporated as topological features. On the triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet, we benchmark the method in the small-$N$ limit. The control variate reduces the standard error of the average sign by up to an order of magnitude and that of the energy estimator by a factor of three to five, remaining effective even when the average sign drops below $10^{-3}$. This work lays out the framework and provides a proof-of-principle demonstration that autoregressive control variates can effectively mitigate the sign problem. Scaling to larger systems with physics-informed architectures is the subject of future work.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum Monte Carlo simulations、autoregressive models、control variates、stochastic series expansion。；研究对象：量子蒙特卡洛模拟中的符号问题（sign problem），具体以三角晶格海森堡反铁磁体（triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet）为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 训练一对自回归模型作为零均值控制变量，可将平均符号的标准误差降低一个数量级，能量估计器的标准误差降低三到五倍，即使在平均符号低于10⁻³时仍有效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：训练一对自回归模型作为零均值控制变量，可将平均符号的标准误差降低一个数量级，能量估计器的标准误差降低三到五倍，即使在平均符号低于10⁻³时仍有效。；创新点：首次将自回归模型构造的零均值控制变量用于量子蒙特卡洛符号问题的缓解，并严格保证正负符号扇区的不交支撑和归一化，在阻挫晶格上实现了符号遍历采样。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机级数展开（stochastic series expansion, SSE）框架，并开发了增量环拓扑更新（incremental loop-topology update）以处理阻挫晶格；通过扭曲通道（twist channel）实现符号遍历采样；控制变量由自回归变换器（autoregressive transformer）实现，并采用序列结束奇偶掩码（end-of-sequence parity mask）强制符号扇区分离，同时将增量环计数变化和累积阻挫奇偶性作为拓扑特征嵌入。

papers.title: Tunable competing optical excitation pathways in the topological surface states of Bi$_2$Te$_3$
papers.abstract: Understanding coherent optical responses of topological surface states (TSSs) requires disentangling excitation pathways from the electronic band structure. Here, using angle-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy, we identify two distinct excitation pathways in the TSSs of Bi$_2$Te$_3$: an off-resonant transition via virtual states and a resonant transition via unoccupied intermediate states. A pronounced modulation of the spectral response is observed, revealing a competition between the two coherent pathways. This competition is tunable via temperature-induced shifts of the chemical potential, which selectively modify the resonant channel. These results provide microscopic insight into the optical excitation mechanisms of TSSs and highlight the potential for controlling their optical responses, relevant for future spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：angle-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy（角分辨双光子光电子能谱）、spectral response（光谱响应）。；研究对象：Bi₂Te₃拓扑绝缘体的拓扑表面态（TSSs）中的相干光学激发过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bi₂Te₃的拓扑表面态中识别出两种不同的光学激发路径：通过虚态的非共振跃迁和通过未占据中间态的共振跃迁，两者之间存在可调谐的竞争关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bi₂Te₃的拓扑表面态中识别出两种不同的光学激发路径：通过虚态的非共振跃迁和通过未占据中间态的共振跃迁，两者之间存在可调谐的竞争关系。；创新点：首次在拓扑表面态中区分并直接观测到两种相干激发路径（虚态非共振与实态共振）的竞争，并发现该竞争可通过温度诱导的化学势移动进行调控。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨双光子光电子能谱（angle-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy）。

papers.title: Superconductivity-enhanced phonon angular momentum
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the properties of phonon angular momentum in the superconducting state, using fulleride compounds in an external magnetic field as a model system. The electron orbital angular momentum injected by an external field is transferred to the phonon subsystem via electron--phonon coupling. We show that this field-induced phonon angular momentum is significantly enhanced and undergoes a sign reversal upon entering the superconducting state. In the normal state, the dominant energy scale governing the response function is the electronic bandwidth $D$. In the superconducting state, the phonon energy scale $ω_1$ enters the denominator, leading to an enhancement of order $D/ω_1$. The observed sign change in the response can be explained by the competition between Fermi surface and Fermi volume contributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、model system、response function。；研究对象：超导态中声子角动量的性质，以富勒烯化合物在外磁场中作为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外磁场注入的电子轨道角动量通过电子-声子耦合转移至声子子系统，导致超导态中声子角动量显著增强并发生符号反转；增强幅度约为正常态下的 \( D/\omega_1 \) 倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外磁场注入的电子轨道角动量通过电子-声子耦合转移至声子子系统，导致超导态中声子角动量显著增强并发生符号反转；增强幅度约为正常态下的 \( D/\omega_1 \) 倍。；创新点：揭示了超导态中声子角动量相对于正常态的显著增强机制，并指出符号反转源于费米面与费米体积贡献的竞争。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于电子-声子耦合模型，通过比较正常态与超导态下响应函数的主导能量尺度（电子带宽 \( D \) 与声子能量 \( \omega_1 \)）来解释增强与符号变化。

papers.title: Weak first-order phase transition out of the classical kagome spin liquid
papers.abstract: The low-temperature fate of the spin-liquid regime in the classical kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet has been debated for over three decades. Using an expansion in the number of spin components, we show that, contrary to earlier Monte Carlo simulations, the spin liquid terminates at a weak first-order phase transition into the $\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$ phase which ordered moment saturates at zero temperature. Adding second-neighbor interactions, this transition belongs to a line of first-order phase transitions that ends at a critical point. For comparison, the pyrochlore antiferromagnet remains disordered at all temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用“expansion in the number of spin components”（自旋分量展开）这一理论方法，并与早期蒙特卡洛模拟结果进行对比。；研究对象：经典kagome晶格海森堡反铁磁体中的自旋液体相及其低温相变行为，同时涉及与pyrochlore反铁磁体的比较。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典kagome自旋液体在低温下并非直接保持无序，而是通过一个弱一级相变进入$\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$有序相，该有序相的磁矩在零温下饱和。加入次近邻相互作用后，该一级相变线终止于一个临界点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典kagome自旋液体在低温下并非直接保持无序，而是通过一个弱一级相变进入$\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}$有序相，该有序相的磁矩在零温下饱和。加入次近邻相互作用后，该一级相变线终止于一个临界点。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋分量数展开（expansion in the number of spin components）的理论分析方法。

papers.title: Relationship between heat effects and shear modulus relaxation during structural relaxation of a telluride glass
papers.abstract: We performed parallel measurements of heat effects and shear modulus relaxation for glassy Te$_{75}$Ge$_{15}$Ga$_{10}$ taken as a representative of practically important non-metallic glasses with covalent bonding. It is shown that the heat effects occurring upon heating are quantitatively linked to the shear moduli in the glassy and crystalline states and their temperature derivatives as implied by Eq.(1), which was originally derived for metallic glasses. This relationship provides a good description of exo- and endothermal reactions using shear modulus relaxation data as an input. This is the first application of this approach to a non-metallic glass with directional interatomic bonding. The obtained results suggest that relaxation phenomena are governed by elastic dipoles -- atomic configurations with the symmetry lower than that of surrounding matrix.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“parallel measurements”（并行测量）、“heat effects”（热效应）、“shear modulus relaxation”（剪切模量弛豫）。；研究对象：碲化物玻璃 Te₇₅Ge₁₅Ga₁₀，作为具有共价键的实际重要非金属玻璃的代表，研究其在结构弛豫过程中的热效应与剪切模量弛豫之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 加热过程中产生的热效应与玻璃态和晶态下的剪切模量及其温度导数之间存在定量关联，该关系最初针对金属玻璃推导，现首次成功应用于具有方向性共价键的非金属玻璃。结果表明弛豫现象由弹性偶极子（对称性低于周围基质的原子构型）主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：加热过程中产生的热效应与玻璃态和晶态下的剪切模量及其温度导数之间存在定量关联，该关系最初针对金属玻璃推导，现首次成功应用于具有方向性共价键的非金属玻璃。结果表明弛豫现象由弹性偶极子（对称性低于周围基质的原子构型）主导。；创新点：首次将原本针对金属玻璃推导的热效应与剪切模量之间的定量关系应用于非金属共价键玻璃体系，并验证其适用性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 并行测量热效应（如放热/吸热反应）和剪切模量弛豫数据，利用式(1)（摘要中提及的定量关系）将剪切模量弛豫数据作为输入来描述热效应。

papers.title: MatFormBench: A Benchmarking Evaluation Framework for Target-Driven Materials Formulation
papers.abstract: Inverse design of materials has significantly advanced target-driven formulation optimization, yet existing materials machine learning benchmarks remain limited to forward property prediction, failing to systematically evaluate inverse optimization and generation algorithms, a critical gap that hinders the progress of target-driven materials design. To address this limitation, we propose MatFormBench, a novel benchmarking ecosystem tailored to evaluate and guide generative strategies for target-driven formulation. MatFormBench integrates a physics-driven formulation generation scheme to generate synthetic samples that faithfully emulate realistic materials structure-property response relationships, complemented by five escalating difficulty levels to quantify the complexity of these relationships. To rigorously assess algorithm performance, we further propose MatFormScore, a multi-dimensional metric that comprehensively quantifies performance across five critical axes: target success, search efficiency, exploratory capacity, robustness, and stability. We validate MatFormBench by evaluating 39 diverse inverse design algorithms, covering classical surrogate-assisted black-box search, state-of-the-art deep generative models, and increasingly popular Large Language Model (LLM)-based recommendation strategies. Across 1170 standardized algorithm-task evaluations, diffusion-based models demonstrate the strongest overall performance, while Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based and Genetic Algorithm (GA)-based methods exhibit distinct advantages in specific scenarios. By establishing a unified evaluation standard for target-driven materials formulation, MatFormBench enables reproducible benchmarking, principled algorithm comparison, and diagnostic analysis of inverse design strategies, providing a foundational tool for advancing materials inverse design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：benchmarking evaluation framework, inverse design algorithms, generative models, machine learning）；研究对象：材料配方（materials formulation）的逆向设计，具体针对目标驱动的配方优化问题，不涉及特定化合物或物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个名为MatFormBench的标准化基准评估框架，用于系统评价逆向设计算法；在1170项标准化算法-任务评估中，扩散模型整体表现最强，而变分自编码器（VAE）和遗传算法（GA）在特定场景下具有独特优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个名为MatFormBench的标准化基准评估框架，用于系统评价逆向设计算法；在1170项标准化算法-任务评估中，扩散模型整体表现最强，而变分自编码器（VAE）和遗传算法（GA）在特定场景下具有独特优势。；创新点：首次针对目标驱动材料配方逆向设计建立了统一的标准化基准评估框架，填补了现有材料机器学习基准仅局限于正向性质预测、缺乏逆向优化与生成算法系统评价的空白。
papers.method_zh: 构建了物理驱动的配方生成方案（physics-driven formulation generation scheme），生成模拟真实材料结构-性能响应关系的合成样本；设计了五个递增难度级别；提出了多维评价指标MatFormScore，涵盖目标成功率、搜索效率、探索能力、鲁棒性和稳定性五个维度；评估了39种逆向设计算法，包括经典代理辅助黑箱搜索、深度生成模型和基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐策略。

papers.title: Visualizing Degradation in Anode-Free High-Utilization Aqueous Batteries Across Cell Lifetime
papers.abstract: Operando microscopy has unveiled key mechanistic insights in battery materials during early cycling, but long-term characterization to unveil material evolution, degradation, and failure remain limited. To address this gap, we develop a custom operando optical microscope that captures images across hundreds of cycles and hours using optically accessible, anode-free pouch cells. We image through-plane, bulk-representative electrodeposition behavior of aqueous tin metal anodes, which are promising due to their high energy density but whose reactivity limits practical cycle life. We show that substrate governs the morphology and stability of plated tin, particularly at high plated capacities. Specifically, copper substrates exhibit a multi-stage tin growth mode, which results in high overpotentials and irreversible active material loss at high plated capacities. In contrast, graphite substrates display a single-stage growth mode with slower kinetics. Using this insight, we balance performance and stability to demonstrate a high-utilization (70%, 630 mAh g$^{-1}_{Sn}$) porous graphite substrate Sn anode with high efficiency and long lifetime. Our results underscore the importance of material and device optimization guided by operando characterization across device lifetime with broad applicability to electrochemical systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Operando microscopy”、“custom operando optical microscope”、“imaging”等表明主要采用实验手段。；研究对象：无负极水系电池中锡金属负极的电沉积行为，特别是铜和石墨基底上的锡沉积形态与稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基底材料决定了锡沉积的形态和稳定性：铜基底上锡呈现多阶段生长模式，导致高过电位和不可逆活性物质损失；石墨基底上锡为单阶段生长模式，动力学较慢。基于此，采用多孔石墨基底实现了高利用率（70%，630 mAh g⁻¹_Sn）且长寿命的锡负极。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基底材料决定了锡沉积的形态和稳定性：铜基底上锡呈现多阶段生长模式，导致高过电位和不可逆活性物质损失；石墨基底上锡为单阶段生长模式，动力学较慢。基于此，采用多孔石墨基底实现了高利用率（70%，630 mAh g⁻¹_Sn）且长寿命的锡负极。；创新点：开发了能够跨电池全寿命周期（数百次循环）进行原位成像的显微镜技术，填补了长期表征材料演化、降解和失效的空白，并将该技术应用于揭示高利用率锡负极在不同基底上的生长机制与失效模式。
papers.method_zh: 定制原位光学显微镜（operando optical microscope），在可光学访问的无负极软包电池中，对数百个循环和数小时内的锡电沉积行为进行面外、体相代表性的成像观察。

papers.title: Chirality-Driven Hierarchical Morphologies in Self-Assembled Biaxial Amphiphiles
papers.abstract: Chirality plays a crucial role in determining the structure of many systems in nature. Twisted or helical aggregates as a consequence of self-assembly can be seen in many biological and synthetic materials. Despite extensive theoretical and experimental efforts, how molecular-scale chirality gives rise to complex twisted morphologies in amphiphiles still remains unexplored. Here we study the interplay between molecular hydrophobicity, shape anisotropy and chirality using molecular dynamics simulation. Variation of relative molecular concentration and intrinsic chirality of molecules drive a sequence of twisted liquid crystalline variants of lamellar, cylindrical and vesicular phases. These structures emerge spontaneously under equilibrium conditions and are characterized by orientational correlation functions. We demonstrate that variation in molecular chirality gives rise to the development of hierarchical chiral order within the system. Further increment of chirality competes with hydrophobic interactions, leading to morphological instabilities. Our findings establish a direct link between microscopic chirality and mesoscale structure formation and their instabilities. Qualitative comparison of liquidity and pitch of the observed phase morphologies with the amount of chirality has been reported.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation）进行研究。；研究对象：双轴两亲分子（biaxial amphiphiles）在自组装过程中由手性驱动的层级形态结构，具体涉及分子疏水性、形状各向异性与手性之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子手性的变化驱动了一系列扭曲的液晶相（层状、柱状和囊泡相）的自发形成，并导致系统内层级手性有序结构的出现；进一步增加手性会与疏水相互作用竞争，引发形态不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子手性的变化驱动了一系列扭曲的液晶相（层状、柱状和囊泡相）的自发形成，并导致系统内层级手性有序结构的出现；进一步增加手性会与疏水相互作用竞争，引发形态不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation），通过改变相对分子浓度和分子固有手性，利用取向关联函数（orientational correlation functions）表征自发形成的平衡结构。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Structures of Parametrically Driven Nonlinear Lattices
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the effects of parametric driving on the one-dimensional Frenkel-Kontorova model, a nonlinear many-body lattice system. It is numerically found that a parametric vibration induces spatiotemporal ordering characterized by the subharmonic frequency $ω_{\mathrm{ex}}/2$ and wavenumber $k$ which takes nontrivial values depending on the vibration strength $P_{\mathrm{ac}}$ and frequency $ω_{\mathrm{ex}}$. With increasing $P_{\mathrm{ac}}$, $k$ gradually increases and discontinuously jumps up to $k=π$. Based on an extended linear stability analysis, we show that the former $k$ resonance (the latter $π$ resonance) corresponds to the unstable (stable) mode and that the $k$ resonance is made possible by the interplay between the parametric amplification and the collective fluctuation developing through the nonlinear effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：theoretically investigate、numerically found、extended linear stability analysis。；研究对象：一维Frenkel-Kontorova模型（一种非线性多体晶格系统）在参量驱动下的时空结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 参量振动可诱导出具有亚谐频率ω_ex/2和特定波数k的时空有序结构；随着驱动强度P_ac增加，波数k逐渐增大并发生不连续跳变至k=π，其中k共振（π共振）分别对应不稳定（稳定）模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：参量振动可诱导出具有亚谐频率ω_ex/2和特定波数k的时空有序结构；随着驱动强度P_ac增加，波数k逐渐增大并发生不连续跳变至k=π，其中k共振（π共振）分别对应不稳定（稳定）模式。；创新点：揭示了参量放大与通过非线性效应发展的集体涨落之间的相互作用如何导致k共振现象。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（数值发现亚谐时空有序结构）结合扩展线性稳定性分析（解析解释共振模式的不稳定性与稳定性）。

papers.title: Quantum statistical mechanics: Gauge invariance, operator shifting, hyperdensity functionals, and nonequilibrium sum rules
papers.abstract: We provide an extended acount of the recent statistical mechanical theory of gauge invariance against operator shifting in quantum many-body systems (arXiv:2509.20494). The gauge transformation is enacted by a shifting superoperator that displaces the fundamental position and momentum degrees of freedom. The shifting superoperator constitutes a map between Hilbert space operators and it features Lie algebra commutator structure. Averages of general observables remain invariant under the shifting both in and out of thermal equilibrium, as well as in groundstates. The gauge invariance induces exact sum rules that interconnect global observables and associated locally resolved correlation functions. In particular we describe the resulting one-body force, hyperforce, product, and two-body sum rules. We relate the shifting superoperator to a previously formulated quantum canonical transformation and present the generalization of quantum shifting to multi-component systems. The gauge theory respects fundamental fermionic and bosonic particle properties, as we demonstrate by proving the compatibility of operator shifting and exchange symmetry. We formulate the quantum version of hyperdensity functional theory to provide formal access to hyperforces as well as to general averaged quantum observables via universal density functionals. For time-dependent situations, we describe quantum dynamical gauge invariance and prove exact dynamical sum rules for nonequilibrium situations, as generated by Hamiltonian time dependence. We argue for the fundamental status of statistical mechanical gauge invariance based on the compliance of the underlying geometry with canonical quantization according to Dirac's correspondence principle. Analogies and differences of the quantum mechanical sum rules with their classical counterparts remain indicative of the respective levels of description.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：statistical mechanical theory、gauge invariance、superoperator、Lie algebra、canonical transformation、hyperdensity functional theory。；研究对象：量子多体系统的统计力学，具体研究规范不变性（gauge invariance）在算符平移（operator shifting）下的性质，以及由此导出的求和规则（sum rules）和超密度泛函理论（hyperdensity functional theory）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子多体系统中存在一种由平移超算符（shifting superoperator）实现的规范变换，该变换保持热平衡、非平衡及基态下可观测量平均值的规范不变性，并由此导出一系列精确的求和规则（如单体力、超力、乘积及两体求和规则）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子多体系统中存在一种由平移超算符（shifting superoperator）实现的规范变换，该变换保持热平衡、非平衡及基态下可观测量平均值的规范不变性，并由此导出一系列精确的求和规则（如单体力、超力、乘积及两体求和规则）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但明确扩展了近期提出的规范不变性理论（arXiv:2509.20494），并首次将算符平移推广到多组分系统，证明了其与费米子/玻色子交换对称性的兼容性，同时建立了量子版本的超密度泛函理论。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于平移超算符的规范理论，结合李代数对易子结构、量子正则变换、超密度泛函理论以及狄拉克对应原理下的正则量子化几何。推导了量子动力学规范不变性及非平衡精确动力学求和规则。

papers.title: Geometric Protection of Bipartite Entanglement in Hopf-Linked Quantum Rings
papers.abstract: We determine the bipartite entanglement bounds of two interacting electrons in deeply interlocked Hopf-linked quantum rings via exact diagonalization of the unexpanded 3D Coulomb interaction. This identifies an exact continuous spatial symmetry that geometrically isolates the positive-parity Bell state, preventing classical interaction-driven localization. A non-coplanar geometric tilt ($α> 0$) is essential to lift the exchange degeneracy and maintain this maximally entangled manifold as a state of frozen entanglement. However, a higher-order Schrieffer-Wolff transformation demonstrates this geometric protection is fundamentally bounded; uncancelled inter-orbital momentum transitions inevitably induce dynamical parity mixing. This defines a critical interaction threshold ($λ_{crit}$) for irreversible entanglement collapse. Our analysis shows that the resulting bounding conditions reveal scaling limitations in mesoscopic semiconductor architectures, dictating the necessity of synthetic macroscopic platforms to achieve robust topological protection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact diagonalization、Schrieffer-Wolff transformation、理论分析。；研究对象：两个相互作用的电子在深度互锁的Hopf链接量子环（Hopf-linked quantum rings）中的双粒子纠缠行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种精确的连续空间对称性，能几何地隔离正宇称Bell态，阻止经典相互作用驱动的局域化；但这种几何保护存在根本性边界，不可消除的轨道间动量跃迁会诱导动态宇称混合，导致纠缠在临界相互作用阈值处不可逆坍缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种精确的连续空间对称性，能几何地隔离正宇称Bell态，阻止经典相互作用驱动的局域化；但这种几何保护存在根本性边界，不可消除的轨道间动量跃迁会诱导动态宇称混合，导致纠缠在临界相互作用阈值处不可逆坍缩。；创新点：揭示了Hopf链接量子环中双粒子纠缠的几何保护机制及其根本性边界，并给出了临界相互作用阈值，指出在介观半导体架构中存在缩放限制，需合成宏观平台才能实现鲁棒的拓扑保护。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用未展开的三维库仑相互作用的精确对角化方法，以及高阶Schrieffer-Wolff变换进行理论分析。

papers.title: Designing Quantum Matter in Pyrochlore Iridates: A Perspective on Recent Thin-Film Advances
papers.abstract: The pyrochlore iridates R2Ir2O7 have emerged as a unique playground for exploring exotic quantum phenomena arising from the intricate interplay of strong spin-orbit coupling, electron correlations, and geometric frustration. While bulk crystals of these materials have revealed a rich landscape of correlated and topological states, recent breakthroughs in epitaxial thin-film synthesis and heterostructure engineering unlocked an entirely new dimension of discovery. This brief Perspective reviews recent advancements highlighting how new tuning knobs such as dimensional confinement, epitaxial strain, and interfacial coupling can be used to manipulate the delicate balance of competing interactions. We discuss several key discoveries enabled by this approach including the realization of the magnetic Weyl semimetal phase in (111) oriented films, strain-engineered magnetic multipolar orders, the emergence of a chiral spin liquid-like state in the quasi-2D limit, and the discovery of novel electronically anisotropic states at interfaces between pyrochlore iridates and other quantum materials, such as spin ice pyrochlores. These findings showcase that low-dimensional pyrochlore iridates provide ample opportunities for both theory and experiment to unravel, control and ultimately design novel quantum states of matter. We conclude by outlining key open questions and future directions ranging from the synthesis of new heterostructures to the application of advanced probes and the exploration of non-equilibrium phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/展望文章（Perspective）。判断依据：关键词“Perspective”、“reviews recent advancements”、“outline key open questions and future directions”。；研究对象：烧绿石铱氧化物（R₂Ir₂O₇）薄膜及异质结，具体涉及（111）取向薄膜、准二维极限下的手性自旋液体态、与自旋冰烧绿石等量子材料的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过维度约束、外延应变和界面耦合等新调控手段，在低维烧绿石铱氧化物中实现了磁性外尔半金属相、应变调控的磁多极序、准二维极限下的手性自旋液体态，以及与其他量子材料界面处的新型电子各向异性态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过维度约束、外延应变和界面耦合等新调控手段，在低维烧绿石铱氧化物中实现了磁性外尔半金属相、应变调控的磁多极序、准二维极限下的手性自旋液体态，以及与其他量子材料界面处的新型电子各向异性态。；创新点：将烧绿石铱氧化物的研究从块材拓展到低维薄膜和异质结体系，引入了维度约束、应变和界面耦合等全新调控自由度，从而实现了块材中无法获得的量子态（如准二维手性自旋液体态）。
papers.method_zh: 外延薄膜生长（分子束外延或脉冲激光沉积等，摘要未明确具体技术）、异质结构工程、应变工程、界面耦合调控。摘要未提及具体表征或计算手段。

papers.title: Ultrametricity of Energy Minimum Configurations of RNA Secondary Structures in the Nussinov Model
papers.abstract: We present a numerical study of the ultrametric properties of the set of RNA secondary structures with the maximum number of base pairs (energetically degenerate minima) within the maximum matching model (Nussinov algorithm). Using 18 natural small nuclear RNAs as examples, we show that the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity varies widely. We consider the optimization problem for the degree of nontrivial ultrametricity of RNA secondary structures with the maximum number of base pairs under a fixed nucleotide composition. It is found that permuting the nucleotide sequence can strongly change the degree of ultrametricity, indicating the key role of nucleotide order in shaping the hierarchical properties of RNA secondary structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical study、maximum matching model (Nussinov algorithm)、optimization problem。；研究对象：RNA二级结构在最大碱基配对（能量简并极小值）构型集合中的超度量性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 不同天然小核RNA的二级结构构型集合的非平凡超度量程度差异很大；在固定核苷酸组成下，改变核苷酸序列可以显著改变超度量程度，表明核苷酸顺序对RNA二级结构的层级性质起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：不同天然小核RNA的二级结构构型集合的非平凡超度量程度差异很大；在固定核苷酸组成下，改变核苷酸序列可以显著改变超度量程度，表明核苷酸顺序对RNA二级结构的层级性质起关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于最大匹配模型（Nussinov算法）进行数值计算，以18种天然小核RNA为样本，分析具有最大碱基配对数的能量简并极小值构型集合的超度量性质，并针对固定核苷酸组成下的序列排列进行优化问题研究。

papers.title: Near-Infrared-Triggered Photodynamic Antibacterial Therapy Using Rose Bengal-Coated Upconverting Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial photodynamic therapy (aPDT) is a promising modality for inactivation of antibiotic resistant bacteria, relying on the activation of a photosensitizer (PS) by light of a specific wavelength. This process results in the formation of reactive oxygen species, which ultimately induce cell death. However, aPDT in its conventional form, is limited by the shallow penetration of visible light, restricting its effectiveness for treatment of soft tissue and orthopaedic tissues. To overcome this limitation, near-infrared (NIR) absorbing PS can be used. However, poor stability in vivo after injection, ineffective microbial targeting due to hydrophilic nature and off-site tissue damage are the issues with use of NIR absorbing bare PSs.
